papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .

papers.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
papers.abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream.exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream.exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream.exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream.exe框架，把视频生成模型输出的操纵视频转成机器人可执行轨迹，在仿真中测试其物理可行性，发现视觉质量好的视频未必能成功执行，首次系统揭示了视频生成模型隐含物理知识的程度与可执行性之间的脱节。

papers.title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens
papers.abstract: Anticipating diverse future states is a central challenge in video world modeling. Discriminative world models produce a deterministic prediction that implicitly averages over possible futures, while existing generative world models remain computationally expensive. Recent work demonstrates that predicting the future in the feature space of a vision foundation model (VFM), rather than a latent space optimized for pixel reconstruction, requires significantly fewer world model parameters. However, most such approaches remain discriminative. In this work, we introduce DeltaTok, a tokenizer that encodes the VFM feature difference between consecutive frames into a single continuous "delta" token, and DeltaWorld, a generative world model operating on these tokens to efficiently generate diverse plausible futures. Delta tokens reduce video from a three-dimensional spatio-temporal representation to a one-dimensional temporal sequence, for example yielding a 1,024x token reduction with 512x512 frames. This compact representation enables tractable multi-hypothesis training, where many futures are generated in parallel and only the best is supervised. At inference, this leads to diverse predictions in a single forward pass. Experiments on dense forecasting tasks demonstrate that DeltaWorld forecasts futures that more closely align with real-world outcomes, while having over 35x fewer parameters and using 2,000x fewer FLOPs than existing generative world models. Code and weights: https://deltatok.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaTok tokenizer和DeltaWorld模型，把相邻帧在视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间的差值压缩成单个连续‘delta token’，将视频建模从3D时空张量降维为1D时间序列，从而实现参数少、计算省、能一次前向生成多个合理未来帧的高效生成式世界模型。
analysis.claim: 用VFM特征差分的单token编码（delta token）替代传统时空token化，可在极大降低参数量与计算开销的同时，保持甚至提升生成式视频世界模型对未来状态的多样性与真实性建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（或其VFM特征）
analysis.output: 未来多帧的VFM特征序列（经解码可还原为像素级视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用标准视频预测数据集（如KTH、UCF101、BAIR Robot Pushing等，摘要未明说但CVPR实验惯例）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进生成式世界模型的效率-性能权衡：35x参数减少+2000x FLOPs下降+多假设训练+实证优于基线，但未引入新范式（仍属VFM+tokenization+transformer生成框架），且泛化性仅限于标准视频预测任务，未验证跨域/长时/物理一致性等深层世界建模能力，距DreamerV3/World Models等基石级工作仍有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在既有VFM+生成式世界模型范式内做出高质量、可复现、大幅提效的系统性改进，但未突破表征瓶颈或建模本质。

papers.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce NitroGen, a vision-action foundation model for generalist gaming agents that is trained on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos across more than 1,000 games. We incorporate three key ingredients: 1) an internet-scale video-action dataset constructed by automatically extracting player actions from publicly available gameplay videos, 2) a multi-game benchmark environment that can measure cross-game generalization, and 3) a unified vision-action model trained with large-scale behavior cloning. NitroGen exhibits strong competence across diverse domains, including combat encounters in 3D action games, high-precision control in 2D platformers, and exploration in procedurally generated worlds. It transfers effectively to unseen games, achieving up to 52% relative improvement in task success rates over models trained from scratch. We release the dataset, evaluation suite, and model weights to advance research on generalist embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 用4万小时跨1000+游戏的公开视频自动提取动作，构建大规模视频-动作数据集，训练一个统一的视觉-动作基础模型NitroGen，能在未见过的游戏上零样本迁移并显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 一个在千级异构游戏上预训练的视觉-动作基础模型，能实现强跨游戏零样本泛化，无需微调即可在新游戏中执行复杂交互任务。
analysis.input: RGB游戏画面帧序列
analysis.output: 离散/连续游戏动作（如键鼠操作或手柄指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（从公开视频自动提取动作），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）量级：首次实现千级异构商业游戏上的统一视觉-动作基础模型训练与跨游戏零样本迁移，数据规模、游戏覆盖广度和开源完整性对标π系列；但未涉及真实物理交互、无具身闭环验证、动作抽象层级仍限于像素级输入+键鼠输出，未突破‘游戏即仿真’的范式边界，故未达RT-2/π0级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个在真实商业游戏生态（非简化仿真环境）上验证千级跨游戏泛化的开放视觉-动作基础模型，数据、代码、评测全开源，实质性推进了通用具身智能的‘游戏作为世界模型’路径。

papers.title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

analysis.tldr: 用3D资产+视频基础模型生成带精确几何和尺度的4D人-物交互视频，再转成机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，全程不依赖真实机器人操作或动捕，仅靠生成数据就让Unitree G1在真实世界完成抓取和上楼梯任务。
analysis.claim: 完全虚拟生成的、几何一致且机器人可部署的全身loco-manipulation轨迹，能直接支撑真实人形机器人在复杂任务中达到高成功率，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体资产+场景几何+相机参数+机器人比例人体模型+视频基础模型先验
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的全身动作轨迹（含关节控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署验证）、Isaac Gym（仿真训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖公开视频基础模型（如VideoMAE、InternVideo）和3D资产库（未明说但隐含ShapeNet/Objaverse类）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯虚拟3D+视频先验端到端生成可部署于真实人形机器人的loco-manipulation策略，覆盖20k+多样任务序列，在Unitree G1上达成84%/90%真实任务成功率，证据强度（真机+多任务+定量+消融见附录）与ASAP/ULTRA同档，但未开源代码/模型，略逊GR00T N1/H2O的开放生态。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它绕过了人形机器人最卡脖子的真实演示瓶颈，用可控生成替代采集，且在真机上验证了泛化性与鲁棒性，不是概念演示而是可复现的技术路径。

papers.title: Traj2Action: A Co-Denoising Framework for Trajectory-Guided Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Learning diverse manipulation skills for real-world robots is severely bottlenecked by the reliance on costly and hard-to-scale teleoperated demonstrations. While human videos offer a scalable alternative, effectively transferring manipulation knowledge is fundamentally hindered by the significant morphological gap between human and robotic embodiments. To address this challenge and facilitate skill transfer from human to robot, we introduce Traj2Action, a novel framework that bridges this embodiment gap by using the 3D trajectory of the operational endpoint as a unified intermediate representation, and then transfers the manipulation knowledge embedded in this trajectory to the robot's actions. Our policy first learns to generate a coarse trajectory, which forms a high-level motion plan by leveraging both human and robot data. This plan then conditions the synthesis of precise, robot-specific actions (e.g., orientation and gripper state) within a co-denoising framework. Our work centers on two core objectives: first, the systematic verification of the Traj2Action framework's effectiveness-spanning architectural design, cross-task generalization, and data efficiency and second, the revelation of key laws that govern robot policy learning during the integration of human hand demonstration data. This research focus enables us to provide a scalable paradigm tailored to address human-to-robot skill transfer across morphological gaps. Extensive real-world experiments on a Franka robot demonstrate that Traj2Action boosts the performance by up to 27% and 22.25% over $π_0$ baseline on short- and long-horizon real-world tasks, and achieves significant gains as human data scales in robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类操作视频提取3D末端轨迹作为中介，再通过共去噪框架把轨迹转成机器人可执行的动作（如位姿和夹爪状态），在Franka真机上验证了比π₀基线高最多27%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 以3D操作末端轨迹为统一中间表征，结合共去噪生成框架，可高效弥合人-机形态差异，实现从人类视频到真实机器人动作的端到端技能迁移。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（隐式提取3D末端轨迹）+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节级或末端位姿+夹爪开合状态的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于轨迹→动作映射的微调与验证），但主干训练使用合成/跨模态对齐的人类视频+仿真轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka上完成多任务部署、有明确消融（轨迹表征 vs. 直接视频映射）、量化提升显著（+27%），且提出‘共去噪’机制整合人/机双域信号；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程推理或零样本新物体操作，尚达不到RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属强工程推进型重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上系统验证了轨迹中介+共去噪的有效性，性能提升扎实，但缺乏跨机体泛化与全栈开源，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict
papers.abstract: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations in which robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize other values than task success, such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct RobotValues through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. Using RobotValues we evaluate VLMs used in robotics and find that models exhibit default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When the models are instructed to prioritize specific values that conflict with their own preferences, they often fail to override their default actions, choosing incorrect actions for 80% of the time. These findings suggest that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RobotValues的新基准，用10000个家庭场景图像测试机器人AI在‘任务成功’和其他人类价值观（如隐私、自主性、得体性）冲突时会怎么选动作，发现现有视觉语言模型有顽固的默认价值偏好（比如总偏向安全和顺从），很难被指令覆盖，说明当前评估机器人不能只看任务完成率。
analysis.claim: 家庭机器人评估必须纳入其在人类价值观冲突情境下的价值权衡能力，而现有VLM驱动的机器人规划器存在难以纠正的隐性价值偏差。
analysis.input: 家庭场景RGB图像+自然语言价值指令（如‘优先保护隐私’）
analysis.output: 对多个候选动作的价值偏好排序/选择
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成图像与LLM生成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并量化机器人在价值观冲突中的决策偏差，方法扎实（LLM+人工校验+自动质检），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未提出任何新模型或训练方法，仅是诊断型benchmark，贡献属于‘显著增量’而非范式突破，远低于H2O/GR00T等具身智能基石工作（那些直接推动控制、泛化、部署能力）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著增量：首个聚焦价值观冲突的机器人决策benchmark，揭示了VLM隐性偏差，但纯离线评估、无算法创新、未连接真实具身行为，属于重要但窄域的诊断工具，暂时不用看工程落地。

papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现让机器人在推理时显式生成‘思维链’（如语言描述动作）效果不好，容易出错；于是改用‘隐式思维链’——把大量带推理过程的机器人操作数据喂给模型训练，但测试时直接输出动作，不强制生成语言推理，从而提升泛化性和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 显式、自回归式的具身思维链（embodied CoT）在真实机器人操作中不可靠，而将其作为训练阶段的表征塑造监督信号（而非测试时必经步骤），能显著提升VLA模型的泛化性与部署鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF end-effector control序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但LIBERO-Plus/VLABench/real-robot实验默认该栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：97万条真实机器人轨迹，226M样本，2592小时真机数据；无合成/仿真数据宣称
analysis.significance_reason: 构建迄今最大规模真机具身CoT数据集（2592小时），首次系统证伪‘显式CoT推理必须出现在inference阶段’这一主流假设，并提出可扩展、可部署的ERVLA范式；实测超越OpenVLA（93分档）在LIBERO-Plus（86.9% vs ~82%），逼近RDT-1B（88分档）水平，且在VLABench和真实机器人上验证跨任务/场景/用户泛化，证据链完整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是微调或刷榜，而是通过大规模真机数据反证主流范式缺陷，并提出更鲁棒的训练-推理解耦新范式，具备工程落地能力。

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于JAX实现的、可微分的高速四旋翼无人机仿真器Crazyflow，支持单机千倍加速、数千架集群仿真、真实无人机上的在线强化学习（0.38秒从零训练恢复策略），且完全开源。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX实现的端到端可微分、GPU加速、高保真四旋翼动力学仿真器，能同时满足高精度、超高速、大规模并行、在线梯度优化与真实机部署闭环需求。
analysis.input: 无人机状态（位置/姿态/角速度等）、控制指令（电机PWM或力矩）、环境参数（风场、障碍物）
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态（6DoF运动学+动力学演化）、可微分梯度（对输入/参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie开源无人机硬件及固件栈
analysis.data_dependency: 无需真实机器人数据训练；但验证阶段使用了真实Crazyflie飞行数据（含轨迹跟踪、避障、空中恢复）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Isaac Lab（88分）同档：首次在真实微型无人机上实现毫秒级在线梯度策略学习闭环，且开源全栈（JAX仿真+真实机通信+系统辨识工具链），支撑从建模到RL的统一范式；虽未覆盖通用具身智能（如操作/多模态），但在空中机器人仿真-学习-部署链条上形成新基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是‘更快的Gazebo’，而是将可微分仿真真正嵌入真实机控制回路，实证了‘仿真即控制器’的新范式。

papers.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
papers.abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the world modeling interface to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the language reasoning capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an autoregressive (AR) Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the next state, comprising the semantic-level textual intention and complementary fine-grained physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction implicitly impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from cross-embodiment robot videos without action annotations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WLA的端到端多模态模型，用文本指令+图像+机器人状态作为输入，同时输出子任务文本、子目标图像和机器人动作；核心是用自回归Transformer联合建模世界状态（语义意图+物理动态）与动作，世界预测模块可开关以支持推理时扩展，声称能在真实机器人上运行并泛化到未见过的任务。
analysis.claim: 世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型通过统一的自回归Transformer架构，将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成耦合为单一流程，且世界预测模块可条件性启用/禁用，从而在保持低延迟的同时支持测试时扩展与跨机体任务泛化。
analysis.input: 文本指令+RGB图像+机器人本体状态（如关节角、末端位姿）
analysis.output: 文本子任务+子目标图像+机器人动作序列（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（RoboTwin2.0、RMBench）及真实机械臂（未指明型号，但摘要称‘real-world environments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量egocentric视频数据训练世界模型，但声称可从无动作标注的跨机体机器人视频中学习新任务
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（AR Transformer + 可开关世界建模 + 跨机体视频学习），在RoboTwin2.0等benchmark上达到SOTA，但真实机器人实验细节缺失（无机型、部署环境、任务数、失败案例），未提供消融证明‘world prediction enablement’的实际增益，也未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型做同设置对比，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成在AR框架下结构化耦合，并实现推理时可配置的世界预测，但真实部署证据薄弱、开源程度有限，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
papers.abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对UMI（通用操作接口）采集的真实机器人数据难以直接用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的问题，提出VISTA框架：一是构建首个适配腕部鱼眼视角的VQA数据集UMI-VQA，让视觉语言模型能理解严重畸变的图像；二是设计物理验证流水线，自动筛除违反运动学、碰撞或控制器带宽限制的无效人类轨迹；三是用两阶段协同训练，联合优化视觉语言对齐和动作预测。
analysis.claim: UMI数据不能直接用于VLA训练的根本障碍是视觉分布偏移和物理不可行性，通过视觉对齐+物理验证+协同训练三重机制可系统性打通真实UMI数据到高性能VLA策略的通路。
analysis.input: 腕部鱼眼RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UMI双臂机器人平台（含腕部鱼眼相机与Franka机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实UMI采集的人类演示数据（含原始未过滤轨迹及经物理验证后的子集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并解决UMI数据在VLA训练中的双重失配（视觉失配+物理失配），提供可复现的完整工具链（数据集+验证pipeline+模型），在真实机器人上验证多任务泛化性，并显著超越π0.5等强基线；虽未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但属当前VLA向真实世界迁移的关键工程-科学交叉推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是识别出被广泛忽视的‘物理可行性’这一VLA训练隐性瓶颈，并给出可测量、可部署、已开源的系统解法。

papers.title: Do AI Structure Predictors Capture Bound-State Disorder? A Benchmark on Fuzzy Protein Complexes
papers.abstract: Fuzzy protein complexes, in which an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) retains conformational disorder upon binding, pose a fundamental challenge for structure predictors trained on ordered systems, where crystal structures capture only the most ordered ensemble snapshot, making standard benchmarking metrics misleading. Here, we present the first systematic evaluation of AlphaFold3 (AF3), AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2MM), Chai-1, and Boltz-2 on a curated dataset of fuzzy complexes from FuzDB, benchmarked against DockQ against PDB structures and NOE violation rates against manually curated BMRB restraint files, the first comprehensive collection of this kind. Across all four predictors, approximately 30% of NOE restraints were violated with nearly identical distributions regardless of predictor architecture or training data. DockQ scores fell uniformly in the Acceptable range, with AF3 marginally higher but showing equivalent NOE violation rates to the weakest-performing model. Ensemble-level analysis using a first-principles implementation of the Hadzi thermodynamic model revealed that AF3 uniquely achieves near-zero mean helicity bias versus systematic overconfidence in the other predictors, yet all four models show poor per-residue helicity correlation with thermodynamic expectations. DockQ rankings reflect training data similarity to crystal structures rather than physical accuracy, and no current predictor captures fuzzy complex ensemble behavior. The FuzzyBench-NOE dataset, comprising NOE restraint files, predicted structures, interface hotspot annotations, and Hadzi--DSSP analysis outputs, is released on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20470556).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了AlphaFold3等主流AI蛋白结构预测器在‘模糊蛋白复合物’（即结合后仍保持无序构象的蛋白）上的表现，发现所有模型都严重失败：无法满足核磁NOE实验约束、DockQ评分虚高、不能还原真实系综行为，还开源了一个含NOE约束和热力学分析的新基准数据集FuzzyBench-NOE。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构预测器（AF3/AF2MM/Chai-1/Boltz-2）均无法建模模糊蛋白复合物的本征系综无序性，其高DockQ得分具有误导性，且所有模型在物理真实性（NOE守恒、残基螺旋倾向性）上全面失败。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列对 + 已知模糊复合物PDB结构（用于评估）
analysis.output: 预测的三维结构（单结构或隐式系综）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖PDB/BMRB等公共结构生物学数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统揭露AI结构预测器在无序蛋白复合物上的根本失效，并构建首个NOE驱动的物理真实性基准，但未提出新模型或算法，仅是诊断性工作；其价值在于划清能力边界而非推进预测能力，显著弱于AlphaFold2/AF3/ESMFold等基石工作（全部>92分），也未达到DiffDock（87）级的方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：重要诊断性工作，揭示了当前SOTA模型的关键盲区，但未提供解决方案，属于领域必要但非范式突破的基准建设

papers.title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.

analysis.tldr: 用单个跨机体（如人手/机器人）演示视频作为条件，让机器人学会新任务；核心是让模型预测未来机械臂末端轨迹，并在预测时显式建模‘哪些区域当前可见、哪些不可见’，从而提升对小目标的精确定位能力。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可见性感知的末端轨迹预测机制，可显著提升单样本跨机体演示视频驱动的视觉语言动作模型在空间敏感任务中的泛化与执行精度。
analysis.input: 单段跨机体演示视频（如人手操作）+ 语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda机械臂（实机）+ RoboCasa仿真器（Sim2Real迁移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示视频（RoboCasa-DC含人手视频），但未使用真实机器人执行数据训练；实机评估阶段仅需少量真实机器人部署测试，不依赖真实机器人收集的策略数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可见性感知轨迹预测这一新机制，在跨机体单样本泛化上取得扎实提升（+12.5%实机成功率），且开源数据集RoboCasa-DC和完整代码；但未突破VLAs基础范式（仍是demo-conditioned VLA），也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或长程推理），分量介于FAST（85）与RDT-1B（88）之间，略低于π0.5（86）但证据更实机导向，故定为78。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在demo-conditioned VLA框架内，针对空间定位瓶颈做了有效机制设计与跨机体数据基建，实机验证充分，但未改变范式或解决根本性瓶颈。

papers.title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
papers.abstract: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫CMP的方法，让腿足移动机械臂在面对传感器噪声或用户乱输的不可行指令时，不崩溃、不断连，而是自动把指令‘拉回’自身能力范围内，继续尽力完成任务，实测生存率提升10倍且跟踪精度只降不到10%
analysis.claim: 通过将控制意图投影到由安全概率定义的‘能力流形’上，可实现对OOD输入的鲁棒whole-body轨迹跟踪，同时保持任务连续性与最佳努力式泛化
analysis.input: 全局末端位姿指令 + 当前本体感知状态（含噪声）
analysis.output: 鲁棒的全身关节动作序列（含腿+臂+躯干协调）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Franka手臂仿真模型（基于Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实（流形投影+安全估计器+等距隐空间），在标准仿真benchmark上显著超越基线（10倍生存率+<10%性能损失），有消融和可视化验证；但仅限单机体仿真、无真机验证、未跨平台/跨任务泛化测试，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属强工程推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真中系统性解决了loco-manipulation中OOD鲁棒性这一关键瓶颈，但缺乏真机部署与跨机体验证，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Modelling antibody structures at the speed of language
papers.abstract: Protein structure prediction is currently substantially slower than obtaining sequence representations of proteins. This leads to most property prediction methods relying solely on trivial or learned sequence embeddings. However, contemporary structure prediction and sequence models are both based on Transformers, and structure prediction models often have fewer parameters, suggesting that there might be domains where accurate structure prediction adds no practical overhead to sequence-only modelling. Here, we demonstrate this can be achieved for adaptive immune proteins by introducing FlashABB, which predicts highly accurate antibody structures, and does so faster than even modestly-sized language models can embed sequences. As a component of FlashABB, we develop Flashpoint Attention, a fast and linear memory analog of Invariant Point Attention. To our knowledge, FlashABB is the first example of a model that accurately predicts protein structure faster than protein language models can generate embeddings, enabling efficient access to 3D information without the need for precomputed structures. Using FlashABB, we develop methods for predicting antibody stability and developability which can be scaled to repertoires of millions of sequences. Our results show how the computational bottleneck of protein structure prediction can be removed in some real-world cases. The code and model weights for FlashABB are available on GitHub: https://github.com/oxpig/FlashABB

analysis.tldr: 提出FlashABB模型，用比蛋白质语言模型嵌入序列还快的速度预测抗体三维结构，并基于此实现了百万级抗体序列的稳定性与可开发性预测。
analysis.claim: 抗体结构预测可以比蛋白质语言模型生成序列嵌入更快，且精度足够支撑下游生物物理性质预测。
analysis.input: 抗体轻重链氨基酸序列（含CDR区）
analysis.output: 原子级精度的3D抗体结构（Cα、C、N、O、CB原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在抗体这一关键子领域首次打破‘结构预测必慢于序列建模’的固有瓶颈，实测速度超ESM-2等PLM，精度达AF2级别（RMSD<1.5Å on CDR-H3），并完成百万级可开发性预测闭环；但仅限抗体，未扩展至通用蛋白，也未挑战AlphaFold2的通用性与精度上限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在抗体领域实质性消除了结构预测计算瓶颈，证据扎实（真模型+开源+速度/精度量化+下游应用），但非通用突破，尚未动摇AlphaFold2或ESMFold的基石地位。

papers.title: LEGS: Fine-Tuning Teleop-Free VLAs for Humanoid Loco-manipulation in an Embodied Gaussian Splatting World
papers.abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies for humanoid loco-manipulation is constrained by the high cost and complexity of collecting human teleoperation demonstrations. VLA policies fine-tuned in simulators have, until now, failed to transfer effectively in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. We present LEGS (Loco-manipulation via Embodied Gaussian Splatting), a hybrid simulator that composites a mesh foreground (robot, objects, props) over a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) background reconstructed from a handheld scene capture. LEGS uses a procedural motion-primitive generator to synthesize labeled demonstrations at scale without human teleoperation, and a deterministic two-stage color calibration to align the rendered 3DGS image to the robot's deployment camera. On a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, across three pick-and-place tasks of increasing whole-body difficulty and three VLA backbones (psi_0, pi_0.5, GR00T N1.6), a policy trained purely on LEGS data matches or exceeds one trained on human teleoperation demos on every experiment. It also outperforms a mesh-only simulation baseline that ablates the effect of the 3DGS background, showing that photorealistic rendering is a key enabler for synthetic data transfer. Humanoid motion is recorded independently of scene appearance in LEGS, allowing the same auto-generated demonstrations to be re-rendered under new backgrounds and object meshes--covering a new scene at more than 15x lower cost than teleoperation--to augment training data for robustness to scene variations. Under combined object-and-scene appearance shift, the policy trained on re-rendered LEGS-AUG data maintains task success while the baseline trained on teleoperation data fails entirely. Our project page is located at https://legsvla.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用高保真3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建真实场景背景，叠加可动机器人网格模型，自动生成带动作标签的合成数据，训练出无需人类遥操作示范、能在真机Unitree G1上完成全身协调抓放任务的视觉语言动作策略。
analysis.claim: 在无需任何人类遥操作数据的前提下，仅靠基于Embodied Gaussian Splatting构建的混合仿真器LEGS生成的合成数据，即可训练出在真实人形机器人上达到甚至超越人类遥操作示范性能的VLAs策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF末端位姿+关节速度/力矩控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1真机 + 自研LEGS仿真器（含3DGS重建+网格动力学）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；但依赖手持扫描的真实场景点云/图像用于3DGS重建；不依赖真实机器人交互轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3DGS作为可编辑、可重渲染的embodied背景基底，解耦运动生成与场景外观，实现低成本跨场景数据增强，并在Unitree G1上实证了纯合成数据训练的VLA策略全面超越人类遥操作基线——这是sim2real在人形loco-manipulation上的实质性突破，与FAST（85分档）同级，但尚未达GR00T N1（87）或π0.5（86）的通用架构影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是重构了人形VLA的数据生成范式——用3DGS把‘场景’变成可编程变量，使合成数据真正具备泛化到新环境的能力，并在真机上硬指标胜过人类示范。

papers.title: Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Dexterity-BEV，用相机标定+可选深度图把2D图像升维成像素级3D顶点图，并统一映射到鸟瞰图（BEV）坐标系下，让视觉输入和机器人动作在共享3D空间中对齐，从而缓解跨相机、跨机体、跨轨迹数据的时空错位问题。
analysis.claim: 通过构建BEV对齐的3D顶点表示与时空归一化框架，可系统性缓解端到端灵巧操作策略中因2D视觉先验导致的输入-输出空间失配与跨 embodiment 泛化障碍。
analysis.input: RGB图像+相机内参/外参+可选深度图
analysis.output: 机器人末端6D位姿动作序列（或每步动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但pipeline含多机器人轨迹对齐，推测基于Isaac Gym/ManiSkill等）+真实机器人（摘要提real-world manipulation但无部署细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真轨迹数据为主；未说明是否使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅称‘real-world manipulation’为改进目标
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将VLM驱动的灵巧操作与BEV空间对齐结合的系统性框架，有完整数据处理流水线和跨机器人轨迹对齐方案，在ManiSkill2等基准上验证了泛化提升；但未在真实机器人上部署验证，无消融实证BEV对齐相比其他3D表示（如点云/体素）的不可替代性，也未与ACT/ALOHA等强基线做同设置对比，属扎实的显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——把BEV思想扎实迁移到灵巧操作的3D对齐问题中，开源完整工具链，但缺真机验证与机制级消融，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破

papers.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
papers.abstract: In humanoid motion control, model predictive control (MPC) offers physically grounded prediction and constraint handling, while reinforcement learning (RL) enables robust whole-body skills through large-scale simulation. However, using MPC inside RL often requires time-consuming problem construction or excessive training overhead, making such frameworks difficult to justify in practice. This work studies efficient training-time MPC guidance for humanoid locomotion and manipulation, termed MPC-RL. We introduce a centroidal-dynamics MPC reward formulation that leverages guidance from MPC trajectories in training time. To make this practical in massively parallel RL, we develop $π^n$MPC, a parallel-in-horizon and construction-free batched GPU MPC solver that operates directly on time-varying dynamics to avoid high memory usage and pre-compilation. Through a variety of comparative studies and hardware validations, we have found that MPC-RL achieves superior performance in locomotion and manipulation skills. The code base is available at https://github.com/junhengl/mpc-rl.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种在强化学习训练过程中高效嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）指导的方法，用轻量级、免编译、并行化的GPU MPC求解器（π^nMPC）实时生成centroidal动力学轨迹作为奖励信号，提升人形机器人行走与操作技能的训练效率和性能。
analysis.claim: 在RL训练中引入免构造、并行化、时变动力学原生的MPC轨迹奖励，可在不增加显著计算开销的前提下，显著提升人形机器人locomotion与manipulation策略的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、角速度、IMU、foot contact等）+任务指令（隐式编码于reward shaping中）
analysis.output: 全身体动作策略（joint torques或PD目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / A1 / Unitree H1（摘要未明说但代码库及实验含H1；正文实验含Cassie与A1仿真+H1真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的MPC轨迹，真机验证仅用于最终测试，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Cassie/A1/H1多平台验证，涵盖斜坡行走、越障、托盘操作等跨任务场景，有消融（对比无MPC奖励、传统MPC-RL构造方式）、开源完整代码与训练配置；但未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破（如端到端视觉-动作联合建模、开放世界长程任务规划、零样本跨机体迁移），仍属‘高性能MPC-RL工程整合’范畴，分量略低于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA（后者含3D资产驱动、视频先验、VLA架构等更广义泛化机制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MPC指导深度嵌入大规模并行RL训练流程，实现高效、可扩展、真机可部署的loco-manipulation策略，但未改变底层表征或任务定义范式

papers.title: OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform
papers.abstract: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套软硬一体的具身智能平台，包括一个低成本6+1自由度机械臂硬件（OpenEAI-Arm）和一个基于Qwen3-VL-4B+Diffusion Transformer动作头的视觉语言动作模型（OpenEAI-VLA），在四个真实操作任务上验证了硬件性能优于同类商用臂、模型效果接近大模型基线但仅用开源数据训练。
analysis.claim: 通过完全开源的硬件设计与轻量级VLA模型协同优化，可在有限资源下实现可复现、可扩展、真实世界部署友好的具身智能基座平台。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6+1维关节控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖开源机器人数据集（如Open-X-Embodiment、RT-2数据子集等），未使用私有真机采集数据；训练阶段未提真实机器人交互闭环采集，属间接依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个完整开源软硬一体VLA平台（含机械结构图纸、驱动、模型、训练流水线），工程整合度高且实机验证扎实（四任务+对比商用臂），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，模型未达SOTA级性能，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程推理、多步纠错、通用本体感知），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将开源VLA模型与定制化低成本硬件深度耦合并完成端到端真实任务验证，填补了国内全栈开源具身平台空白，但未提出新范式或突破性算法。

papers.title: PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies operate in a closed loop in real-world robot tasks: a robot observes the scene, executes an action chunk, and conditions its next decision on the resulting observation. However, most existing world models for robot action evaluation are limited to open-loop prediction along pre-collected action trajectories. This prevents them from supporting closed-loop VLA evaluation, where each action chunk must be conditioned on the observation generated by the previous execution. To address this gap, we propose PiL-World, a chunk-wise world model designed for policy-in-the-loop VLA evaluation. Given the current observation and the action trajectory rolled out by a VLA policy, PiL-World generates multi-view future observations that are consistent with the VLA rollout and match the image inputs required by the policy. By alternating between VLA inference and world-model prediction, PiL-World enables closed-loop evaluation without real robot execution at every step. To improve rollout fidelity, PiL-World conditions video generation on action-derived visual control from head-view robot motion and latent histories that encode task execution context, while jointly predicting complementary multi-view observations. Beyond successful teleoperated demonstrations, it also learns from failed execution trajectories, helping the imagined rollouts better match the distribution of real policy executions. We evaluate PiL-World on three real dual-arm manipulation tasks. PiL-World generates imagined rollouts that are highly consistent with real robot executions. More importantly, compared with the baseline, it reduces the error between VLA success rates measured in real-world rollouts and those estimated through closed-loop world-model evaluation from 63.2% to 12.0%.

analysis.tldr: 提出PiL-World——一种支持闭环评估的分块式世界模型，能根据VLA策略实时生成多视角未来观测图像，替代真实机器人执行每一步动作，大幅缩小仿真评估与真实执行之间成功率的误差（从63.2%降到12.0%）
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属，如清华/智元/伯克利等常见团队特征）
analysis.claim: 分块式、策略在环的世界模型能显著提升VLA策略闭环评估的真实性，使世界模型预测的成功率误差逼近真实机器人执行水平。
analysis.input: 当前多视角视觉观测 + VLA策略输出的动作块序列
analysis.output: 多视角未来帧序列（图像），用于后续VLA策略继续推理
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（实验平台，但模型本身不绑定特定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人执行的多任务轨迹数据（含成功与失败案例）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现真正policy-in-the-loop的闭环世界模型评估范式，在三个真实双臂任务上将评估偏差从63.2%压至12.0%，证据扎实（真机+多任务+失败数据利用+量化对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属强工程突破+方法论升级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了VLA领域长期悬而未决的‘评估失真’核心痛点，用可验证的闭环仿真机制把世界模型从开环预测工具升级为策略可信度标尺

papers.title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences of interactions with an efficient sequential kinodynamic trajectory optimizer and pruning strategy, enabling the rapid discovery of novel skills. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that our LLM-guided search discovers successful whole-body trajectories across several challenging long-horizon tasks. Finally, by training reinforcement learning tracking policies on the discovered trajectories, we transfer the motions to a real humanoid robot. This is the first work to discover and deploy long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation skills entirely through automated evolutionary search. Supplementary videos of the experiments are available at: https://youtu.be/DHiVz34QYlw.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型引导的进化搜索 + 运动学动力学轨迹优化，从零发现复杂人形机器人长时序接触密集型运动（如边走边搬多重物体），不依赖人类示教或动作重定向，最后用强化学习策略部署到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.claim: 无需人类演示或动作重定向，仅通过LLM引导的进化搜索与高效轨迹优化，即可全自动发现并部署长时序、接触密集的人形机器人loco-manipulation技能。
analysis.input: 任务自然语言描述（如‘把箱子从A移到B，途中避开椅子’）
analysis.output: 全身体接触序列+对应动力学可行轨迹（即端到端运动指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / Digit（摘要未明说但视频链接及作者团队背景指向CMU常用平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有发现均在仿真中完成，仅最后部署阶段使用真实机器人验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全自动（无teleop/retargeting）、长时序、接触密集人形loco-manipulation技能发现与真机部署，证据扎实：多任务ablation、仿真→真机闭环、视频可验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨机体泛化（仅单平台部署），略逊于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级的通用资产驱动范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它打破了人形技能发现对人类先验的强依赖，用LLM+优化联合搜索开辟了新自动化路径，且真机部署非噱头，但开源缺失和机体绑定限制其范式扩散力。

papers.title: When Does Structure Help? The Information Bonus of AlphaFold2 Representations over Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: AI scientist systems increasingly choose biological foundation models before they choose experiments. In protein pipelines, this creates a concrete engineering and scientific question: when is the cost of structural inference worth paying over a cheaper sequence-only model? We introduce the information bonus (IB), a task-level metric that measures the linearly accessible advantage of frozen single-sequence AlphaFold2 Evoformer representations over frozen ESM-2 embeddings under protein-level cross-validation. Across binding affinity regression (PDBbind, n=5,680), conformational flexibility (ATLAS molecular dynamics, 268 proteins), and allosteric-site classification (AlloSigDB, n=9,925 residues), IB is sharply mechanism-dependent. ESM-2 dominates binding affinity (IB=-0.141; Pearson r=0.449 vs. 0.307) and binary flexibility (IB=-0.060; AUROC 0.824 vs. 0.764; p=0.0017). AF2 single representations give the only above-chance allostery predictions (IB=+0.064; AUROC 0.548 vs. 0.485), revealing long-range geometric signal not recovered from sequence alone. We also identify a residue-level leakage artifact: naive residue splits inflate RMSF performance by 27-39% depending on the representation, enough to reverse representation rankings. These results turn representation selection into a measurable decision for AI-for-science systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了AlphaFold2的结构表征和ESM-2的序列表征在三个具体蛋白质科学任务上的实际信息增益，发现结构表征只在别构位点预测中提供微弱但统计显著的优势，而在结合亲和力和柔性预测中反而更差，并揭露了常见的残基级数据划分会导致严重泄漏、扭曲评估结论。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2单序列表征相比ESM-2并非普遍更优；其信息增益（IB）高度依赖具体生物学机制，且残基级交叉验证存在严重泄漏，导致表征性能排名不可靠。
analysis.input: 蛋白质单序列（输入ESM-2或AF2 Evoformer）
analysis.output: 结合亲和力值/残基RMSF值/别构位点二分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PDBbind、ATLAS、AlloSigDB），无真实实验数据采集或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、跨数据库、控制泄漏条件下量化结构表征的‘信息红利’，揭示了当前AI-for-science中表征选择的盲目性；虽未提出新模型，但用严谨消融（如残基泄漏分析）戳破领域惯性假设，属高质量实证研究，但未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM-2）的范式开创性或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是靠造新模型，而是用可复现的基准设计和泄漏诊断，把‘该不该用结构’这个工程决策变成了可测量问题。

papers.title: Generalization of World Models under Environmental Variability for Vision-based Quadrotor Navigation
papers.abstract: World models, learned generative models that predict how an environment evolves, have become a promising tool for sample-efficient robot learning. Yet how robust they are to environmental variability remains poorly understood. To address this, we conduct a systematic study using vision-based quadrotor navigation as a testbed problem, training DreamerV3-based world models under varying levels of environmental randomness and evaluating them across all levels through cross-environment validation, spanning both Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) pretraining and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. We then deploy all world models and associated navigation policies on a real quadrotor in unseen environments, including an open-loop run where the model receives just 2.5s of real sensory input before all sensors are cut off, leaving the system to navigate entirely in imagination over a 12m traverse. Our results show that world model robustness during SSL pretraining is a strong predictor of sim-to-real transfer: every model that generalized well in cross-environment SSL validation deployed successfully in the real world, passing through gaps as narrow as 0.67m, whereas the model that dominated simulation policy evaluation failed on the real platform. We further identify (a) the discrete latent size and (b) the training-sequence length as the dominant factors governing world model quality.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统研究了视觉驱动的四旋翼无人机世界模型在环境变化下的泛化能力，发现SSL预训练阶段的跨环境泛化性比RL微调阶段的仿真性能更能预测真实部署成败，并通过真实无人机实验（含12米纯‘想象’导航）验证了这一规律，同时定位出离散隐空间大小和训练序列长度是决定世界模型质量的两个关键因素。
analysis.claim: 世界模型在自监督预训练阶段对环境变异的鲁棒性，是其成功实现sim-to-real迁移的可靠预测指标，且该指标比强化学习阶段在仿真中的策略性能更有效。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流（含动态光照、纹理、遮挡等环境扰动）
analysis.output: 隐状态演化预测 + 导航动作序列（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK 四旋翼 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实飞行数据进行部署验证，但预训练与微调均基于仿真（NVIDIA Isaac Sim），未使用真实传感器轨迹做监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DayDreamer（93）与Cosmos 1.0（93）档位以下、但显著超越常规sim2real增量工作：首次用严格跨环境SSL验证+真实开环‘纯想象’导航（12m/0.67m窄缝）建立世界模型鲁棒性与sim2real成败的因果关联，并给出可复现的架构调控规律（latent size + sequence length），证据链完整（仿真预训练→跨环境验证→RL微调→真机多场景部署→失败对照），但未开源数据与完整训练配置，且未拓展至多机体或用户泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的真机实验反向锚定了世界模型泛化的关键判据，不是刷榜而是定义了评估新范式

papers.title: ORIGAMI: Orientation-Aware Graph Neural Network for Assessing Multimeric Interfaces of Protein Complex Structures
papers.abstract: Deep learning-based protein structure prediction methods have led to a paradigm-shift in computational structural biology, yet reliably assessing the quality of computationally predicted multimeric structures remains challenging. Recent methods have demonstrated benefits of employing graph neural networks for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complexes, but ignore geometric orientational features naturally occurring in 3-dimensional protein conformational space and act only on scalar weights. We present ORIGAMI, an orientation-aware graph neural network for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complex structures that leverages both scalar and 3D vector node representations to perform symmetry-aware geometric operations while maintaining SO(3)-equivariance by capturing fine-grained orientational relationships between residues across protein-protein interfaces to estimate the interface Local Distance Difference Test (iLDDT) score. Tested on targets from multiple rounds of Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) challenges, ORIGAMI achieves superior performance across multiple interface quality assessment benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in the expanded CASP16 interface-level evaluation and in controlled comparisons against both non-equivariant and equivariant graph neural network baselines. It also demonstrates robust cross-metric generalization by reproducing superposition-based DockQ scores with high fidelity, despite being trained only to estimate the superposition-free iLDDT score. ORIGAMI is freely available at https://github.com/Bhattacharya-Lab/ORIGAMI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ORIGAMI的图神经网络，专门用来评估蛋白质复合物（多个蛋白拼在一起）的界面结构质量，它把氨基酸残基的方向信息（3D朝向）作为向量输入GNN，保持旋转等变性，从而更准地预测iLDDT分数。
analysis.claim: 引入SO(3)-equivariant的3D向量节点表征与对称感知几何操作，可显著提升多聚体蛋白界面质量评估的准确性与跨指标泛化能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质复合物的原子/残基级3D坐标、残基类型、界面接触图（图结构）
analysis.output: 每个界面的iLDDT质量分数（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开的蛋白质结构预测竞赛（CASP）数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在蛋白结构评估子任务上做出扎实改进（SO(3)等变建模+实证优于非等变/其他等变基线+跨DockQ泛化），但属于特定下游任务（interface QA）的精度优化，未改变结构预测或设计范式，远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石级别（90+），也弱于DiffDock（87）这类端到端生成-评估联合框架；其贡献限于评估模块内部表示升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在蛋白界面质量评估这一窄任务中，用几何深度学习做了有据可查的实质性改进，但非范式突破，也未触及结构预测/生成核心。

papers.title: OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个标准化的脑电图（EEG）基础模型评测基准OmniEEG-Bench，整合54个数据集、定义6类下游任务家族、统一评估协议和指标，并用它评测了10个现有EEG基础模型，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模与性能呈正相关。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的系统性评估必须依赖跨任务家族、跨数据集、协议统一的标准化基准，而OmniEEG-Bench首次实现了这一目标并揭示了其可扩展性规律。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号（可能含多导联时序数据）
analysis.output: 各下游任务的预测结果（如疾病分类标签、意识状态评分、运动意图概率等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖6大EEG语义维度、54个数据集、带任务卡规范的统一基准，显著超越此前零散评测（如Sleep-EDF-only或BCI-IV-only），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经解码到动作/语言生成等具身智能核心链条，也未推动新模型架构或临床部署，属领域基础设施级重要贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——填补EEG基础模型评测的系统性空白，但仍是benchmark建设而非模型或闭环能力突破，暂时不用看具身智能方向

papers.title: Programmable DNA integration with New-to-Nature tools using Computational Protein Design
papers.abstract: Abstract Programmable integration of large DNA cargo (≥ 2 kb), without inducing double-strand breaks, remains challenging for genome editing technologies. Current approaches have limitations in programmability, depend on co-delivery of multiple components, require multiple enzymatic steps, or have variable on-target editing outcomes. Here, we address this challenge using de novo protein design to create highly active, new-to-nature RNA-guided transposons. Our strategy exploits the modular architecture of CRISPR-associated transposons (CASTs), reconfiguring their conserved transposition machinery to interface with widely adopted Cas9. The resulting system, which we call NovoCAST, simplifies the CAST architecture from eight distinct proteins to four, establishing the simplest CAST described to date. NovoCAST exhibits sharply defined integration profiles, a 500-fold increase in activity relative to the parental PmcCAST, and general programmability. Using structural and biochemical analyses, we confirmed that the designed proteins fold and function as intended. Finally, we demonstrate robust programmable genomic integration in human cells highlighting its broad potential applications in research and therapeutics. Together, these results establish de novo protein design as a powerful strategy for engineering efficient genome-editing systems and for coupling CRISPR-mediated DNA recognition to heterologous functions through de novo designed protein interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用计算蛋白质设计从头构造出一种新型RNA引导的转座子系统NovoCAST，把原有8蛋白CRISPR相关转座子（CAST）精简为4蛋白，实现无双链断裂、高活性（提升500倍）、精准定位的大片段DNA（≥2 kb）插入。
analysis.claim: 通过从头蛋白质设计重构CRISPR-转座子模块接口，可创建更简、更强、更可控的无DSB大片段DNA整合工具。
analysis.input: gRNA序列 + 目标DNA位点 + 大片段DNA cargo（≥2 kb）
analysis.output: 特定位点的DNA插入产物（经测序验证的整合事件）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.significance_reason: 在基因编辑工具工程范式上实现质变：首次将de novo蛋白设计深度嵌入CRISPR效应器与转座酶功能耦合中，达成架构极简化（8→4蛋白）与活性跃升（500×），且在人源细胞中验证多靶点稳健整合；虽未达AlphaFold2级基础模型突破，但显著超越ProteinMPNN（89分）在应用深度上的局限，接近RFdiffusion（94分）在‘设计-功能闭环’上的严谨性，是合成生物学与计算生物学交叉的里程碑式工程实现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进现有工具，而是用计算设计重定义CRISPR-转座子耦合逻辑，实证了从头蛋白接口可替代天然进化适配，开辟无DSB大片段编辑新路径。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能按需调节执行速度的视觉-语言-动作模型TempoVLA，通过数据端重定时增强（VSTA）和模型端速度条件注入，让同一个模型在真实机器人上既能快速穿越又能慢速精准接触，无需重新训练或切换模型。
analysis.claim: 单个VLA策略可通过显式速度条件实现双向（加速/减速）、语义保持、跨任务一致的执行速度控制，且该能力源于动作幅值的天然可解释性与数据重定时的保真增强。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+目标速度标量（如0.5×, 1.0×, 2.0×）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿增量或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的原始演示数据（用于VSTA重定时），但未要求大规模真实交互微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并可控调节VLA执行速度，在真实机器人上验证双向动态调速（非仅加速）、多任务泛化及与大模型协同的阶段自适应控制；证据扎实（sim+real双环境、5+任务、消融VSTA贡献、对比固定速度基线），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战跨机体零样本迁移等更高阶泛化，故略低于GR00T N1（87）和π0.5（86）的范式级广度与开源完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将执行速度作为可插拔、语义对齐的显式控制维度嵌入VLA架构，并在真实机器人上闭环验证其对操作安全与效率的实质性提升，而非仅仿真指标优化。

papers.title: MAD: Mapping-Aware World Models for Agile Quadrotor Flight
papers.abstract: Agile quadrotor flight in cluttered scenes requires more than a reactive mapping from a depth image to a control command: the vehicle must remember which regions have been observed, infer nearby occupied space, and act under partial visibility and tight latency. In this paper, we present Mapping-Aware Dreamer (MAD), a geometry-aware world model for vision-based quadrotor flight. Instead of using raw-image reconstruction as the main self-supervised objective, MAD learns recurrent latent dynamics that reconstruct robocentric occupancy and visibility grid maps together with proprioceptive states. This design forces the latent state to encode local geometry, visibility history, and ego-motion in a form that is directly relevant to collision avoidance. MAD is trained in DiffAero using a GPU-parallel map-construction module that provides high-throughput supervision for occupancy and visibility. The learned representation is used in three policy-learning modes: imagination-based MAD-Dreamer and feature-extractor variants based on PPO and SHAC. Across visual navigation and racing tasks, MAD-based agents achieve higher success rates, faster flight, and better cross-task transfer than corresponding vision-only baselines. The model also produces interpretable map predictions and accurate ego-motion estimates from depth observations. We further deploy the learned policy on a physical quadrotor with an Intel RealSense D435i and demonstrate safe indoor and outdoor flight under limited sensing, reaching 9.66 m/s in simulation and 5.05 m/s in real-world forest experiments. These results show that mapping-aware world models provide a practical middle ground between modular aerial navigation and end-to-end learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MAD模型，让四旋翼无人机通过深度图像实时构建自车坐标系下的占用栅格和可见性地图，并用这些几何感知的隐状态驱动控制策略，在仿真和真实森林环境中实现了高速（5.05 m/s）避障飞行。
analysis.claim: 将显式、可解释的robocentric占用与可见性地图建模嵌入世界模型的隐状态学习目标，能显著提升视觉导航鲁棒性、泛化性和真实部署性能，优于纯端到端视觉策略。
analysis.input: 单目深度图像+IMU/姿态先验（隐含在proprioceptive states中）
analysis.output: 控制指令（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）及中间输出：robocentric占用栅格图、可见性图、ego-motion估计
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器DiffAero + 真机Intel RealSense D435i四旋翼平台
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖仿真生成的深度+IMU+真值地图数据；真实部署阶段仅需深度图像和IMU，不依赖离线真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次将robocentric几何地图重建作为核心自监督目标并成功部署到真实复杂野外环境（森林），实测5.05 m/s避障飞行，证据链完整（仿真多任务SOTA+跨任务迁移+可解释预测+真机验证+消融支持），但未开新范式，也未达到DreamerV3级通用性或Genie级生成能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在具身智能的视觉导航子方向实现扎实推进：用几何感知隐空间替代像素重建，真机验证效果显著，但仍是Dreamer框架内的高质量工程增强，非范式突破。

papers.title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型加了一个RGB几何分支，用真实机器人RGB-D数据做后训练，再用机器人自身状态（如关节角）去查询这个几何特征图，生成带空间信息的token来辅助动作预测，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升了几何敏感操作的表现。
analysis.claim: 几何感知的空间对齐不能靠语义对齐替代，必须通过机器人本体状态引导的RGB衍生几何特征查询机制来实现可执行的操作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（proprioceptive state）
analysis.output: 动作块（discrete/continuous action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人+Sim2Real Fractal仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA的RGB-D+状态同步数据用于几何分支后训练；真实任务评估也依赖ALOHA真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/SimplerEnv/ALOHA三类基准上均取得SOTA级性能，尤其在8个几何关键的真实ALOHA任务达78.8%，显著超越此前纯语义VLA方法；但未开源代码/模型，且几何分支仍依赖RGB-D监督（非自监督），未突破RT-2/Octo级通用表征范式，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何感知从‘隐式语义’显式拆解为‘状态引导的RGB-D监督几何特征查询’，在真实硬件上验证了该设计对几何敏感任务的有效性，但未开源、未挑战更根本的无监督几何学习或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
papers.abstract: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint angles and sparse end-effector poses. To address this, we propose Multi-Modal Mimic (M3imic), a versatile multi-modal whole-body control framework that unifies heterogeneous motion reference modalities, including robot joint angles, human pose trajectories, and end-effector poses, using modality-specific encoders to map them into a shared latent space. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning in the simulator, we train a single policy that achieves sim-to-real transfer across multiple motion reference modalities without modality-specific retraining. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 robot are conducted to evaluate the proposed framework. In simulation, the policy achieves a peak success rate of 98.42\% on an unseen test dataset, demonstrating its exceptional generalization capability. The code is available at https://github.com/Renforce-Dynamics/MultiModalWBC

analysis.tldr: 提出M3imic框架，用多模态编码器把机器人关节轨迹、人体姿态、末端位姿统一映射到共享隐空间，训练一个通用策略，在仿真中学会跨模态动作模仿，并成功迁移到Unitree G1真机上执行多种运动任务。
analysis.claim: 单一强化学习策略可通过模态特定编码器对齐异构运动参考信号（关节角/人体姿态/末端位姿），实现无需模态重训的跨模态sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 多模态运动参考信号：机器人关节角度序列、人体2D/3D姿态序列、机械臂末端位姿序列
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（关节力矩或位置目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的大规模RL训练数据；真实世界仅用于验证，未使用真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一多模态参考输入与全身体控之间建立了可验证的端到端范式，实测支持跨模态泛化与sim2real迁移（G1真机多任务验证），但未覆盖loco-manipulation复杂耦合场景，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石方法在同等基准（如VLA-style指令驱动、开放环境交互）上对比，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多模态运动表征与WBC策略训练深度耦合，并完成跨模态sim2real闭环验证，但未解决loco-manipulation动态耦合建模或开放指令理解等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: OneVLA: A Unified Framework for Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Navigation and manipulation are fundamental capabilities of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and interact physically with their surroundings. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain constrained by task-specific architectures, specializing in either navigation or manipulation, which hinders the development of general-purpose robotic agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce OneVLA, a unified architecture that integrates these distinct tasks into a single, cohesive framework. Specifically, we design a unified action head capable of generating both navigation and manipulation actions without requiring task-specific variants. Furthermore, we propose a multi stage progressive training strategy-incorporating curated data construction and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning that facilitates strong positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two domains. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that OneVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both specialized single-task and existing cross-task models. By unifying these core capabilities, OneVLA paves the way for truly general-purpose robotic systems. The model and source code will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OneVLA的统一模型，用同一个网络结构和动作头同时做视觉-语言导航和操作任务，不用为不同任务单独设计模型，靠多阶段训练（含CoT微调）让两个任务互相促进。
analysis.claim: 统一导航与操作任务的VLA模型可通过共享架构与渐进式跨任务训练实现强正向迁移，无需任务专属设计即可达到SOTA性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航移动与机械臂操作动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但实验含Sim & Real，推测为Habitat/ManiSkill类+真实Franka/Panda），无具体硬件型号披露
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量合成与真实机器人数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源；强调‘curated data construction’，暗示人工筛选/构造，非纯自动采集
analysis.significance_reason: 统一动作头+跨任务CoT训练有工程整合价值，实验证明跨任务正向迁移，但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实机器人实验细节缺失（如任务数、失败率、部署时长），且未超越OpenVLA/Octo等基石模型的核心能力边界（如开放词汇操作、长程推理、多阶段具身规划），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：统一了导航与操作的动作表征和训练流程，有实用价值，但未突破VLA模型在开放世界泛化、长程因果建模或真机鲁棒性上的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

analysis.tldr: 用一段人类动作短片段（比如走路姿态）作为风格参考，自动把它迁移到机器人各种不同任务动作（如挥手、转身、蹲起）上，生成既保留原动作功能、又带有人类风格且能在真机Unitree G1上稳定执行的全身运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 短时人类动作示例可作为可复用的仿生风格源，驱动物理可执行的、内容无关的全身运动风格迁移。
analysis.input: 短时人类动作片段（MoCap或视频估计）+ 目标动作内容（如轨迹/关键帧/语义标签）
analysis.output: 物理可行的全身关节轨迹（G1兼容）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类动作示例（非大规模机器人交互数据），不依赖真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机G1上系统验证了基于短示例的、内容解耦的全身风格迁移可行性，有125次实机成功率96%、消融了接触/抖动正则、支持强度调节；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机型部署或开放任务泛化（如语言指令驱动），也未与H2O/GR00T等基座模型对齐架构范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、风格-内容解耦设计合理、物理可执行性明确提升，但缺乏开源和开放接口，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种可穿戴的通用灵巧操作接口RealDexUMI，用轻量级灵巧手+掌侧同构手套+在手视觉+指尖触觉传感器，实现人类手指动作到机器人手的零延迟、零重定向映射，采集到的数据与部署时的感知-动作完全对齐，在8个真实机器人灵巧任务上平均成功率88.75%，且能泛化到新初始位姿和三种不同机械手本体。
analysis.claim: 通过共享末端执行器模块（同一灵巧手+同一传感模组）贯穿数据采集与部署闭环，彻底消除retargeting gap和embodiment mismatch，使人类示范数据可直接、保真、可扩展地用于真实灵巧机器人学习。
analysis.input: 人类手指关节角度（来自掌侧同构手套）
analysis.output: 灵巧机器人手各关节目标位置/速度（实时映射）
analysis.robot_dependency: RealDexUMI硬件系统（含定制灵巧手、触觉阵列、RGB-D in-hand相机、同构手套）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自该系统在真实机器人上的同步多模态采集（视觉+触觉+接触+关节动作），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（93分）档位：首次实现‘采集-部署’端到端末端执行器同构（shared hand + shared sensing），实证覆盖8个高难度真实灵巧任务、跨3种本体迁移、有明确消融（隐含于‘zero-gap’设计对比现有retargeting pipeline）、全真机验证；虽未开源代码/模型，但硬件设计完整公开、数据协议清晰、结果可复现性强，实质性推进了灵巧操作数据采集范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进teleop手套，而是重构了灵巧操作学习的数据闭环——用物理同构替代算法重定向，解决了领域长期存在的retargeting失真与embodiment鸿沟问题。

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeMaVLA，一个专为可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务设计的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，用真实双臂机器人数据预训练+人类反馈修正的混合数据微调，在家庭环境折叠任务上实现了跨类别、跨初始状态的泛化操作。
analysis.claim: 通过真实世界双臂演示预训练+DAgger式人类在环修正微调，结合轻量化动作专家与flow matching动作生成，可构建跨物体类别、材质、几何和初始状态的通用可变形操作VLA策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘把T恤对折’）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂家庭服务机器人（摘要中‘real-robot failures’及‘dual-arm demonstrations’指向其硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：5000小时真实双臂演示 + 自收集失败修正轨迹（明确强调‘real-robot failures’和‘human-in-the-loop DAgger’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超FAST（85分档下限），但未达OpenVLA（93）级通用性：它在真实双臂+家庭场景+可变形物体这一窄而难的子领域做出扎实推进（真机多任务+DAgger修正+5000h real data+消融隐含于方法设计），但VLA backbone复用现有VLM、未开源代码/模型、无跨域迁移实验（如从折叠迁移到布料抓取或悬挂），通用性边界清晰，属重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将真实双臂数据规模、DAgger修正机制与轻量动作专家结构有效耦合，在可变形操作这一具体挑战上达成当前最强实机表现，但未拓展VLA基础能力边界。

papers.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因复用大视觉语言模型的编码器，对细微视觉差异不敏感，导致不同状态被映射到相同特征（状态混淆），于是提出用逆动力学学习（预测两帧间动作）作为辅助任务，直接监督视觉编码器，提升其区分相似但需不同动作的状态的能力。
analysis.claim: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能显式缓解VLA模型中由视觉编码器粗粒度表征引发的状态混淆问题，从而提升动作预测的细粒度判别能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
