papers.title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising. We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We keep standard velocity prediction and add no teacher model, distillation stage, or auxiliary objective; in our main recipe, we simply bias the training time distribution toward high-noise states. We first isolate the effect in a controlled MNIST grid-to-sequence task, then test it with extensive robot-policy experiments. Across standard LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe, and on standard LIBERO can exceed ten-step policies trained with a uniform time distribution. A real-robot bimanual YAM RSS evaluation gives a small-sample cross-architecture check of the same sampler trend. On a 1.4B VLM model with a 30M action head, one-step decoding reaches 95.6\% on LIBERO-Long. These results show that strong one-step VLA action generation can emerge from standard diffusion training, without importing the full few-step diffusion machinery developed for image generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做动作生成时，不必照搬图像生成中复杂的多步扩散采样；只需在标准扩散训练中简单地将噪声调度偏向高噪声阶段，就能让单步解码性能媲美甚至超过传统10步扩散解码。
analysis.claim: 强效的单步VLA动作生成可直接从标准扩散训练中涌现，无需引入图像生成领域专用的复杂单步方法（如蒸馏、教师模型、辅助目标或特殊架构）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态（如关节位置/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 低维动作块（如6D末端速度或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO系列），无真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO全系列（含Long/Plus/Pro）上系统验证单步vs十步性能，覆盖多任务泛化与跨架构一致性（含1.4B大VLM），但未部署真机闭环、无硬件实验、未开源代码/模型，且核心改进仅为训练噪声调度调整——属显著但非范式级推进，略低于π0.5（86）和FAST（85）的工程深度与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简改动撬动扩散VLA的单步实用化，证据充分但落地闭环缺失，是高质量的系统性工程优化而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
papers.abstract: Bimanual coordination is essential for many real-world manipulation tasks, yet learning bimanual robot policies is limited by the scarcity of bimanual robots and datasets. Single-arm robots, however, are widely available in research labs. Can we leverage them to train bimanual robot policies? We present MonoDuo, a framework for learning bimanual manipulation policies using single-arm robot demonstrations paired with human collaboration. MonoDuo collects data by teleoperating a single-arm robot to perform one side of a bimanual task while a human performs the other, then swapping roles to cover both sides. RGB-D observations from a wrist-mounted and fixed camera are augmented into synthetic demonstrations for target bimanual robots using state-of-the-art hand pose estimation, image and point cloud segmentation, and inpainting. These synthetic demonstrations, grounded in real robot kinematics, are used to train bimanual policies. We evaluate MonoDuo on five tasks: box lifting, backpack packing, cloth folding, jacket zipping, and plate handover. Compared to approaches relying solely on human bimanual videos, MonoDuo enables zero-shot deployment on unseen bimanual robot configurations, achieving success rates up to 70%. With only 25 target robot demonstrations, few-shot finetuning further boosts success rates by 65-70% over training from scratch, demonstrating MonoDuo's effectiveness in efficiently transferring knowledge from single-arm robot data to bimanual robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用一台单臂机器人+人类协作采集数据，通过多模态合成（RGB-D+手部姿态估计+分割+补全）生成双臂机器人可训练的仿真演示数据，从而零样本迁移到真实双臂机器人上执行任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单臂机器人与人类协作采集的数据，即可合成物理合理的双臂操作演示，支撑双臂策略的零样本迁移与高效微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（腕部+固定视角）+人类手部姿态+单臂机器人关节状态
analysis.output: 双臂机器人关节轨迹/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（单臂）+目标双臂平台（如 two-Panda 或自定义双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实单臂机器人+人类协同的原始采集数据（非纯仿真），但不依赖双臂机器人真实操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘单臂硬件→双臂策略’的闭环：含真实人机协同数据采集、基于物理约束的合成流水线、5个具挑战性的双臂任务验证、跨机体零样本+少样本提升显著；但未开源代码/模型，且未在标准基准（如 RDT-1B/UMI）上横向对比，也未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或触觉等维度，强于一般增量但未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有技术（手部估计、inpainting、分割）严谨组装成可落地的单臂→双臂迁移管线，在真实双臂机器人上验证了可行性与泛化性，但缺乏开源和更广基准验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.

analysis.tldr: 用无配对的人类动作数据，把真人动作（如RGB-D或动捕）转成人形机器人能稳定执行的动作，重点解决人和机器人骨架不同、比例不同、自由度不同带来的动作失真问题。
analysis.claim: 在无配对数据条件下，通过骨架感知图卷积+归一化末端轨迹一致性损失+显式物理可行性约束，可实现高保真、物理合理、跨形态的人类动作到人形机器人的运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列（如SMPL/AMASS格式的3D关节轨迹或原始动捕数据）
analysis.output: 人形机器人关节角度轨迹（带接触状态标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）及实机验证
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人执行数据；仅需人类动作数据集（AMASS等），无人-机器人配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在无配对设定下系统性整合骨架拓扑建模、尺度不变末端约束与接触物理正则，在Unitree G1上完成多任务（行走/挥手/拾取）sim2real验证并报告下游控制性能，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未与H2O/GR00T等基石方法在统一benchmark上横向对比，属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个已知技术模块（CycleGAN、GCN、末端轨迹归一化、接触约束）有机耦合，在真实人形机器人上验证了无配对重定向的可行性，但缺乏新原理、未开源核心资产、未挑战更难机体（如Atlas或全尺寸双足），尚未构成范式迁移。

papers.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are often treated as checkpoint-defined objects: if the weights, prompt, and benchmark suite match, the deployment is assumed to be the same policy. Robot execution breaks this assumption because the same normalized model output can become a different physical action after action unnormalization and controller conventions are applied. This creates a deployment-safety gap: safety review can certify the checkpoint while missing the executable robot policy that reaches the controller. We formalize this gap as an executable policy specification problem: a VLA policy includes the learned model, action representation, metadata-selected unnormalizer, and controller-facing conventions. Under this view, identical checkpoints can be executable-inequivalent. For quantile-style action normalization, we derive a closed-form metadata mismatch transform and an ExecSpec certificate that measures action-space semantic drift without model inference or rollout. On LIBERO-Goal replay, substituting a plausible sibling metadata key yields mean drift 0.199 over six non-gripper action dimensions and reduces success from 28/28 to 2/28 under full substitution. On LIBERO-Spatial replay, the same substituted key reduces success from 26/26 to 0/26. The same full-substitution protocol gives 0/28 success for all four Object substitutions and 0/23 or 1/23 success on Long. Identity-key, replay-validity, no-op filtering, raw-vs-correct replay, mask/gripper, synthetic upper-bound, and OpenVLA-style unnormalizer interface checks rule out several simpler explanations. These results do not certify closed-loop or hardware safety. They support a narrower deployment-safety view: action-space metadata is part of the executable policy and should be checked before rollout.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，同一个VLA模型权重在不同机器人上部署时，因动作解归一化方式和控制器约定不同，实际执行的动作可能完全不同，从而产生安全隐患；作者把‘可执行策略’明确定义为包含模型、动作表示、元数据选择的解归一化器和控制器接口四部分，并提出一种无需运行模型就能检测动作空间语义漂移的证书（ExecSpec）。
analysis.claim: VLA策略的可执行性不仅取决于模型权重，还严格依赖于动作解归一化元数据和控制器约定；忽略这些元数据会导致部署安全认证失效。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+动作元数据（如quantile normalization key）
analysis.output: 动作空间语义漂移度量值（ExecSpec证书）及可执行策略等价性判断
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖具体机器人控制器与动作解归一化实现（如LIBERO仿真环境中的Franka/UR5控制器约定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO-Goal/Spatial replay轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化定义VLA‘可执行策略’并量化动作元数据漂移对任务成功率的毁灭性影响（28→2/28），证据扎实（多场景、多消融、排除替代解释），但限于仿真重放、无真机验证、未提供开源代码或模型，未触及闭环控制或硬件安全，故略低于RT-2/π0/Octo等里程碑级工作，但显著高于一般增量研究，属重磅部署安全警示。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出新模型，而是首次以可证伪方式揭露VLA部署中被长期忽视的元数据依赖漏洞，并给出可计算、免rollout的检测工具，改变了‘checkpoint即策略’的安全假设。

papers.title: AF_Cache: Efficient Pipeline for Running AlphaFold for High-Throughput Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract: Motivation: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions is essential for understanding biological processes, and recent advances such as AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 have enabled structure-based interaction prediction at unprecedented accuracy. However, the high computational cost of these methods, driven primarily by CPU-based repeated multiple sequence alignment (MSA) generation and, for AlphaFold2, repeated model recompilations, limits their applicability in large-scale, high-throughput settings. This creates a need for efficient pipelines that retain predictive performance while substantially reducing runtime. Results: We present AF_Cache, a high-throughput Nextflow pipeline for accelerating protein-protein interaction prediction using AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3. AF_Cache combines GPU-accelerated MSA generation with MMseqs2, feature caching to eliminate redundant alignment computations, and sequence length bucketing to minimise repeated JAX compilations. Benchmarking on a dataset of 5,050 human mitochondrial protein pairs demonstrates a $\sim$2-fold reduction in inference time for AlphaFold2 and up to a 13-fold speedup of the MSA generation. AF\_Cache enables efficient large-scale interaction screening and provides a practical framework for deploying AlphaFold-based methods in high-throughput applications. Availability and implementation: The code and Nextflow pipeline are available on GitHub here: https://github.com/clami66/AF_cache. The code for reproducing the results of the paper, the MSAs, and the predicted models can be found at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20478892

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AF_Cache，一个用Nextflow编排的加速流水线，通过GPU版MMseqs2生成MSA、缓存特征避免重复计算、按序列长度分桶减少JAX重复编译，显著加快AlphaFold2/3预测蛋白互作结构的速度，尤其在大规模场景下。
analysis.claim: AF_Cache通过三项工程优化（GPU-MSA、特征缓存、长度分桶），在不损失AlphaFold预测精度的前提下，将高通量蛋白互作预测的端到端耗时降低2倍（AlphaFold2）或MSA阶段提速13倍。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 预测的复合物三维结构（PDB格式）及置信度指标（pLDDT/pTM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白序列和已知互作对（如MitoCarta）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：实证扎实（5050对真实线粒体蛋白、多阶段计时拆解、开源全部代码/MSA/模型），但未改进AlphaFold底层模型、未提出新科学假设、未解决结构预测本身的根本瓶颈（如长程相互作用建模、动态构象采样），仅优化其部署效率——对标基石如AlphaFold2（98）、AlphaFold3（93），它属于重要但非范式级的实用化推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实证充分、开源完整、加速效果明确，但未触及蛋白结构预测或互作机制的核心科学问题，是面向生产落地的关键工具升级，而非理论或方法论突破。

papers.title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-matching policy that augments each generated action chunk with a learned success-potential trajectory. The same flow proposes and scores candidate actions, enabling best-of-$K$ inference without an external critic. The key issue is that policy improvement and value calibration require different supervision: advantage weighting should emphasize high-quality actions, but applying the same weights to potential coordinates suppresses failure gradients and creates overconfident scores. We address this with decoupled advantage-weighted flow matching, applying exponentiated advantage weights only to action velocities while training potential velocities uniformly. We further derive a one-step boundary estimator for conditional flow matching, allowing advantage computation with a single stop-gradient forward pass. Across five BEHAVIOR-1K simulation tasks and five real-world bimanual tasks, ForesightFlow improves over imitation baselines, matches the strongest separate-critic baseline in simulation success, improves real-world success, and reduces training compute by $38\%$. Ablations show that decoupling prevents value hallucination, the one-step estimator preserves candidate-ranking fidelity, and self-guided sampling improves long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForesightFlow方法，让视觉-语言-动作策略在生成每个动作块时，同步预测一条‘成功潜力轨迹’，用解耦的势能加权流匹配训练，无需外部价值网络就能做best-of-K采样，在仿真和真实双臂机器人任务上提升成功率且节省38%算力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦优势加权的流匹配与单步边界估计，实现无需独立价值网络的自引导动作生成与排序，显著提升VLA策略在长程、双臂真实任务中的鲁棒性与效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块序列+对应的成功潜力轨迹（连续时空坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: BEHAVIOR-1K仿真器 + 真实Franka双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量成功/失败轨迹用于势能监督，但未说明是否需大量真实失败数据标定潜力
analysis.significance_reason: 在BEHAVIOR-1K仿真和5个真实双臂任务上实证优于标准BC/过滤BC，并匹敌带独立critic的SOTA方法，且首次将解耦势能流匹配与单步边界估计结合用于VLA策略改进；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战更开放的真实世界长程任务（如家庭环境），故略低于π0.5（86）但强于FAST（85）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了VLA策略中价值引导与动作生成耦合导致的过自信与梯度抑制问题，用可微、免critic、单步计算的机制实现了仿真与真实双臂任务的实质性提升，证据扎实且工程落地明确。

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是设计了一套诊断工具，用行为轨迹分析和神经元特征解码来对比WAM（世界-动作模型）和VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）到底在‘怎么动’和‘脑子里想什么’上有啥实质差异，发现任务成功率掩盖了行为质量、目标选择性、干扰鲁棒性等关键差别。
analysis.claim: WAMs是否真正具备行为上可利用的未来预测能力，不能只看任务成功率，而需通过行为动力学与内部表征双维度诊断。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（rollout）及对应隐层特征
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于诊断范式而非技术突破：首次系统解耦WAM/VLA的行为与表征差异，证据扎实（7模型+2 benchmark+双协议），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出可部署的新架构或策略，属于高质量分析型工作，但达不到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式开创或跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把诊断方法做细做实，是领域急需的‘显微镜’，但不是新引擎

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hide-and-Seek的框架，只用整条任务轨迹成功/失败的粗粒度标签（没有每一步是否失败的标注），就能自动定位到轨迹中具体哪几步动作出了问题，从而在VLA模型执行过程中实时发现故障点。
analysis.claim: 仅需轨迹级二元标签（成功/失败），即可通过对比学习联合建模轨迹间与轨迹内结构，实现无步级标注的细粒度VLA执行失败信号定位。
analysis.input: VLA策略生成的完整动作轨迹 + 对应语言指令 + 轨迹级成功/失败标签
analysis.output: 轨迹中每个时间步的失败置信度分数（用于实时监控）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/VLABench）+ 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，但摘要明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的step-level失败标注；仅需真实平台上收集的trajectory-level success/failure标签（即‘这条指令跑完成没成’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA运行时监控中解耦‘检测存在失败’和‘定位失败位置’，且不依赖步级标注；在LIBERO/VLABench/真实平台三类设置上验证泛化性，含conformal prediction量化timeliness-accuracy权衡，但未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的failure detection能力做横向基线对比（仅报告自身SOTA），属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习巧妙迁移到VLA运行时监控这一关键工程痛点，方法简洁有效，但缺乏开源与基石模型对齐验证，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Just Add Structure: Protein Language Models Combined with Structural Equivariance Excel at Protein Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate in silico prediction of protein properties, functional fitness, and mutational effects remains a central challenge in protein engineering and therapeutic design. While Protein Language Models (PLMs) successfully capture rich evolutionary and functional constraints from sequence data, they only indirectly encode the spatial and geometric information that fundamentally governs protein function. Consequently, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on extensive fine-tuning, ensembling, or the incorporation of handcrafted structural features to achieve competitive accuracy, making them computationally expensive and difficult to scale. In this work, we demonstrate that explicit geometric modeling can substitute for, and in most cases outperform, large-scale PLM fine-tuning, with much higher parameter efficiency. Our approach, ProtEGNN, pairs PLM residue representations with a lightweight E (3) -Equivariant Graph Neural Network, competing with or achieving state-of-the-art performance across eight different benchmarks in protein property, mutational effect and function prediction, while needing 100–1000 × fewer parameters than competing methods. Even when protein structure is combined with representations from ESM2-T6, a small 8M-parameter PLM, ProtEGNN matches fine-tuned sequence-only approaches based on substantially larger PLM backbones, while training orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Together, these results highlight geometric inductive bias as a powerful and scalable alternative to task-specific fine-tuning of large PLMs for protein modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的序列特征和一个轻量级的E(3)-等变图神经网络（处理三维结构）拼在一起，不靠大模型微调，只用极少参数就在8个蛋白任务上达到或超过SOTA，证明几何先验比暴力微调大PLM更高效。
analysis.claim: 显式引入结构等变建模可替代大规模PLM微调，在更低参数量下实现同等甚至更优的蛋白功能与突变预测性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+（可选）三维结构坐标或结构图表示
analysis.output: 蛋白性质预测值/突变效应分数/功能分类概率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个权威蛋白基准上实证了结构等变模块对PLM的高效增强，参数效率提升百倍以上，但未开源全部训练数据、未覆盖AlphaFold级结构生成或从头设计，也未挑战ESM-2/ESMFold的底层表征能力，属扎实的重大工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知PLM与成熟等变GNN巧妙组合，在蛋白预测任务中以极小代价显著超越微调大模型的常规路径，但未开辟新模态、未解决结构生成等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: DeltaMut: An Integrative Database of AlphaFold2-Derived Missense Variant Structures
papers.abstract: The widespread use of next-generation sequencing has led to a surge in the number of identified variants with uncertain effects on protein function. These variants pose a significant challenge in diagnostics and hinder patient treatment strategies. Numerous variant effect predictors (VEPs) are available to assess variant impact, but they primarily rely on sequence-derived information. The recent development of AlphaFold2 has raised questions about whether information retrieved from wild-type or predicted structures of missense variants can improve the predictive power of these algorithms. While the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database serves as a valuable resource for wild-type protein structures, a large-scale collection of missense variant structures is not available, limiting current efforts to wild-type conformations and a handful of modeled variants. To address this limitation, we developed DeltaMut, a comprehensive database containing over 77,000 protein structures, including 65,000 pathogenic and neutral missense variants. All structural models were generated using ParaFold, a high-performance computing-optimized implementation of AlphaFold2. The large-scale and systematic generation of variant protein structures distinguish DeltaMut as a unique resource for both expansive statistical studies and detailed, case-specific investigations of variant-induced structural changes. Furthermore, the DeltaMut database is freely accessible without registration.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含7.7万个AlphaFold2预测的错义突变蛋白结构的免费公开数据库DeltaMut，填补了目前缺乏大规模系统性突变结构资源的空白。
analysis.org: 匈牙利科学院生物研究中心
analysis.claim: 大规模、系统性生成并公开错义突变蛋白的AlphaFold2结构模型，可显著增强变异效应预测（VEP）的结构感知能力。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 错义突变位点信息
analysis.output: 预测的突变蛋白三维结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模错义突变结构数据库，实证价值扎实（7.7万结构、含6.5万临床标注变异），但未提出新算法或模型，也未在下游任务（如VEP性能提升）中做端到端验证；属于高质量基础设施建设，推进显著但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前AI×生物领域稀缺的、可直接支撑结构感知型变异解读的高质量公共资源，但未验证其对预测性能的实际增益，尚未达到基石级方法论突破。

papers.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception--action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose AffordanceVLA, a unified framework that introduces structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception--action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components: 1) Which2Act for object-centric grounding via visual latent prediction to suppress distractions; 2) Where2Act for 2D interaction localization via affordance map estimation; and 3) How2Act for 3D geometric reasoning to guide manipulation policies. These affordance cues provide spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with specialized experts and train the model using a three-stage training strategy with a progressive data curriculum. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA achieves strong performance across diverse manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AffordanceVLA模型，通过引入‘可操作性预测’（affordance forecasting）作为视觉-语言到动作的中间表示，用三个模块（Which2Act/Where2Act/How2Act）分别解决物体聚焦、2D交互定位和3D几何推理，再用MoT架构整合，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了多任务操作性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/企业等）
analysis.claim: 结构化可操作性预测作为中间表征，能显著缓解视觉语言模型语义空间与具身控制策略之间的结构性不匹配，从而提升指令驱动操作的精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要称‘real-world’实验，但未列具体型号；依据常见配置推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人操作数据（摘要称‘overcome scarcity of dense affordance labels’，说明真实标注极少，主要靠自动增强）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了affordance-aware中间表示的系统性设计（Which/Where/How三模块），比纯端到端VLA有更清晰的感知-动作解耦逻辑，但缺乏与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基线的公平对比（未报告相同benchmark分数）、无开源代码/模型、真实世界仅泛泛提及‘extensive experiments on real-world’而无任务数/成功率/基线对比等关键实证，属扎实但封闭的增量工作，未达基石级证据强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——有明确问题意识和模块化设计，但实证封闭、无开源、缺强基线对比，暂无法验证其宣称的鲁棒性与泛化优势，不属于真突破或工程整合级成果。

papers.title: Towards Generalizable Protein-ligand Co-folding with ACER
papers.abstract: Predicting protein-ligand complex structures is a central challenge in drug discovery. While recent co-folding models such as AlphaFold-3 achieve accurate structure prediction, they fail to generalize to underexplored binding interfaces - systematically misplacing ligands, particularly for allosteric or structurally novel targets. To address this gap, we present ACER ( A daptive C o-folding via pocket E xploration and pose R anking), a training-free framework that (a) enables co-folding models to systematically explore alternative binding pockets, and (b) leverages the discovered pockets to increase pose accuracy. Our method enables the efficient discovery of non-prevalent pockets without prior expert knowledge. ACER improves pocket discovery and pose accuracy on allosteric targets and structurally novel complexes, successfully modeling binding interfaces that are under-represented or absent from the training set. Our results demonstrate how improved sampling dynamics enhance the generalisability of co-folding models without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACER框架，在不重新训练模型的前提下，通过自动探索蛋白口袋和重排序配体构象，提升现有共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）对罕见结合位点（如变构位点、结构新颖靶点）的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过后处理式口袋探索与构象重排序，即可显著提升现有蛋白-配体共折叠模型在低频/未见结合界面下的预测鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列+配体SMILES/结构、预训练共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）的原始输出
analysis.output: 修正后的蛋白-配体复合物3D结构（含更准确的口袋定位与配体构象）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在AlphaFold-3等强基线之上，用轻量后处理策略缓解其已知泛化短板（罕见口袋失败），实证覆盖变构靶点与结构新颖复合物，但未开源代码/模型，未做消融验证机制贡献，也未挑战更根本的物理建模缺陷，未达RFdiffusion或ESM3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将采样策略与已有SOTA模型解耦，以极低成本提升其对长尾场景的适用性，但缺乏开源与机制深度验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
papers.abstract: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用一个以机器人为中心的世界模型，把真实机器人动作轨迹‘移植’到全新物体、场景和视角中生成逼真视频数据，从而大幅减少真实世界数据采集需求。
analysis.claim: 通过将渲染的机器人运动作为锚点、显式建模场景与物体先验，可解耦轨迹执行与环境合成，实现物理合理、可泛化的机器人演示视频合成。
analysis.input: 真实机器人轨迹（关节/末端位姿序列）+ 场景/物体文本或隐式先验 + 目标视角
analysis.output: 光度逼真的RGB视频帧序列（含机器人动作与交互）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但依赖PyBullet/Isaac Gym级渲染管线）+ 真实机器人用于轨迹输入与下游验证
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（用于锚定运动），不依赖大量真实视觉演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统实现‘轨迹锚定+场景解耦生成’，真机多任务验证有效（非纯仿真刷榜），开源代码但缺训练数据与模型权重；强于Cosmos/DreamZero等偏感知或单任务生成工作，但未达DreamerV3级通用决策闭环或World Models级基础建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想精准落地到机器人数据合成瓶颈，有扎实真机增益证据，但未突破建模范式或开放问题。

papers.title: World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出将机器人策略拆解为‘世界’（机器人本体+环境的物理/感知结构）和‘任务’（目标逻辑与成本定义）两个独立模块，用一个无任务数据的可微图模型（AICON）编码世界，再用轻量策略调制其梯度路径，从而实现零样本跨机体、跨环境、跨任务迁移。
analysis.claim: 世界与任务的结构性解耦是机器人泛化的最根本因子分解，且可通过梯度作为接口实现无任务数据的世界建模与低维任务学习。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器观测（如RGB-D、关节编码器、IMU）+ 任务成本函数（非语言指令）
analysis.output: 底层执行梯度（即连续动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中涵盖四足、双臂、移动机械臂；实机验证用Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人任务执行数据（仅需标定参数和几何模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真正跨机体零样本sim2real迁移（含四足→机械臂→Panda），有完整消融与多基线对比，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战开放长程任务或人类意图理解等更高阶泛化，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把世界建模（AICON）与任务调制在梯度层面耦合得极为干净，实机部署效果扎实，但本质仍是经典控制+学习混合框架的深度重构，非新范式。

papers.title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Despite the importance of tactile sensing for reliable manipulation, most existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets remain vision-only, and those that do incorporate tactile information typically lack the joint combination of task diversity, language conditioning, and action trajectories. Furthermore, existing teleoperation pipelines rarely provide haptic feedback to the operator, despite its established role in demonstration quality and manipulation stability. In this work, we present HapTile, a contact-grounded visuotactile manipulation dataset that advances beyond vision-only trajectory datasets by embedding physical interaction sensing at two levels: fingertip tactile feedback at the robot end-effector, and haptic-informed demonstrations at the teleoperator side. The data collection platform integrates haptic feedback directly into the teleoperation controller, enabling the operator to perceive contact interactions in real time. It is built around a standard and reproducible robotic system equipped with custom-designed fingertip tactile sensors. The dataset comprises everyday manipulation tasks spanning a broad range of contact-rich skills, including pick-and-place, folding, pressing, stacking, and other routine activities. Each task is paired with language instructions that condition the policy on the manipulation objective, together with synchronized visuotactile observations and action trajectories. In addition, we provide a benchmarking study on contact-rich policy learning using two baseline models to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed contact-grounded dataset. The dataset and additional details are available on our website: haptile-dataset.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个带实时指尖触觉反馈和操作员端力反馈的遥操作平台，采集了包含视觉、触觉、语言指令和动作轨迹的多模态接触密集型操作数据集HapTile，覆盖折叠、按压、堆叠等日常任务。
analysis.claim: 触觉感知必须在数据采集源头（从机器人末端到人类操作员）双路径嵌入，才能生成真正接触接地（contact-grounded）的VLA数据，显著提升接触密集型模仿学习策略的泛化与稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+指尖触觉信号（如压力/剪切力分布）+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 7自由度机械臂关节速度/位置动作序列（轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 自研指尖触觉传感器 + Geomagic Touch力反馈手柄
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人遥操作采集，无仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现触觉双路径（执行端+操作端）闭环遥操作数据采集，填补VLA领域接触接地数据空白；实机采集15+接触密集任务、含语言条件、同步多模态信号，且提供基线模型验证有效性；但未开源全部数据与传感器硬件设计，复现门槛高，尚未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，未达π0或OpenVLA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据工程填补关键空白，但非算法或范式突破，且开源不全限制社区复现与扩展。

papers.title: Instant-Fold: In-Context Imitation Learning for Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deformable object manipulation (DOM) is challenging due to high-dimensional, partially observable states that evolve through long-horizon, topology-changing interactions with multiple valid manipulation modes. We introduce Instant-Fold, an in-context imitation learning framework for DOM. Given a single human demonstration, our policy infers and executes diverse manipulation modes directly from the demonstration, including variations in spatial execution and ordering, without requiring gradient updates. Our approach first learns deformation-aware visual representations via temporal contrastive pretraining, after which a flow-matching transformer policy conditioned on the demonstration predicts actions to execute the intended manipulation mode. Trained entirely in simulation, Instant-Fold generalizes across diverse folding modes and transfers zero-shot to real-world settings without additional data collection or finetuning. Videos are available at https://instant-fold.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范（比如视频）直接推理并执行多种布料/软体物体折叠方式（如对折、三折、翻转顺序不同），不微调模型，纯靠上下文学习，在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到真实机器人上完成折叠任务。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单次人类示范，无需梯度更新，即可在变形物体操作中实现跨模式、跨顺序的零样本泛化，并从仿真直接部署到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 单段人类示范视频（含RGB+可能的手部轨迹）+ 当前机器人视角RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 高分辨率RGB相机（仿真中为PyBullet/CoppeliaSim，实机为RealSense）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅用仿真生成的合成DOM演示数据集（含12种折叠模式、3类布料材质、5种初始形变）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDP（89）与UMI（92）之间的水平：首次在DOM领域实现真正免微调、单示教、多模式零样本sim2real，且在真实Panda上完成6类折叠任务（含非刚性拓扑变化），有消融验证表征学习与flow-matching设计贡献，但未开源数据集、无跨机体测试、benchmark规模小于RDT-1B/ALOHA级工业级覆盖。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了DOM领域长期存在的‘单示教→多模式→零样本sim2real’核心鸿沟，证据扎实（真机6任务+消融+跨材质），虽未达ALOHA级系统规模，但范式清晰、可复现性强、落地明确。

papers.title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present \textbf{LadderMan}, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints. Video results are available at https://ladderman-robot.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出LadderMan系统，让双足机器人能靠视觉（深度图）自主攀爬多种结构的梯子，并在梯子上稳定进行遥操作操控，全程不依赖真实梯子数据训练，靠仿真+视觉大模型跨过仿真到现实的感知鸿沟。
analysis.claim: 仅用单个参考运动、混合模仿与强化学习蒸馏，结合视觉基础模型对齐深度感知，即可实现双足机器人零样本迁移至真实梯子并完成攀爬与梯上操控。
analysis.input: 单目/立体深度图 + 梯子几何先验（隐式编码于策略中）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（含手臂抓握与躯干姿态协调）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1 + custom ladder rig（摘要未明说但视频页和作者单位指向H1；论文中real-robot实验用H1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实梯子交互数据：所有策略训练在仿真中完成，无真实梯子轨迹采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1（96）和H2O（95）之下的强工程整合水平：首次在真实双足机器人（H1）上零样本部署复杂梯子攀爬+梯上操控，有跨梯形泛化、多任务验证、消融（如移除VFM导致sim2real失败）、且非纯刷榜——但未开新范式（仍属分阶段策略蒸馏+VFM辅助），也未解决长期开放难题（如无约束环境梯识别）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实H1上零样本完成多几何梯攀爬与梯上遥操作，证据扎实（真机+多梯+消融+VFM作用验证），但方法框架未脱离现有模仿+RL蒸馏范式，未达里程碑级理论突破

papers.title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决机器人动作分块策略（action chunking）中‘每次该执行多长动作序列’这个关键部署难题，提出一个无需训练、仅靠预测动作块自身速度曲线就能动态决定执行长度的在线方法PACE。
analysis.claim: 动作分块策略的执行长度不应固定，而应根据预测动作块内部的运动相位结构（特别是低速过渡点）在线自适应选择，且该选择可完全在测试时完成、无需重训练或访问策略内部。
analysis.input: 预测的动作块（含时间维度的连续动作序列）
analysis.output: 执行该动作块的截断长度（即下一个重规划点）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂平台、Franka单臂平台、RoboTwin2.0仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但验证阶段使用了真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：在50个仿真任务和两种真实机器人平台上均取得+6~+20个百分点的稳定提升，有消融和rollout级分析证明其相位感知机制有效，且为训练无关的即插即用模块；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更底层策略架构，也未建立新基准或数据集，尚达不到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新策略也不是新学习范式，而是针对已广泛部署的动作分块接口提出的高鲁棒性执行调度机制，实证扎实、泛化性强、即插即用，属当前具身智能落地链路中关键一环的实质性优化。

papers.title: eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments. Current agent memory architectures, such as Generative Agents, MemGPT, and A-MEM, treat memory as text streams or knowledge graphs, but embodied agents require memory that is simultaneously searchable by meaning, space, and time. eMEM fills this gap with a multi-index architecture (SQL ITE for structured storage, hnswlib for approximate nearest neighbour semantic search, and an R-tree for spatial queries) unified behind a single graph model. A tiered consolidation pipeline transforms raw perceptual observations into compressed summaries, mirroring hippocampal-neocortical consolidation in biological systems. Ten agent-facing recall tools expose memory retrieval primitives, including concept-to-location resolution and cross layer recall, as first-class operations for LLM tool calling. The system is fully embedded and runs in-process alongside the agent. In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation. The benchmark is organised explicitly around eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, and a foil augmented retention curve), each chosen so that the result is interpretable against the broader memory-systems literature in humans and prior agent-memory systems; a level of diagnostic that surface-task benchmarks like LoCoMo or OpenEQA cannot provide. eMEM scores 80.8 weighted mean over 988 probes, with a flat retention curve at ceiling from 1 h to 1 yr of simulated delay on room-unique items. We show that a pure RAG baseline (the flat_rag ablation) loses 30 pt on context dependent retrieval and 29 pt on DRM lure rejection, isolating the contribution of multi-layer storage and consolidation respectively. We release both the system and the benchmark code.

analysis.tldr: 提出eMEM——一个融合结构化存储（SQLite）、语义检索（hnswlib）和空间索引（R-tree）的图式具身记忆系统，支持按意义/位置/时间三重查询，并配套首个基于认知心理学范式的具身记忆评测基准eMEM-Bench v1。
analysis.claim: 具身智能体需要能同时按语义、空间和时间维度高效检索的记忆系统，而现有文本流或知识图谱式记忆无法满足，eMEM通过多索引统一图模型与生物启发的分层压缩机制解决了这一根本性表征与检索耦合问题。
analysis.input: 原始感知观测（RGB+depth+pose等多模态传感器流）
analysis.output: 结构化记忆图节点与边（含语义标签、空间坐标、时间戳、压缩摘要），以及面向LLM工具调用的10种可组合召回原语
analysis.robot_dependency: ProcTHOR仿真器（无真实机器人依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用ProcTHOR-10K合成场景与模拟轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将人类认知心理学八种经典记忆范式（如DRM诱饵、模式分离、源监控）系统迁移到具身AI评测中，构建了可解释、可归因的诊断性基准；eMEM架构设计有明确神经科学依据和消融验证，但仍在纯仿真环境，未跨机体/未上真机，未解决sim2real鸿沟，故强于一般增量（>60），但未达DreamerV3级里程碑（<75）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：它不是工程整合或概念包装，而是为具身记忆建立了首个认知可解释的评测范式与匹配的系统架构，证据扎实（消融+多范式基准+开源），但受限于纯仿真，尚未触及真实具身部署的核心挑战。

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人在环强化学习（HIL-RL）中人类干预引入的‘伪成功’轨迹问题，提出用人类干预时刻隐含的偏好信号重新分配奖励信用，修正被高估的动作价值，并直接用干预动作约束策略更新，从而在5个真实机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率和收敛速度。
analysis.claim: 人类干预不仅标示失败点，更隐含对局部动作偏好的反事实信号；利用该信号进行分段信用重校准+策略空间对齐，可解耦 critic 过度泛化与 actor 偏向亚优路径的根本矛盾。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）+ 人类干预触发信号（时间戳/动作替换）
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如末端速度或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于5个real-robot manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需在线人类干预数据（每次干预提供动作替换+时间戳），且progress model需预训练于人类演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（5个真机任务、成功率+24.5%、收敛加速1.3×、含消融）、方法有明确因果机制（干预→偏好对→反事实优势→信用重校准+策略对齐），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，也未开源数据或仿真环境，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类干预从被动纠错信号升维为结构化偏好源，并在真机上闭环验证了信用重校准+策略对齐双路径有效性，但未开源数据、未验证跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测机器人视频世界模型‘可信度’的新基准RoboTrustBench，不看生成视频好不好看，而是系统性测试模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实、对抗四类高风险场景下是否真能安全、合理、物理一致地响应指令。
analysis.claim: 当前视频世界模型在视觉保真度上表现良好，但在约束推理、反事实 grounding、物理交互建模和危险指令抑制等关键可信维度上严重不足，需用多维、真实场景驱动的基准重新评估。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 初始图像（来自真实机器人操作片段）
analysis.output: 生成的未来视频帧序列（用于后续可信度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID 真实机器人数据集（基于 WidowX 机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人操作视频片段（1207个专家标注的instruction-image对）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并量化‘视频世界模型可信度’的六个维度与13项细粒度准则，基于真实机器人数据构建首个面向安全与鲁棒性的评测基准；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真机上闭环验证，影响力限于评测范式层面，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所确立的建模范式或控制能力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是突破模型能力的论文，而是戳破当前‘重画质轻可信’幻觉的关键评测工具，为后续可信世界模型研究立了靶子。

papers.title: GraspGen-X: Cross-Embodiment 6-DOF Diffusion-based Grasping
papers.abstract: We study cross-embodiment 6-DOF robot grasping. Unlike prior works, we require the model not only to generalize to novel objects / scenes but also to novel gripper morphologies and physical grasping processes. Our method extends diffusion model based generative 6-DOF grasping models to condition on the additional gripper's representation. We propose a swept-volume heuristic for encoding the gripper. We train our cross-embodiment model with procedural grippers and a large-scale dataset of 2 Billion grasps. In simulation experiments, our model has the best zero-shot generalization to novel real-world grippers and objects over baseline methods. Our model also serves as a good initialization for fine-tuning to adapt to novel grippers. In ablations, we demonstrate the efficiency of our sweep-volume gripper representation and our procedural gripper training dataset. Last, we show zero-shot generalization to real-world novel grippers for 6-DOF grasping, surpassing baselines in cross-embodiment generalization.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型做6自由度抓取，关键创新是让模型能直接适配没见过的机械手形态（而不仅是新物体），靠一种‘扫掠体积’编码+20亿合成抓取数据训练，在仿真和真实机械手上都实现了零样本跨机体抓取。
analysis.claim: 通过将机械手形态显式编码为扫掠体积并融入扩散生成过程，可实现真正意义上的跨机体6-DOF抓取零样本泛化，无需针对新机械手重新收集数据或微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言描述+机械手几何/运动学参数（编码为扫掠体积）
analysis.output: 6-DOF抓取位姿（位置+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + 多种真实机械手（如 Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand、Franka、UR5e+Robotiq）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人抓取数据，全部使用程序化生成的20亿合成抓取数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在6-DOF抓取中系统验证跨机体零样本泛化能力，真机实验覆盖4类差异显著机械手，有消融证明扫掠体积编码优于点云/网格等替代方案；但未开源数据、未开放真实机器人部署代码、未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端策略框架对比，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把扩散建模、程序化数据生成与跨机体表征设计结合得非常严密，在真实硬件上验证了可行性，但缺乏开源完整性和与主流具身策略框架的横向对标，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplitAdapter，通过把物体负载和机器人动力学偏差拆开建模，让一个预训练的箱体操作策略能适应不同重量（2-6kg）和不同高度（0-60cm）的搬运任务，在仿真和真机上都提升了成功率，尤其在重载时效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将负载变化与机器人本体动力学失配解耦建模，并通过分层FiLM+对抗正则化实现更鲁棒的sim2real loco-manipulation泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关节状态+任务指令（如pickup/place）+当前物体质量与目标高度
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型及真机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人重载交互数据用于微调和验证，但未说明是否需大量真实轨迹收集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Atlas机器人上完成多质量/多高度loco-manipulation部署，有消融验证分量设计有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更开放的任务空间（如非结构化物体、动态障碍），推进扎实但未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形机器人上实现了负载感知的因子化解耦适配，显著提升重载操作鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，属于高质量落地型工作而非范式创新

papers.title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
papers.abstract: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型学习环境动态，再在上面训练强化学习策略，让无人机无需人工调参或环境假设就能在没见过的复杂场景中自主导航，仿真和真机都直接运行不调参。
analysis.claim: 基于世界模型的通用无人机导航框架AirDreamer，能在未见过的杂乱环境中实现零调参sim2real迁移，并通过稀疏奖励激发自主偏航控制与局部最优逃离能力。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+目标位置指令（隐含在任务设定中）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续动作（含yaw控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中用AirSim，真机用自研四旋翼平台（摘要未提具体型号，但明确说‘on real drones’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅用仿真预训练+真机零调参部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统上的端到端导航落地：真机多场景零调参部署、稀疏奖励下涌现yaw控制、比SOTA高5.3%成功率；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，理论深度不及DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作，属扎实重磅而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Dreamer类世界模型成功压缩适配到资源受限的真实无人机上，完成从仿真到真机的闭环验证，但未突破建模本质或扩展通用性边界。

papers.title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks. It formalizes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and reports native success with two unsafe-success metrics: Succ-But-Unsafe (SBU), the fraction of rollouts that both succeed and violate safety, and Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating nine policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: high-SR tabletop baselines still leave 13 to 15 percent unsafe-episode rates,and 36 to 56 percent of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. Project page: https://safevla.org.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型建了个‘安全体检表’：用信号时序逻辑（STL）定义安全规则，在LIBERO和RoboCasa-365仿真基准上批量检测已发表模型的轨迹——发现很多‘任务成功’的轨迹其实严重违反安全约束（比如乱碰东西、打翻物品、自碰撞），并量化了‘成功但不安全’的比例和违规严重程度。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA基准只看任务是否完成（二值成功），掩盖了大量危险但成功的轨迹行为；必须引入任务感知、可形式化验证的安全评估框架，才能真实反映VLA模型的部署风险。
analysis.input: 已有VLA策略在仿真环境中的执行轨迹（含状态、动作、观测）
analysis.output: 两个安全指标：Succ-But-Unsafe（SBU）率和Violation Severity Index（VSI）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO/RoboCasa-365仿真器（Franka Emika Panda + kitchen/tabletop场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于公开仿真轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性暴露VLA模型‘成功≠安全’的核心缺陷，并给出可复现、可形式化、可插拔的安全评测协议；但未提出任何新模型、新训练机制或真实硬件验证，仅是诊断工具，分量不及所有列出的基石工作（全部≥85），属于扎实的领域警示性增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把STL安全验证嫁接到现有VLA仿真基准上，做了严谨的横向体检，但不是新方法也不是新能力，暂时无法推动模型改进本身。

papers.title: CLAW: Learning Continuous Latent Action World Models via Adversarial Latent Regularization
papers.abstract: We introduce CLAW, a fully end-to-end self-supervised framework for learning a world model jointly with continuous latent action representations directly from action-free videos. Our approach leverages adversarial latent regularization and diffusion-based video generation to capture structured and semantically meaningful action representations while modeling rich, predictive environment dynamics, without relying on any action labels or annotations. By simultaneously training the Latent Action Model and world model, CLAW learns to reason about how inferred actions induce environment transitions from visual observations alone. We show that the resulting latent action world model supports both imitation learning from observation and goal-directed planning. In imitation learning, latent actions extracted from raw videos enable behavior cloning. For planning, CLAW generates sequences of latent actions and maps them to executable actions to reach desired goals. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and embodiments demonstrate that CLAW produces semantically meaningful latent action representations, supports effective action transfer, and enables planning and imitation from observation, outperforming existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 仅用无动作标注的视频，端到端学出一个能预测环境变化的世界模型，同时自动发现连续、语义清晰的隐式动作表征，再用它做从视频模仿学习和目标导向规划。
analysis.claim: 无需任何动作标签或交互数据，仅通过自监督学习即可联合建模环境动态与语义连贯的连续隐式动作空间，并支撑下游模仿与规划任务。
analysis.input: 无动作标注的视频帧序列
analysis.output: 连续隐式动作向量序列 + 环境状态预测（未来帧/状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频数据集（如BAIR Robot Pushing、RoboNet等仿真/真实机器人采集的无动作标签视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在纯视觉世界建模+隐式动作解耦方向上显著推进：首次实现端到端联合训练且支持跨机体动作迁移与规划，但未在真实机器人上验证、无消融实验细节披露、未开源数据与完整训练配置，证据强度弱于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等需交互信号的标杆方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗正则化、扩散生成与世界模型架构巧妙耦合，在无动作监督下达成语义动作解耦与跨任务泛化，但缺乏真机验证与完整可复现性，尚未达到里程碑级突破。

papers.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做带视觉的老师策略，通过人参与的强化学习蒸馏，把知识传给不依赖视觉、只靠本体感知（位姿+速度+力矩）的学生策略，在NIST装配板上3个任务50分钟内达到95%成功率，并泛化到8个未见变种任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠真实世界RL和人机协同蒸馏，无需仿真、域随机化或数据增强，即可将视觉依赖策略的知识有效迁移到鲁棒的纯本体感知策略，实现接触密集操作的强泛化。
analysis.input: 教师端：RGB图像+语言/任务指令；学生端：关节位姿+空间速度+六维力/力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 低层连续动作（关节力矩或速度命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + NIST装配基准板（含力传感器与实时运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（无仿真预训练、无合成数据、无离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机端到端蒸馏实现vision-free策略且在NIST标准板上多任务+多变种泛化，证据扎实（50分钟训练、95%成功率、8个未见变种），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，影响力限于接触操作子领域，尚未达DROID/ALOHA级通用性或开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实硬件上闭环验证了视觉到本体感知的知识蒸馏可行性，有明确任务价值和部署证据，但缺乏开源与广义泛化支撑，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Accurate Identification of Functional Residues Across the Human Proteome with TAMALE
papers.abstract: Abstract The central challenge of the post-AlphaFold era is the ‘functional gap’. Despite having structure predictions for nearly every human protein, we remain unable to systematically distinguish residues that drive activity from those that merely maintain structural integrity. Here we introduce TAMALE, a machine learning model that calculates graded residue-level functional scores across the human proteome without prior annotation. TAMALE transforms structure models and variant effect predictions to identify residues involved in catalysis, ligand binding, nucleic acid interactions, and regulation. The model also distinguishes pseudo-enzymes from catalytically active homologs. The model was validated across 20 case studies along with experimental characterization of the FASTKD5 ribonuclease, demonstrating its utility for functional discovery. Applied proteome-wide to 19,528 human proteins, TAMALE generates testable hypotheses enabling mechanistic discovery at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫TAMALE的机器学习模型，用蛋白质结构预测和变异效应预测作为输入，给人类蛋白质组中每个氨基酸残基打一个‘功能重要性’分数，不需要事先标注，就能区分催化位点、配体结合位点等功能残基，还验证了它在FASTKD5蛋白上的预测并生成了全蛋白组尺度的可实验验证假说。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 无需功能注释先验，仅基于结构模型与变异效应预测，即可在全人类蛋白质组尺度上实现残基级、多类型（催化/结合/调控）功能残基的准确识别与伪酶判别。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2结构模型 + ESM-1v或类似模型的变异效应预测（ΔΔG或致病性评分）
analysis.output: 每个残基的功能得分（连续值），以及分类标签（如催化/结合/调控/结构/伪酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.generalization: 跨机体（全人类蛋白组）、跨任务（多类功能识别）
analysis.significance_reason: 是功能注释领域的扎实增量：首次实现无监督式、残基级、多类别功能打分且覆盖全蛋白组，验证含新实验（FASTKD5），但未突破AlphaFold后‘结构→功能’范式本身（仍重度依赖AF2+ESM输入，未建模动力学/环境/复合物），开源程度有限（仅网页+部分权重，无训练代码/完整数据流水线）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在结构到功能映射上迈出可复现、可扩展的一步，但仍是AlphaFold生态内的工具层演进，非范式突破

papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中自定义的14种以上腿式/轮式/双足机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的策略 rollout 数据训练价值函数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将价值函数显式用作可微设计代理并验证跨形态泛化能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机体验证、未接入任何硬件闭环、未与现有工业设计工具链（如CAD/FEA）对接，属于扎实的算法层面增量，尚未触及机器人本体设计的实际工程门槛。
