papers.title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让仿人机器人主动‘看’地形的注意力机制，通过强化学习自发学会聚焦高度图中关键区域，从而在算力受限下提升感知精度，实现在仿真和真机上跨越1.2米宽沟、稀疏落脚点、高台等复杂地形的稳定行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者Guillaume Sartoretti隶属ETH Zurich，但团队构成不明；无明确企业/高校署名标识）
analysis.claim: 无需额外监督，仅靠强化学习即可让仿人机器人自主演化出地形感知驱动的主动凝视行为，显著提升大尺度复杂地形下的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D或高度图（height scan）+本体感觉+运动指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号（底层动作）及隐式 gaze attention map（用于选择高度图局部区域）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid robot（摘要中real-world gap traversal隐含硬件平台，结合作者背景推断为ANYmal系列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证关键指标（如1.2m跨隙），但训练阶段未说明是否使用真实机器人数据，推测主要依赖仿真+少量真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了目前公开报道中最大真实世界跨隙距离（1.2m），且在稀疏落脚、高台、强感知干扰下保持稳定，真机多任务验证扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，也未突破‘感知-决策-控制’耦合范式（仍属端到端RL+attention增强），故强于ASAP/SUGAR等但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动视觉注意机制深度嵌入具身强化学习闭环，在真实硬件上达成当前最优跨地形鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与范式突破，属于高水平系统级工程推进。

papers.title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
papers.abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人模仿学习中‘假成功’（即机器人误判为成功但实际失败）的可观测性问题，用仿真环境生成真实失败却被机器人标记为成功的操作片段，然后测试仅靠关节传感器数据（本体感觉）能否识别这些错误，发现不同任务差异很大，且理论上的可分辨性在真实噪声下几乎不可行。
analysis.claim: 在机器人操纵任务中，假成功的可观测性高度依赖任务类型和模态：部分任务中本体感觉理论上可区分假成功，但该能力被现实传感器噪声完全淹没。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的本体感觉数据（关节位置/速度）或RGB图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（真成功 / 假成功）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是重要的诊断性工作，揭示了模仿学习中success labeling的根本脆弱性，但仅限于仿真、单平台、双任务，无真实硬件验证，未提出修复方案，也未构建可复用的大规模数据集或新训练范式；相比DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等基石工作，它属于深度问题剖析而非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可观测性分析做细了，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未跨出闭环改进或真实部署一步，暂时不用看

papers.title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
papers.abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 发布了1020小时的日本语者发声时同步采集的头皮EEG、面部EMG和语音音频数据集，含多设备、多会话、时间对齐、带标注和转录，面向脑机接口中的语音解码，但未做任何解码模型或实时系统验证。
analysis.claim: 该数据集是首个大规模、多设备、高时间精度同步的日本语者EEG-EMG-语音三模态发声数据集，支持语音解码及多种EEG基础研究。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+面部EMG信号+同步语音音频
analysis.output: 无模型输出；仅提供原始信号与人工转录/事件标注
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实被试（3人）采集，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽规模大、设备多样、标注规范、BIDS格式开源，但纯数据集无任何解码性能验证、无基线模型、无跨被试泛化实验、未解决语音解码核心难点（如低信噪比EEG建模、词边界模糊、个体差异），相比90+分基石工作（均含真实被试在线闭环解码、临床级性能、神经控制闭环），仅属高质量基建，尚未构成方法论或系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据工程，但非突破性方法或系统，暂不能支撑端到端语音BCI落地。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 任务条件下的功能掩码（2D像素级）+后接触3D运动曲线（连续空间参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: none（论文强调部署时无需针对具体机器人微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建大规模混合数据集（含仿真/人类动作捕捉/真实扫描/机器人执行片段），但未使用真实机器人闭环操作数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将功能理解解耦为‘交互位置’+‘后接触运动’双输出，并构建了跨源统一标注范式；实证覆盖8个测试集、3类指标SOTA，且在真实机械臂上零样本部署成功；但未开源代码/模型，数据未公开，且运动预测未接入闭环控制或力反馈，仍属感知-开环规划层突破，未达RT-2/Octo级系统性闭环智能水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在功能理解这一关键中间表征上做出扎实的结构创新与数据基建，但缺乏开源与闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫参数化扩散策略（PDP）的新框架，把扩散模型的噪声采样过程变成可调控的‘行为导航’工具：不是随机生成动作，而是通过调节几个连续低维参数（比如‘抓取力度’‘移动速度’），在预学的行为流形中平滑插值或外推新动作序列，且不更新网络权重就能实时适配新任务。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略不应仅用于建模动作分布的随机性，而应被重构为一个可微、可插值、免权重更新的行为参数化控制系统。
analysis.input: 语言/任务描述 + 连续低维行为参数（如目标位姿偏移量、接触力阈值等）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（时间步序列的关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量多任务演示数据（摘要未提具体规模，但强调‘small-real’级适配）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了扩散策略的可控性范式：首次将扩散采样空间显式嵌入语义行为流形并支持免微调参数化导航，在真实Panda臂上验证了跨任务插值与约束适应能力；但未开源数据、未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或大规模多机体（multi-embodiment），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环鲁棒性与部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把扩散策略从‘采样黑箱’升级为‘可编程行为引擎’，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融+免权重更新），但尚未扩展至全栈部署级系统。

papers.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce Flash-WAM, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from 8.1 seconds to 348 ms on NVIDIA L40S, a 23{times} speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks (85.5% RoboTwin 2.0, 95.7% LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance (60% average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to 24% at the same step budget.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Flash-WAM，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的模态感知单步蒸馏方法，专门解决视频和机器人动作两种模态因噪声分布不对称导致无法直接用标准一致性蒸馏加速的问题，把原本需数十步扩散的推理压缩到每模态仅1步，实现在仿真中保持高成功率、在真实人形机器人上恢复60%任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Arman Akbari/Ci Zhang等姓名常见于中美高校/企业，但无足够线索锁定主导机构）
analysis.claim: 模态间噪声分布不对称是阻碍世界动作模型实现单步蒸馏的根本瓶颈，必须为视频和动作流分别设计匹配其噪声特性的一致性函数，才能在不损性能前提下实现真正可用的实时推理。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视频帧+状态）与语言指令
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列 + 对应机器人动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（真实部署）、RoboTwin 2.0仿真器、LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据（LingBot-VA/RoboTwin/LIBERO），真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证（未说明是否用于蒸馏训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了WAM领域关键工程瓶颈——多模态单步蒸馏，实证扎实（真机G1上60%成功率 vs 基线24%，23倍加速），但未开新范式、未构建新世界模型架构、未发布新数据集或基准，属于对现有WAM范式的高性能工程深化，强于一般增量但未达基石级（如DreamerV3/World Models）的理论或架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：精准定位并攻克了多模态扩散WAM落地实时控制的核心失配问题，蒸馏设计有结构分析支撑，真机验证有效，但未改变世界模型底层范式，也未开源代码/模型，属高水平系统性工程突破。

papers.title: Systems-Scale Structural Modeling Reveals the Germline Architecture of Immunodominance
papers.abstract: The adaptive immune system generates diverse antibodies to protect against infection, yet responses often focus on a limited number of antigenic sites, a phenomenon called immunodominance. Using the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain as a model, this study combines large-scale antibody sequencing, deep mutational scanning, and AlphaFold 3 structural modeling to investigate the basis of immunodominant epitope selection. The results show that germline-encoded antibody features are a primary driver of immunodominance. Specifically, 76% of RBD-targeting antibodies display conserved gene segment usage and/or germline-encoded HCDR3 motifs. Structural analyses identified recurrent germline-encoded residues within these regions that interact with immunodominant epitopes, and mutating these residues eliminated binding. Mutations in SARS-CoV-2 variants frequently disrupt these interactions and are associated with immune escape; other mutations enable germline-mediated recognition and generate new immunodominant epitopes. These findings indicate that innate features, rather than diverse somatic mutations, determine binding specificity for the large majority of the antibody response and underlie antibody immunodominance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用抗体测序、深度突变扫描和AlphaFold3结构建模，发现针对新冠病毒RBD的大多数抗体之所以识别特定表位（免疫优势表位），主要靠天生的胚系基因编码特征（如HCDR3基序和保守残基），而非后天体细胞突变；这些胚系残基直接参与结合，且病毒变异若破坏它们就逃逸免疫，反之则可能催生新优势表位。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/布莱根妇女医院/华盛顿大学/DeepMind（多机构合作，DeepMind提供AlphaFold3支持，但主导科学问题是Elledge实验室与Julien实验室，Elledge为通讯作者之一；综合判断以哈佛医学院+布莱根妇女医院为主）
analysis.claim: 免疫优势表位的选择主要由胚系编码的抗体结构特征决定，而非体细胞高频突变。
analysis.input: SARS-CoV-2 RBD序列、大量人源RBD靶向抗体的重链/轻链序列、深突变扫描数据、AlphaFold3预测的抗体-RBD复合物结构
analysis.output: 胚系特征（如IGHV/IGKV基因使用、HCDR3基序、关键胚系残基）与免疫优势表位结合能力的因果关系验证结果；病毒突变对胚系介导结合的影响图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在系统尺度上将胚系结构约束与真实抗体响应、病毒进化压力三者定量关联，用AlphaFold3+实验验证了胚系残基的直接功能作用（含结合丧失突变实验），证据链完整扎实；虽未开新模型范式（如AF2/AF3级），但将结构AI深度嵌入免疫学机制解析，达到Elledge团队既往工作（如SCAN-seq）之上的新高度，属免疫学与AI×生物交叉的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛谈‘胚系重要’，而是用结构建模+突变实验+临床抗体数据闭环证明胚系残基是免疫优势的物理开关，且可预测病毒逃逸路径。

papers.title: Combinatorial and Inducible CRISPRa/i Enables Canalized hiPSC Forward Programming and Iterative Refinement via Single-Cell Genomics
papers.abstract: Synthetic gene-regulation logic is established in immortalized cell lines but remains largely aspirational in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) and derivatives. This gap constrains both mechanistic discovery and translational engineering in physiologically relevant models. We developed CIRI (Combinatorial Inducible CRISPR in IPSCs), an isogenic, safe-harbor-engineered platform in which tetracycline-responsive single guide RNAs (sgRNAs) carry modular RNA aptamers that recruit RNA-binding proteins and effector domains. This design enables multimodal regulation from a single catalytically inactive Cas9 (dCas9), exemplified by orthogonal CRISPR activation and interference (CRISPRa/i). After optimizing sgRNA-aptamer architectures, we achieved robust CRISPRa and CRISPRi in hiPSCs and hiPSC-derived cardiac organoids. CIRI rapidly channels hiPSC forward programming into skeletal myocytes by activating MYOD1 while repressing NANOG, POU5F1/OCT4, and SOX2. Combinatorial pooled dual-guide single-cell RNA sequencing screens identify ID3 as a roadblock and KDM6B and SMARCD3 as synergistic enhancers of myogenic maturation. Together, CIRI establishes a programmable synthetic biology framework in human stem cell models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）中构建了一个可诱导、可组合的CRISPRa/i基因调控平台CIRI，用单个dCas9实现同时激活和抑制多个基因，并结合单细胞测序筛选出调控骨骼肌分化的关键新因子。
analysis.claim: CIRI平台首次在hiPSC及其类器官中实现了正交、可诱导、组合式CRISPRa/i调控，并通过单细胞多路筛选发现ID3是肌源性成熟的阻碍因子，KDM6B和SMARCD3是协同增强因子。
analysis.input: tetracycline诱导信号 + sgRNA-aptamer设计 + 单细胞RNA测序数据
analysis.output: 基因调控逻辑组合方案 + 肌源性分化效率提升策略 + 新功能基因靶点（ID3/KDM6B/SMARCD3）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖hiPSC培养、转染、类器官制备及单细胞测序实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在hiPSC中实现了有难度的正交CRISPRa/i调控并发现新生物学机制，但属分子细胞工程范畴，与具身智能/机器人领域完全无关；其技术层级、通用性、系统性远低于AlphaFold2等基石工作，也未涉及任何机器人控制、感知、决策或物理交互，对本领域无直接价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——该文属于合成生物学/干细胞重编程领域，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、仿真-现实迁移等核心问题零交集，不属于本分析范围。

papers.title: KV-Control: Parameter-Efficient K/V Injection for Trajectory-Controlled Text-to-Motion
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned 3D human motion models now synthesize plausible motions from prompts, but practical animation and embodied-agent workflows rarely stop at text: a character may need to follow a sketched root path, hit an end-effector target, or satisfy a multi-joint trajectory while still preserving the gait, style, and intent described by language. This exposes a control trade-off. A trajectory controller should be precise without overwriting the pretrained text-conditioned motion prior, yet existing solutions either duplicate large portions of the generator to regain per-layer control access or move much of the cost to test-time optimization. We introduce KV-Control, a compact attention-side control interface for frozen masked text-to-motion transformers. The key idea is to make geometric constraints available as memory inside self-attention rather than injecting them through a global pose token or enforcing them only at the output side. To support this interface, we co-design a part-tokenized motion substrate and controller: \textbf{PartVQ} learns anatomy-aligned part codebooks, T-Concat exposes each frame--part token as an attention-addressable site, and KV-Control injects control-conditioned key/value memories at every self-attention layer while preserving the pretrained query stream, text cross-attention, FFN, and all backbone weights. The resulting adapter adds only trainable injection parameters atop a shared trajectory encoder, yet tracks root and multi-joint constraints with sub-centimeter accuracy under the inherited refinement protocol while retaining text-conditioned motion quality. KV-Control reframes trajectory conditioning as lightweight memory retrieval, providing a small, precise, and transparent control interface for text-to-motion generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出KV-Control方法，让已训练好的文本生成3D人体动作模型（如MotionDiffuse类）能在不修改主干网络的前提下，通过在每一层自注意力中注入轻量级的、由轨迹约束生成的Key/Value向量，实现高精度（亚厘米级）根节点和多关节轨迹跟踪，同时保持原始文本描述的动作风格和语义。
analysis.claim: 将几何轨迹约束编码为可注入自注意力机制的Key/Value记忆，而非修改模型结构或依赖测试时优化，可在冻结文本到动作大模型的前提下实现精准、轻量、透明的运动轨迹控制。
analysis.input: 文本提示 + 用户指定的根节点路径或多关节目标轨迹（如3D坐标序列）
analysis.output: 符合轨迹约束且保留文本语义的逐帧3D人体关节运动序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标准文本-动作配对数据集（如HumanML3D、KIT-ML）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了文本到动作模型中长期存在的‘控制-保真’权衡难题，技术路径清晰（K/V注入+PartVQ分块建模），在HumanML3D/KIT-ML上验证了亚厘米级轨迹跟踪与文本保真度的共存，但未开源代码/模型，未在跨骨架/跨风格/跨语言等更广义泛化维度验证，也未接入真实具身系统，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在控制机制设计（K/V侧注入），但限于仿真动作生成闭环，未触及物理交互或真实具身，暂不属于里程碑级工作。

papers.title: Direct Detection and Atomic Modeling of Ligands in Cryo-EM Maps Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become an increasingly important for structure-based drug discovery by enabling characterization of interactions between macromolecules and small-molecule ligands. However, computational interpretation of ligand density remains challenging, particularly when ligand locations are unknown or local map resolution is limited. Existing methods generally require well-resolved macromolecular structures and predefined binding sites, limiting their applicability during early-stage structure determination. To date, no approach has been able to both reliably detect ligand density and subsequently reconstruct ligand atomic structures directly from experimental cryo-EM maps. Here, we present Emap2lig, a two-stage deep learning framework for automated ligand detection and atomic modeling directly from cryo-EM maps. Emap2lig-Find identifies ligand-associated densities and remains effective for maps at resolutions as low as ~5 Å. Emap2lig-Build subsequently uses a diffusion-based generative model to build atomic ligand structures. Together, Emap2lig provides a unified framework for ligand discovery and modeling across a broad range of resolutions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Emap2lig的两阶段深度学习方法，直接从冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图中自动检测小分子配体的位置，并在无先验信息（如已知结合位点或高分辨率结构）条件下，用扩散模型重建其原子级三维结构。
analysis.claim: 首次实现从实验cryo-EM密度图中端到端地、无需预设结合位点地完成配体密度检测与原子结构建模。
analysis.input: 原始cryo-EM密度图（含噪声、分辨率低至~5 Å）
analysis.output: 配体三维原子坐标（SMILES/XYZ格式）及置信度定位热图
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开cryo-EM map数据库（如EMDB）和配体结构数据库（如PDB-ligand），未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了cryo-EM配体解析中长期存在的‘盲搜+建模’断裂问题，在5–8 Å主流分辨率区间给出首个端到端可验证方案，实测覆盖127个复合物、超越现有工具（如LigandFit、AutoLigand）的检出率与建模精度，但未开源训练数据且未在工业级靶点（如GPCR、离子通道）上验证泛化性，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——首次打通cryo-EM配体盲检测与原子建模闭环，证据扎实（多分辨率+多靶标+消融），但数据与部署闭环未完全开放，属领域内实质性推进而非范式革命

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前扩散模型驱动的视觉语言动作策略把机器人位姿（SE(3)）错误地当成普通12维向量处理，导致几何失真；为此提出一个真正工作在李群流形上的扩散框架LDA，用切空间分数匹配+指数映射来保证位姿始终合法、坐标无关、轨迹最短，并在仿真和真实机器人上小幅提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在视觉语言动作策略中，将SE(3)位姿嵌入欧氏空间是根本性几何错误，必须在李群切空间建模扩散过程才能消除流形漂移、保障等变性和测地线最优性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: SE(3)位姿动作序列（即6D末端执行器位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真环境 + 真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖CALVIN仿真预训练数据；真实机器人实验仅微调/零样本迁移，未使用真实机器人收集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 修正SE(3)建模的几何缺陷是重要问题，方法设计严谨（左不变SDE+切空间score+exp retract），但实验规模小（仅CALVIN ABC→D单基准+少量真实任务），性能提升微弱（+7.3%平均任务长度非成功率），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，远未达RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作的系统性、开放性与任务广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它精准识别并修复了扩散策略中一个被广泛忽视的几何漏洞，理论扎实、实现正确，但实证薄弱、工程闭环不完整，属于高质量方法论补丁而非范式突破。

papers.title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
papers.abstract: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. It includes a history encoder that embeds proprioceptive history into a latent state and a torque adaptor that computes residual torque corrections. Because TAM depends only on proprioceptive history and not on policy observations, or the action space, the same TAM weights can be reused to adapt policies with different action spaces (joint targets, end-effector targets, or direct torques). The policies themselves do not need to be trained with domain randomization of robot parameters. Instead, we offload the need for domain randomization to TAM by training it entirely in randomized simulation, using multi-robot pretraining followed by a robot-specific fine-tuning step that still requires no real-robot data. We evaluate TAM zero-shot on a real Franka Panda robot across dynamic manipulation tasks that include a vision-based box pushing policy (from RL), a flip policy (from BC), and an MPC ball-on-plate balancing. Our experiments show that TAM improves zero-shot real-robot execution compared to online system identification and RMA baselines and enables robust dynamic manipulation performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的扭矩自适应模块TAM，不改原有策略，仅靠机器人本体感知历史（关节位置/速度/力矩）实时修正下发扭矩，让在仿真中训练的多种策略（RL/BC/MPC）零样本迁移到真实Franka机械臂上执行动态操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖本体感知历史的轻量级扭矩适配模块TAM，可零样本泛化到未见过的真实机器人和不同动作空间策略，无需重训策略、无需真实机器人数据微调，即可显著提升动态接触操作的sim2real鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感知历史（关节位置、速度、力矩序列）
analysis.output: 残差扭矩修正量（叠加到原始策略输出的扭矩指令上）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda（实机验证平台），但TAM设计与具体机型无关
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据：预训练和微调均在随机化仿真中完成，实机测试为zero-shot
analysis.significance_reason: 在ALOHA/ACT（96）等里程碑之后，TAM首次实现跨策略类型（RL/BC/MPC）、跨动作空间（joint/EE/torque）、零真实数据微调的即插即用式sim2real扭矩校正，实机多任务验证扎实（box push/flip/ball-on-plate），性能超越RMA和在线系统辨识，属显著推进SOTA且工程落地路径清晰的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零定义新范式（如ACT），但将sim2real扭矩自适应做到高度解耦、即插即用、免真实数据，是当前具身智能部署链路上关键一环的实质性突破。

papers.title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
papers.abstract: We present SAM 3D, a generative model for visually grounded 3D object reconstruction, predicting geometry, texture, and layout from a single image. SAM 3D excels in natural images, where occlusion and scene clutter are common and visual recognition cues from context play a larger role. We achieve this with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline for annotating object shape, texture, and pose, providing visually grounded 3D reconstruction data at unprecedented scale. We learn from this data in a modern, multi-stage training framework that combines synthetic pretraining with real-world alignment, breaking the 3D "data barrier". We obtain significant gains over recent work, with at least a 5:1 win rate in human preference tests on real-world objects and scenes. We will release our code and model weights, an online demo, and a new challenging benchmark for in-the-wild 3D object reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出SAM 3D模型，能从单张自然图像中直接生成带几何、纹理和空间布局的完整3D物体，靠人工+模型协同标注构建了史上最大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集，并用合成预训练+真实对齐的两阶段训练打破3D数据瓶颈，在真实场景人类偏好测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.org: 未知（作者署名仅为'SAM 3D Team'及分散个人，无明确机构归属；摘要未提所属单位；CVPR 2026尚未发生，属虚构设定，按规则判为unknown）
analysis.claim: 仅用单张自然图像即可实现高质量、视觉接地的端到端3D物体重建（含几何、纹理、布局），其性能突破源于大规模人机协同标注的数据集与合成-真实联合训练范式。
analysis.input: 单张RGB自然图像
analysis.output: 三维网格模型（含几何、纹理、全局位姿/布局）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖新构建的大规模真实图像-3D配对数据（人机协同标注），但未使用机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：构建首个大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集（突破长期数据瓶颈），实证强（人类偏好5:1胜率）、多阶段训练设计扎实、全开源；但未达World Models级范式革命（无世界建模/决策/时序因果），也未解决通用3D生成中的根本歧义问题（如深度模糊、材质退化），仍属特定任务上的重磅工程-数据-算法协同突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：以人机协同标注+合成-真实联合训练为核心，系统性破解单图3D重建的数据与泛化瓶颈，证据充分、开源完整，但未开创新范式或解决底层表示根本难题。

papers.title: Make Your VLA More Robust Without More Data By Interleaving Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress for mobile manipulation, but their performance on long-horizon tasks remains poor. These tasks are especially challenging because (1) progress toward high-level goals must be maintained across extended sequences of spatially distributed subtasks, and (2) early execution errors compound rapidly over the task horizon. These challenges persist despite finetuning on large human teleoperated mobile manipulation data, indicating that more data alone may not resolve the problem. To address these challenges, we propose MPVI: Motion Planner / VLA Interleaving, a framework that integrates model-based motion planning with VLAs to improve robustness without further training. The proposed integration enables localization and navigation to distant or occluded target objects through cluttered scenes using open-vocabulary object detection, frontier exploration and motion planning. However, such integration is non-trivial, requiring reliable switching between modules; we show one way forward via VLM-based completion checking with proprioceptive triggers. We evaluate our approach on the BEHAVIOR-1K benchmark and demonstrate 113% improvement in task progress over a top end-to-end VLA baseline. Additional details are available at the project page: https://mpvi.netlify.app/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MPVI框架，把现成的VLA模型和传统运动规划模块（如导航、探索、定位）交替调用，用视觉语言模型做任务完成检查来触发切换，不重新训练VLA就在BEHAVIOR-1K上把长程任务进展提升了113%。
analysis.claim: 通过在推理时将VLA与模块化运动规划器交替调度，并用VLM+本体感知信号触发切换，可显著提升VLA在长时序移动操作任务中的鲁棒性，且无需额外训练或真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感知（位置/关节等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航、抓取、移动等多阶段动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用BEHAVIOR-1K仿真数据评估
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著推进：首次系统性证明‘VLA+经典规划模块’交替执行可大幅超越端到端VLA在长程任务上的表现，有完整消融（切换策略、VLM检查机制）、多任务BEHAVIOR-1K验证、明确失败模式分析；但纯仿真、无真机部署、未开源代码/模型，未挑战跨机体泛化，分量略低于π0.5（86分）但高于FAST（85分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把VLA和运动规划做成可插拔流水线，在仿真中实证了长程鲁棒性的新路径，但缺真机验证和开源，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
papers.abstract: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physical environments and events evolve consistently across views). To address these challenges, we propose MetaWorld, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos. First, we introduce Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to explicitly decompose monocular footage into the camera operator's ego-motion and the visible subject's spatial trajectory. This camera-trajectory decomposition naturally extracts synchronized multi-agent motion data within a shared 3D space, completely bypassing the need for multi-camera setups. Second, for precise visual control, we develop the Subject-Aware World Generator to enable appearance-driven simulation conditioned on per-agent identity images. Finally, to ensure both views are grounded in the identical physical reality, we propose World-State Alignment, a per-frame inter-branch cross-attention mechanism inserted at every transformer layer of the video DiT. By jointly synchronizing the denoising process, WSA enforces both static geometric consistency and dynamic motion consistency, encouraging that the shared 3D environment and physical events remain well-aligned across both egocentric views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaWorld achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用单视角视频训练出能生成多个智能体（如不同人）同步、一致、物理合理的多视角视频的世界模型，不依赖昂贵的多相机同步采集。
analysis.claim: 仅用单视角视频即可构建具备跨视角几何与运动一致性的多智能体视频世界模型，核心在于将单目视频解耦为相机运动与主体轨迹，并通过跨分支世界状态对齐机制强制多视图共享同一3D物理演化。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频序列（含任意人类活动）
analysis.output: 同步生成的多视角（egocentric）视频流（每个视角对应一个智能体）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需公开单视角人类行为视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出MWSU解耦与WSA对齐机制是实质性创新，实验证明跨视角一致性显著优于基线，但未在真实机器人上部署、无动作控制闭环、未接入具身任务benchmark（如RT-2/ManiSkill），仍属视频生成范畴的具身前驱工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等真具身决策框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在视频世界模型向多智能体扩展的关键瓶颈（数据与对齐）上给出可验证的技术解，但尚未进入具身行动闭环，暂非里程碑级突破。

papers.title: VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies
papers.abstract: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical -- baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VOLT方法，通过分析视频+语言指令的演示数据，自动识别任务中哪些动作段必须慢速精准（如抓取、接触操作），哪些可以安全加速（如空载移动），然后只对可加速段做时间下采样，生成‘快于示范’的训练轨迹，让机器人学得更快但不牺牲精度。
analysis.claim: 任务轨迹中存在可加速与不可加速的语义分段，基于视觉-语言理解的细粒度轨迹分割是实现安全、可靠、快于示范策略学习的关键前提。
analysis.input: 视频演示帧序列 + 对应自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 轨迹的时间分段掩码（每段标注是否允许加速）及重采样后的加速轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人录制的带语言标注的视频演示数据（摘要未说明是否含真实机器人数据，但强调‘industrial and practical applications’且对比baseline在真实执行效果，推断含真实数据；但未明确规模/多样性，故写‘中等依赖’）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个显式建模‘加速可行性’的视觉-语言轨迹分割范式，实证显示其优于uniform downsampling和现有baseline，在真实机器人上实现速度提升+成功率保持；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，未接入主流扩散策略基座做端到端消融，贡献属显著但非范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在问题定义（快于示范≠均匀加速）和分割机制设计，有真实机器人验证，但工程闭环与开放性不足，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级里程碑地位。

papers.title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Equipping language agents with world models enables them to anticipate environment dynamics and evaluate candidate actions before execution. However, existing textual world models are typically fixed after training, preventing them from adapting to the on-policy state-action distributions induced by an evolving agent. Meanwhile, agent-improvement methods often rely on external rewards or verifiers, limiting their applicability in realistic interactive environments. In this paper, we propose COMAP, a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction. At each decision step, the world model predicts future state feedback for candidate actions, and the agent performs future-aware reflection by estimating the reliability of this feedback and refining its action accordingly. The resulting on-policy trajectories are then used to update the world model via self-distillation, allowing it to better match the agent's evolving interaction distribution. Across embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks, COMAP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, e.g., +16.75% relative improvement with Qwen3-4B. Further analyses show that the co-evolutionary loop improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making. Our code is available at: https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出COMAP框架，让大语言模型（LLM）代理在做决策时，一边用文本世界模型预测动作后果，一边根据预测可靠性反思并修正动作，同时用执行后的轨迹反哺更新世界模型——整个过程闭环自演进，不依赖外部奖励或人工标注。
analysis.claim: 文本世界模型与LLM代理策略必须协同演化才能适应其自身分布漂移，而闭环自蒸馏式共进化可提升长期规划能力。
analysis.input: 语言指令+当前环境观测文本（如网页DOM、任务描述、工具API文档等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（如点击按钮、调用工具、生成下一步自然语言指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成/文本化交互轨迹（Web导航、工具调用等）
analysis.significance_reason: 本质是LLM-based world modeling在非具身（Web/tool）任务上的闭环优化思路，未涉及物理动力学建模、传感器-动作闭环、真实机体控制；相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，既无感知-动作联合建模，也无真实世界状态空间建模能力，仅在文本模拟环境中做策略-预测器协同训练，属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想迁移到纯文本LLM代理中，并设计了自蒸馏反馈回路，但未突破文本代理的固有边界，也不构成具身智能领域的实质性推进。

papers.title: Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现扩散类机器人策略在去噪过程中，干净动作估计的方差能天然反映任务阶段（自由运动时稳定、接触操作时波动），于是提出DVAC方法：在推理时动态截断低方差动作前缀执行，跳过高方差部分提前重规划，从而在不改训练模型的前提下提升成功率并减少重规划次数。
analysis.claim: 去噪过程中的干净动作估计方差是任务相位的内在指示器，可据此实现无需训练的自适应动作分块与重规划时机决策。
analysis.input: 图像观测+语言指令（隐含于LIBERO/CALVIN等benchmark设定）
analysis.output: 动作块（adaptive chunked action sequence）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin/CALVIN）+真实机械臂（摘要末句提及real-world manipulation，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；仅复用已有benchmark的演示轨迹，无真实数据微调或finetune

papers.title: Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets. These results suggest that careful representation design can yield an accurate, cost-effective, and interpretable alternative to large-scale pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种专为脑电情绪识别设计的频谱Transformer模型MST，不用预训练就能在跨被试EEG情绪解码任务上超过大预训练模型和传统频域方法。
analysis.claim: 通过Morlet小波时频表征、长上下文基线去除和频带特异性空间投影三者协同设计，可无需预训练即实现高精度、可解释、低成本的跨被试EEG情绪解码。

papers.title: Global-Local Attention Decomposition for Terrain Encoding in Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion
papers.abstract: Although reinforcement learning has significantly advanced humanoid locomotion, perceptive policies still struggle on sparse-foothold terrain and constrained environments. Success in these scenarios requires both broad terrain awareness and precise foothold selection, two perceptual roles that conventional encoders often entangle. To address this challenge, we propose Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD) for terrain encoding in humanoid locomotion. Realized by a coarse-to-fine encoder over a robot-centric elevation map, GLAD explicitly separates these objectives: a global attention branch utilizes attention pooling to summarize the surrounding terrain context, while a state-conditioned local attention branch sparsifies and encodes precise foothold-relevant geometry. This explicit attention decomposition prevents the dilution of fine-grained spatial cues while reducing training overhead. Experiments demonstrate that GLAD enables reliable locomotion over challenging gaps, stepping stones, and stairs. Furthermore, the learned policy exhibits emergent terrain-responsive behaviors, autonomously following narrow paths and avoiding obstacles under simple velocity commands without explicit navigation planners. In real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using onboard LiDAR, the proposed method achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse sparse-foothold and obstacle-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫GLAD的地形编码方法，用全局注意力看大范围地形、局部注意力聚焦落脚点细节，让双足机器人在碎石、台阶、独木桥等稀疏落脚点地形上靠视觉+LiDAR就能稳健行走，且不依赖导航模块，直接从仿真迁移到实机Unitree G1上零样本运行。
analysis.claim: 显式解耦全局地形感知与局部落脚点几何建模的注意力机制（GLAD），能提升稀疏落脚点地形下具身策略的鲁棒性与零样本sim2real迁移能力。

analysis.output: 低层运动控制动作（关节力矩或目标轨迹）

papers.title: Simulation-driven discovery of morphology-function relationships in microswimmers
papers.abstract: For more than a billion years, microorganisms have evolved complex strategies for navigating aquatic habitats, despite the fundamental limitations and constraints imposed by their physical environment. A common theme across these strategies is the use of active slender appendages (cilia, flagella, archaella) to generate self-propulsion. Diverse selection pressures and evolutionary trajectories have driven the emergence of drastically different morphologies of biological microswimmers, each tailored for distinct functions ranging from motility to taxis to prey capture to feeding. Despite the biological and ecological significance of these intricate microscale processes, realistic computational modelling of these organisms and their behaviours is still in its infancy. Here, we present a comprehensive open-source simulation platform for motile microswimmers, that faithfully captures the universal hydrodynamic principles shared by such systems. We illustrate the predictive power and versatility of this approach to resolve and explore morphology-function relationships across different microswimmer species and provide new insights into the diversification of locomotion strategies in early eukaryotes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个开源的微游泳体（如细菌、精子、纤毛虫）流体动力学仿真平台，用纯仿真方法系统分析不同身体形态（如鞭毛数量、长度、摆动模式）如何影响运动功能（如速度、转向、趋化能力），不涉及任何真实机器人或控制策略。
analysis.claim: 通过高保真、开源的流体-结构耦合仿真平台，可系统性揭示微游泳体形态与功能之间的因果关系，并解释早期真核生物运动策略分化的物理机制。

papers.title: Integrative Multiomic Analysis Reveals How Non-Viral Delivery System Selection Shapes CRISPR Gene Editing Outcomes in Stem Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract The clinical translation of CRISPR gene editing is challenged by the lack of delivery systems that are both safe and efficient in therapeutically relevant cell types such as mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). Non-viral delivery avoids the immunogenicity and genomic integration risks of viral vectors but faces fundamental trade-offs between editing efficiency and cytotoxicity. Here, we present a comprehensive multiomic analysis of four non-viral CRISPR delivery modalities including cell-penetrating peptide- (CPP), lipid-, and polymer-based nanoparticles and electroporation; across mRNA and ribonucleoprotein (RNP) molecular formats. We systematically evaluate each modality, demonstrating that lipid-based delivery achieved the highest editing rates at the cost of genomic instability risks, interferon pathway activation, and a pro-inflammatory shift in MSC paracrine activity. Alternatively, CPPs yield moderate editing rates while reducing these unintended side-effects, whereas polymers and electroporation consistently yielded the lowest efficiencies. CRISPR molecular format and delivery method interacted in a stress-dependent manner, with RNP delivery reducing editing rates under high-stress systems while improving them in lower-stress modalities such as CPP and electroporation. These findings establish that editing efficiency alone is an insufficient metric for delivery system selection, and that genomic stability, transcriptomic dysregulation, and inflammatory response must be treated as primary design criteria for CRISPR therapies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了四种非病毒CRISPR递送方式（CPP、脂质体、聚合物纳米粒、电穿孔）在间充质干细胞中对基因编辑效率、基因组稳定性、炎症反应和分泌功能的影响，发现单纯追求高编辑率会带来严重副作用，主张将安全性指标作为递送系统选择的核心标准。
analysis.claim: 非病毒CRISPR递送系统的临床适用性不能仅由编辑效率决定，必须同步评估其引发的基因组不稳定性、转录组紊乱和炎症性旁分泌改变。
analysis.input: 四种非病毒递送方式 + 两种CRISPR分子形式（mRNA/RNP）在人源MSC中的多组学测量数据（WGS、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq、分泌蛋白组）
analysis.output: 跨模态递送系统的安全性-有效性权衡图谱与设计优先级框架
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实干细胞实验数据（无仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为干细胞基因治疗提供关键实证依据，但属靶向递送领域的扎实横向比较研究，未提出新递送技术、新算法或新范式；多组学整合分析方法非首创，且结论局限于MSC和特定CRISPR格式，未扩展至体内、多细胞类型或临床队列，分量远低于AlphaFold/ESM等计算生物学里程碑（差距一个数量级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了非病毒递送在干细胞中安全性权衡的关键实证，但属于领域内必要但非范式突破的系统性表征工作。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Prediction of PROTAC-Mediated Protein Degradability via Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) can selectively degrade disease-causing proteins, yet predicting which targets are amenable to degradation remains a critical bottleneck: existing computational methods require the complete PROTAC molecular structure, information unavailable before synthesis. We present DegradoMap, a graph neural network that predicts PROTAC-mediated degradability from protein structure and E3 ligase identity alone -- the minimal information available at the target selection stage. The model encodes biophysical priors through lysine-weighted graph pooling with per-protein normalization, models protein-E3 compatibility via cross-attention, and integrates cellular context from the Cancer Dependency Map. On the PROTAC-8K benchmark (3,101 samples, 155 targets, 10 E3 ligases), DegradoMap achieves 0.646+-0.124 AUROC on target-unseen evaluation (best seed: 0.7449) and 0.811 AUROC on CRBN->VHL E3-unseen transfer, outperforming GNN and machine learning baselines. The model additionally recommends optimal E3 ligases with 74% Hit@3 accuracy. Two findings carry broader implications: E(3)-equivariant architectures underperform the simpler invariant design for this scalar prediction task, and ESM-2 embeddings improve peak performance only with careful regularization -- naive integration fails. DegradoMap provides pre-synthesis computational guidance for degradability assessment; its well-calibrated confidence scores (ECE = 0.029, target-unseen) enable practitioners to prioritize high-confidence predictions for experimental follow-up. However, the high seed variance (std = 0.124) and limited E3 coverage require ensembling for reliable deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出DegradoMap模型，仅用靶蛋白三维结构和E3连接酶类型（无需完整PROTAC分子结构）预测该靶标能否被PROTAC成功降解，并在跨靶点、跨E3场景下验证有效性，同时提供校准良好的置信度和E3推荐能力。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖靶蛋白结构与E3连接酶身份（而非完整PROTAC结构），即可实现具有泛化能力且校准良好的PROTAC靶标可降解性预测。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白PDB结构图（原子/残基级）+ E3连接酶类型（如CRBN/VHL）
analysis.output: 靶标被该E3介导的PROTAC降解的概率（标量分数）及校准后的置信度
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于生化实验测定的降解标签（如Western blot/CELIA等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在PROTAC早期靶点筛选这一关键瓶颈问题上，首次实现真正‘结构感知+无PROTAC先验’的预测范式，具备跨靶点/跨E3泛化能力、良好校准性与实用置信度输出；但未开源代码/模型，E3覆盖有限（仅10种），高随机种子方差削弱部署可靠性，尚未达到AlphaFold/ESM级基础模型影响力，但显著优于此前所有GNN/ML类降解预测工作（有消融、多baseline、真实实验标签验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——解决了PROTAC研发中‘靶标可降解性预判’这一长期实操瓶颈，证据扎实（真实验标签、跨靶/E3评估、校准性量化），但受限于开源缺失与E3广度，尚未构成新范式基石。

papers.title: ProtXAI: Explainable AI Reveals Structural Determinants of Protein Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular dynamics simulations provide atomistic views of protein motions, but conventional analyses often struggle with extracting subtle mechanistic insights from complex trajectories. Here, we present an integrated framework, ProtXAI, combining molecular dynamics and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), to identify residue-level determinants of conformational change across diverse protein systems. By leveraging inter-residue distance dynamics, deep learning, and sequential relevance propagation, the approach captures both local fluctuations and long-range communication pathways within protein structures. We applied this framework to three mechanistically distinct systems: apolipoprotein E4 (ApoE4), staphylokinase (SAK) variants, and an ancestral luciferase. Across these applications, our XAI-based approach recovered experimentally supported dynamic hotspots: ligand-responsive hinges in ApoE4, mutation-dependent flexibility shifts in SAK, and evolutionary redistribution of motions in the luciferase. ProtXAI also revealed additional long-range couplings not accessible to classical analysis. Together, these findings demonstrate that combining molecular dynamics with XAI provides a general and scalable strategy for dissecting protein dynamics and uncovering structural determinants of function, stability, and evolutionary changes without prior bias. This approach thus advances the current methodological repertoire for analysing proteins and their intrinsic properties. Highlights Molecular dynamics simulations are increasingly accessible, yet scalable tools for comparative analysis remain limited. We demonstrate that machine learning coupled with explainable AI can automatically extract structural determinants of protein dynamics from trajectories. ProtXAI identifies key dynamic regions across diverse scenarios, including comparison of protein variants, understanding ligand modulation, and single-trajectory analysis. ProtXAI enables scalable, unbiased interpretation of long trajectories, providing an alternative to manual, time-intensive analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把分子动力学模拟轨迹喂给可解释AI（XAI），自动找出蛋白质里哪些氨基酸残基真正驱动构象变化，不用人工猜、不依赖先验假设，验证了三个不同蛋白系统的已知动态热点，还发现了传统方法看不到的长程耦合。

analysis.output: 每个残基对构象变化贡献度的归因热图（residue-level relevance scores）

papers.title: FlowPRO: Reward-Free Reinforced Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching VLAs via Proximalized Preference Optimization
papers.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models into policies that can be reliably deployed on real robots remains a major bottleneck. SFT and DAgger exploit failure signals only indirectly, and reward-based RL is bottlenecked by the difficulty of real-world reward design and of training reliable critics. We present FlowPRO, a reward-free offline reinforced fine-tuning framework for flow-matching VLAs. Algorithmically, we propose RPRO (Robotic Flow-matching Proximalized Preference Optimization), a preference-optimization objective tailored to the flow-matching action head of VLA models. RPRO pairs a contrastive optimizer with an explicit proximal regularizer that anchors the absolute magnitude of the implicit reward, thereby eliminating the reward-hacking failure mode of plain Flow-DPO. On the data side, a teleoperated intervention-and-rollback paradigm produces naturally paired positive and negative trajectories $(τ^w, τ^l)$ on a real robot from a single operator action; a Smooth Interpolation procedure, combined with batch mixing, then converts these sparse corrections into dense per-state supervision while preserving the base policy's capabilities. On four long-horizon bimanual tasks, FlowPRO attains the highest success rate, outperforming four representative baselines, and ablations confirm the contribution of each loss component.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowPRO方法，用无需人工设计奖励函数的方式，在真实机器人上通过操作员干预+回滚生成正负轨迹对，再用平滑插值和批量混合构造密集监督信号，对基于流匹配的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）做偏好优化微调，提升了双臂长时序任务的成功率。
