analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂机器人（未指明型号，但明确用于采集τ^w/τ^l）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自单操作员在真实机器人上的干预-回滚采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward-free VLA微调方向有实质性推进：真机验证、四任务基准、消融完整、明确解决flow-DPO的reward-hacking缺陷；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型做统一评测，也未展示部署延迟、鲁棒性或长期运行稳定性，属于扎实但边界清晰的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机reward-free偏好优化落地有效，但闭源且泛化有限，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs
papers.abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface. Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation. This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations. Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出S2框架，通过给视觉语言动作模型的执行器（executor）提供更精细的子任务级语言指导+限制其可看的视觉区域数量（不依赖标注），在真实机器人上显著提升了跨干扰、跨外观变化的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型泛化能力差的主因是执行器被迫从粗粒度指令和全图视觉中联合推断执行细节；改用目标保持的细粒度语言指导+显式视觉证据预算，能解耦学习压力并提升真实机器人泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+粗粒度语言指令+细粒度子任务级语言指导（训练时生成，推理时由VLM planner via in-context learning 提供）
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity / end-effector pose）
analysis.robot_dependency: TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容版）和HSR真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8个任务轨迹数据（用于relabelling和eval），但未说明是否开源原始数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%，有消融验证（goal-preserving guidance vs instruction replacement, evidence budgeting effect），且部署于双平台；但未开源代码/数据，未挑战跨机体泛化，也未超越π0.5（86分档）的范式高度，属扎实重磅但非里程碑级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言细化+视觉预算两个正交设计落地到真实机器人多任务场景，效果显著且有机制分析，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and release. To address this challenge, we propose Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm (SKIP), an event-preserving sparse-to-dense framework that avoids dense frame-by-frame generation. SKIP first identifies task-relevant keyframes by leveraging robot-aware multimodal features. It then synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. A learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator subsequently reconstruct the missing intervals according to the robot actions. On LIBERO, SKIP generates dense rollouts $4.16\times$ faster than a dense baseline while improving visual fidelity and reducing aggregate FVD by $89.0\%$. Importantly, SKIP-generated videos are effective policy-training data. Even when they fully replace real demonstrations, $π_{0.5}$ success drops only $1.3$ pp in LIBERO simulation and $6.7$ pp on the real robot, whereas fully dense frame-by-frame generation collapses by $48$ to $58$ pp.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SKIP框架，用稀疏关键帧（只生成任务事件点如接触、抓取）加动作引导的插值来替代传统逐帧生成视频的世界模型，大幅加速推理并保持策略训练有效性。
analysis.claim: 在保持任务相关事件完整性的前提下，通过机器人感知驱动的关键帧稀疏化与动作条件插值，可显著加速具身世界模型的视频rollout，且生成视频仍能有效支撑下游策略训练。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+多模态观测（视觉+动作指令）
analysis.output: 密集视频帧序列（但非逐帧生成，而是稀疏关键帧+插值重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境（Franka机械臂+RGB相机），未依赖特定真实硬件接口
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用LIBERO公开仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO上实现4.16×加速+89% FVD下降+真实机器人仅降6.7pp，证明其工程有效性；但未开新范式（仍是world model rollout优化），未挑战长期开放难题（如闭环自监督建模、跨机体泛化），也未超越DreamerV3等基石的理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是高效视频生成的架构创新，在仿真到真实迁移中验证扎实，但未突破世界模型的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynaFLIP，用图像-语言-3D光流三元组监督训练一个纯图像编码器，让视觉表征提前学懂‘动作如何改变世界’，从而提升机器人在操纵任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作相关的动力学信息（3D flow）显式注入视觉编码器的预训练过程，能显著提升下游机器人策略对未见场景和动作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D光流（合成或估计）
analysis.output: 动力学感知的图像嵌入向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）及少量真实机械臂（如Franka），但非端到端控制硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/估计的3D flow，未使用真实机器人交互视频中的ground-truth dynamics数据；真实世界验证仅用现成视频帧+后处理光流，无闭环真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3D flow作为显式模态与图文联合约束视觉编码器，在多个仿真+小规模真实实验中验证了动力学感知表征对VLA类策略的增益（+22.5% OOD），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨硬件部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身闭环学习），属扎实且有启发性的表征层面增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：把动力学信号前移到视觉编码器预训练阶段并验证其泛化价值，但缺乏真机大规模闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

analysis.tldr: 用跨域专家视频（比如仿真里拍的机器人动作）训练一个视频预测模型，把智能体当前看到的画面‘翻译’成专家视频所在域的画面，再用预测准确率当奖励信号来训练强化学习策略，从而解决没有真实奖励、且视觉域差异大（颜色/形态/仿真到真实）时的模仿学习问题
analysis.claim: 跨域视频预测的似然性可作为无奖励、跨视觉域模仿学习的有效代理奖励信号
analysis.input: 当前智能体观测帧序列（RGB）+专家视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 标量奖励信号（用于RL训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: DMC仿真器（DeepMind Control Suite）及对应真实机械臂数据集（sim2real transfer dataset）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需真实场景下的静态观测帧（用于reward inference），无需真实动作标签或轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用跨域视频重建似然作reward），在DMC Color/Body两个标准benchmark上验证了有效性，并做了sim2real reward transfer分析；但未在真实机器人上闭环训练或部署，无策略泛化实验（如跨任务/跨机体控制），reward模型本身是标准VAE+Transformer预测架构的组合应用，未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页，证据链止于reward信号合理性，未证明端到端策略性能跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了可验证的跨域reward构造范式，在标准仿真benchmark上有效，但未跨越sim2real闭环控制门槛，也未开源核心资产，尚不能支撑领域范式转移

papers.title: Replicate-anchored calibration of within-host single nucleotide variant detection in Mycobacterium tuberculosis whole genome sequencing
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Intra-host genetic heterogeneity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is biologically and clinically informative, but its detection from short read whole genome sequencing depends on thresholds over read depth (DP), alternate allele support (AD), and minor allele frequency (MAF) that are rarely empirically anchored. Methods We developed a biological replicate-anchored, lexicographic calibration framework for per-specimen intra-host single nucleotide variant (iSNV) detection. Within-patient replicate sputum pairs from a pre-treatment tuberculosis (TB) cohort were scored across the joint (DP, AD, MAF) grid on six concordance metrics; the selector penalized no-signal regimes and ranked cells by reproducibility, with sensitivity as a tiebreaker. Selection stability was quantified by B=1,000 nonparametric bootstrap resamples of replicate pairs, defining a Looser/Primary/Tighter sensitivity ladder. The calibrated rule was applied to 97 patients contributing 282 cultured sputum specimens. Results Calibration on 169 replicate pairs from 67 patients identified a Primary cell at DP≥ 60x, AD ≥ 3, MAF ∈ [0.02, 0.50]. The bootstrap modal cell coincided with the Primary cell in 45.7% of 703 successful replications (MAF = 0.02 in 100%; AD = 3 in 90.2%). Per-patient prevalence of detectable within-host diversity at the Primary tier was 16.5% (16/97, Wilson 95% CI: 10.4% - 25.1%); Looser and Tighter tiers yielded comparable rates. Conclusion Within-patient replicate concordance provides a reproducible empirical anchor for iSNV detection thresholds in TB whole genome sequencing. The framework is internally calibrated and reported with explicit sensitivity tiers. The calibrated rule can be applied to external cohorts as a direct test of transferability. Data Summary Raw paired-end Illumina whole genome sequencing reads for the 282 Mycobacterium tuberculosis genomes analyzed in this study have been deposited at the NCBI Sequence Research Archive (SRA) under BioProject accession PRJNA1466981. Per-sample run accessions and corresponding metadata are provided in Supplementary Data S1. The M. tuberculosis H37Rv reference genome used for read alignment is available from GenBank under accession NC_000962.3 . The full analysis pipeline (R), calibration scripts, application scripts, parameter files, and derived data tables that reproduce all reported results, main figures, and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/K01-tb-genomics/paper1_isnv_calibration . A versioned snapshot of the repository at the time of manuscript submission is archived at Zenodo under 10.5281/zenodo.20246996. Supplementary Tables S1-S5 and Supplementary Figure S1 are provided as supplementary files alongside the article. The authors confirm that all supporting data, code and protocols have been provided within the article or through the cited public repositories. Impact Statement Within-host genetic diversity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is increasingly used to study transmission, treatment response, and resistance emergence. The bioinformatic thresholds that distinguish low-frequency variants from sequencing noise vary widely across published TB studies and are rarely empirically justified, thus reshaping which patients are reported as harboring detectable within-host diversity. We provide a biological replicate-anchored calibration framework that ties threshold selection to within-patient replicate concordance, quantifies stability under resampling, and reports explicit sensitivity tiers. Applied to 97 TB patients, the calibrated rule identifies 16.5% as carrying detectable within-host M. tuberculosis variation. The framework is transferable to other TB cohorts as a transparent basis for cross-study comparison. Lay Summary Tuberculosis (TB) bacteria can vary slightly within a single patient. Bacterial cells in the same person may carry small genetic differences, sometimes affecting only a small fraction of the bacterial population. Studying this kind of within-patient variation matters for understanding how TB responds to treatment and how it spreads between people. Detecting these differences from DNA sequencing means distinguishing real signal from background noise. However, the rules used to make that distinction affect which patients are reported as carrying mixed bacterial populations. In this study, we developed a method for making that detection decision more reliably. Most patients gave more than one sputum sample on the same day. We used the agreement between repeat samples from the same patient to pick rules that gave consistent answers. We checked how stable our chosen rules were by repeating the selection on randomly drawn versions of the data, and we report stricter and looser versions of the rule alongside our preferred one. We applied the method to 97 TB patients. About one in six (16.5%) showed detectable genetic variation within their TB bacterial population using our preferred rule. The same rules can also be applied to other TB studies to check whether they give consistent results when used in a different setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用同一患者多次痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，为结核分枝杆菌（M. tuberculosis）全基因组测序中检测低频体内单核苷酸变异（iSNV）设定了可复现、有实证支撑的阈值规则（DP≥60x, AD≥3, MAF∈[0.02,0.50]），并量化了该规则在重采样下的稳定性，还公开了全部代码、数据和流程。
analysis.claim: 基于同一患者多份痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，可为结核菌体内iSNV检测提供经验锚定、稳定且可迁移的阈值校准框架。
analysis.input: 配对的Illumina短读长WGS原始数据（同一患者不同痰标本）
analysis.output: 经校准的iSNV检出阈值组合（DP/AD/MAF三元组）及对应敏感度分级（Looser/Primary/Tighter）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床痰标本的配对测序数据（169对来自67人）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的生物信息方法学贡献：首次在结核领域系统性用生物学重复锚定iSNV阈值，含bootstrap稳定性评估、三级敏感度报告、全开源实现，并在97例真实队列中验证；但问题范畴窄（仅TB iSNV）、未跨病原体泛化、未整合新模型或深度学习，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了TB基因组学中长期存在的阈值主观性问题，证据扎实、完全开源、临床可落地，但属垂直领域方法优化，非跨学科范式创新。

papers.title: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in UAV navigation. However, existing approaches typically rely on historical observations to directly predict actions, often struggling in dense urban environments where severe occlusions and sharp turns result in drastic viewpoint transitions. We argue that the ability to "imagine" future states -- inherent in World Models -- is critical for robust decision-making under such partial observability. To address this, we construct a challenging Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark, specifically designed to evaluate spatial understanding in scenarios characterized by severe occlusions and drastic viewpoint transitions. To this end, we propose WorldFly, a novel world-model-based VLA framework that employs a dual-branch coupled flow matching mechanism to jointly generate future video predictions and navigation actions, thereby explicitly guiding the agent's policy via spatial imagination. Extensive evaluations on our benchmark demonstrate that WorldFly outperforms other baselines, particularly in unseen environments, validating the effectiveness of integrating world models into embodied aerial agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldFly模型，用世界模型（预测未来视频帧）辅助无人机在高楼林立、严重遮挡的城市峡谷中做视觉-语言-动作联合决策，通过双分支流匹配机制同步生成未来画面和导航动作，在自建的Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark上验证了对未见环境的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型显式嵌入VLA框架，通过联合视频预测与动作生成实现空间想象力驱动的无人机导航，显著提升在严重遮挡与剧烈视角变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流+自然语言导航指令（如'飞过右侧窄巷'）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续控制动作（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（Gazebo/PX4？摘要未明示，但Urban Canyon场景强暗示基于AirSim或类似高保真仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实无人机数据提及
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（世界模型+VLA耦合），但仅在自建仿真benchmark上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明‘双分支流匹配’比简单时序建模更优；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既未建立通用具身基础模型，也未解决真实部署瓶颈，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：世界模型引入方向合理，但实证局限在单一仿真场景，缺乏真实系统验证和机制级消融，尚未达到开范式或工程落地门槛。

papers.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个叫RoboSemanticBench的诊断型基准——让机器人读数学题或常识题，再从多个候选积木块里抓取正确答案对应的那一个，专门检测VLA模型是否真能把语言语义‘落地’成正确动作，结果发现主流VLA模型在语义选择上基本靠猜。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型虽具备语言/视觉骨干的语义能力，但在动作预测阶段无法可靠地将复杂指令语义映射到正确的物理操作目标上。
analysis.input: 多选题文本（数学/常识）+ RGB观测图像（含候选答案块）
analysis.output: 单步抓取动作（对应正确答案块的6D位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未明说但benchmark默认基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成任务生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘语义到动作映射失效’的诊断型基准，设计精巧、有实证支撑（多模型在控制抓取成功率后仍随机选答案），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未提出任何修复方案，属于高质量增量诊断工具，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需同时推进建模、训练、部署闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语义理解与动作解耦诊断做得扎实，但仍是评估工具而非解决方案，不改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
papers.abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向野外搜救任务的、分阶段诊断型仿真基准RescueBench，用以暴露现有具身智能在多阶段组合任务中（探索→救援→记忆返回→交接）的级联失败问题，核心发现是自主探索和空间记忆是两个独立且未被解决的瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 当前具身智能方法在真实搜救工作流中失败的根本原因不是单一模块缺陷，而是多阶段任务组合下自主探索能力不足与空间记忆能力薄弱的双重、独立瓶颈，且二者无法被现有拓扑导航或地图方法缓解。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+语言指令+环境线索（如声音/文本提示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（移动/交互/抓取/放置）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（基于Unity/Unreal的自定义具身代理，无指定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、结构清晰、有诊断深度的benchmark工作，但属于领域基础设施建设而非范式突破；未涉及真实机器人、未提出新模型/算法/架构，所有结论止步于对现有方法的归因分析，且7个基线中无一个SOTA级具身VLA模型（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA等），评估广度与前沿性不足。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它把搜救任务拆解成可诊断的四阶段流水线并实证定位了两个关键瓶颈，但仍是纯仿真benchmark，未推动算法/部署/泛化边界，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: MAGI: Mechanistic Consequences of Genetic Variants via Genomic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Clinical variant interpretation requires mechanism-aware evidence to guide diagnosis and clarify the biological consequences of mutations. However, existing computational predictors and genomic foundation models largely function as black boxes, providing pathogenicity labels with limited mechanistic insight or clinical actionability. Here, we present MAGI (Mechanistic Annotation of Genomic Impacts), a novel method that bridges this interpretability gap by unifying clinically relevant variant interpretation with mechanistic genomic analysis. MAGI pipeline leverages a genomic transformer model to quantify the effects of DNA variants across 3,623 functional tracks, encompassing regulatory features, multi-omics datasets, including tissue specificity and chromatin states, and 21 additional molecular annotations of genes and transcripts. These signals are integrated through a deterministic logic layer that maps single-nucleotide variants and indels to explicit molecular consequences. We benchmark MAGI-derived consequences against clinical rationales curated from ClinVar and observe strong concordance that scales with the magnitude of functional disruption. MAGI accurately recapitulates canonical pathogenic mechanisms, including start codon loss, splice site disruption, and regulatory element perturbation, consistent with ClinVar annotations. We further present case studies addressing conflicting or incomplete mechanistic interpretations, as well as variants requiring complex inference. Notably, MAGI is also applicable to non-human genomes and was evaluated on multispecies OMIA pathogenic variants. Collectively, MAGI establishes a generalizable framework that extends beyond clinical diagnostics to enable mechanistic discovery in functional genomics, generating mechanistically grounded, testable hypotheses for variants of uncertain significance (VUS) and variants with discordant clinical interpretations. In several cases, MAGI proposes alternative explanations that challenge existing annotations, providing transparent rationales and experimentally tractable predictions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了MAGI方法，用一个基因组Transformer模型预测DNA变异在3623个功能轨道（如调控元件、染色质状态、组织特异性等）上的定量影响，并通过确定性逻辑层将变异映射到明确的分子后果（如起始密码子丢失、剪接位点破坏），从而为临床变异解读提供可解释、可验证的机制依据。
analysis.claim: MAGI首次将大规模基因组基础模型的定量预测与确定性分子逻辑规则结合，生成临床可解释、实验可验证的变异机制注释。
analysis.input: DNA序列变异（SNV/indel）及其上下文序列
analysis.output: 显式的分子后果类别（如'canonical_splice_site_loss'、'start_codon_lost'、'enhancer_disruption'）及支持该结论的多轨道功能扰动证据
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开基因组数据（ENCODE、Roadmap、GTEx等），无需真实机器人或湿实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在可解释性范式上有实质性推进（黑盒预测→机制映射），且验证了ClinVar一致性与跨物种适用性，但未开源代码/模型权重，仅靠项目页和有限案例支撑；其核心创新是工程化整合（ESM-like模型+规则引擎），而非新架构或新数据源，显著弱于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义范式的基石工作，也未解决长期开放难题（如VUS功能验证仍需湿实验），属扎实但窄域的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有基因组大模型输出与分子生物学规则系统性对接，提升了临床注释的透明度，但缺乏开源实现与端到端实验验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

analysis.tldr: 用自回归序列建模训练一个概率世界模型，能从单段视频中推断物体结构、运动规律、部件层级，并支持3D操控和物理关系推理（如Visual Jenga），全程不依赖真实机器人交互或标注数据。
analysis.claim: 概率化、可条件查询的自回归世界模型能从无标注视频中端到端涌现物体发现、部件分解、3D操控与物理关系建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 条件概率分布（如未来外观/运动/物体分割/3D位姿/物理力矩关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；仅用合成仿真视频（如NVIDIA Kaolin、PyBullet生成的物理合理场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型架构上提出可条件查询的概率接口+自回归训练范式，确实在物体发现和物理关系推理上比DreamerV1/V3更细粒度，但未在真实机器人上验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、未开源代码或模型，且所有结果均基于可控合成环境，未解决长期开放难题（如遮挡鲁棒性、非刚体建模、真实传感器噪声），属显著贡献但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：推进了世界模型的结构化理解能力，但仍是纯仿真、窄任务、不可复现的扎实增量，暂时不用看真机落地

papers.title: AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

analysis.tldr: 用一个能看图说话的多模态GPT代理自动设计奖励函数、训练并诊断无人机导航策略，再根据诊断反馈闭环优化奖励，最后在真实无人机上实现91%成功率的端到端视觉导航。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯斯科尔科沃科学技术研究院（Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology）
analysis.claim: 通过引入具备多模态感知与自反思能力的GPT代理，可实现奖励函数生成、策略训练、失败归因与奖励迭代优化的全闭环自主强化学习，显著提升无人机在复杂视觉导航任务中的sim2real泛化性与部署鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（六自由度控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK + RealSense D455 + custom ROS2 stack
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的合成视觉数据；真实飞行仅用于最终验证，未用于训练或奖励调优
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将多模态大模型作为闭环奖励工程师+策略诊断员嵌入RL训练流，在5类真实无人机导航任务上验证了reward self-refinement的有效性（+71%行为改进）和强sim2real迁移（91%实机成功率），但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨机体/跨传感器泛化证据，也未与SOTA基线（如RT-2、Octo）在统一benchmark上对比，属扎实的领域内显著推进，但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机多任务验证了大模型驱动的reward闭环优化可行性，但缺乏开源与横向基准对比，暂未构成范式转移。

papers.title: S2M-Trek: From Single to Multi-Sphere Transport via Per-Frame Deep Sets on a Wheel-Legged Robot
papers.abstract: We study the problem of scaling dynamic loco-manipulation from a single free-rolling sphere to multiple spheres transported simultaneously on the back of a wheel-legged quadruped, without fences, grippers, or mechanical stops. Multiple identical free-rolling spheres form an unordered set with no persistent identity: their ordering may change independently at each history frame, creating a \emph{per-frame permutation symmetry} that standard history-concatenation set encoders do not explicitly enforce -- these encoders impose only a shared, diagonal permutation symmetry over the full history. We show that this symmetry mismatch leads to a concrete failure mode in curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Within the same PPO training budget, flat MLPs and branch-wise encoders plateau at or below the two-sphere stage, while a history-concatenation Deep Sets baseline (\HCDS) fails to progress past the two-sphere stage in our runs unless ball-to-slot assignments are randomised during training, suggesting that it exploits slot indices as a curriculum shortcut rather than learning identity-free multi-sphere dynamics. We propose \textbf{Per-Frame Deep Sets (\PFDS)}, which performs permutation-invariant pooling within each history frame before temporal readout; we prove that \PFDS is $\Gframe$-invariant and universally approximates continuous $\Gframe$-invariant policies. A $2{\times}2$ ablation over encoder architecture and slot randomisation separates the architectural and data-augmentation pathways, and \PFDS reaches the five-sphere stage with 100\% no-drop transport in simulation across all five random seeds. We further distill the \PFDS teacher into \TactSet via DAgger, replacing privileged sphere-state observations with a $16{\times}16$ Boolean union contact map, yielding a compact and naturally $\Gframe$-invariant tactile representation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让轮腿四足机器人不用围栏、夹爪或机械限位，仅靠背部平台滚动运输多个无标识小球，并提出一种叫Per-Frame Deep Sets的新编码结构来解决多球排列无序导致的对称性建模错误，从而在仿真中稳定完成5球同步运输。
analysis.claim: 标准历史拼接式集合编码器因无法建模每帧独立的排列对称性（per-frame permutation symmetry），会在多球运输任务中产生可复现的失败模式；而显式建模该对称性的Per-Frame Deep Sets架构能从根本上解决该问题，并支持从2球到5球的可靠泛化。
analysis.input: 每帧的多球位置/速度（仿真状态）或16×16布尔触觉接触图（蒸馏后）
analysis.output: 轮腿机器人底盘的连续动作（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿四足机器人仿真模型（未命名，基于PyBullet/Mujoco类引擎）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论证明（Gframe-不变性+通用逼近）和强实证（5球100%成功+5种子+消融分离架构与数据增强效应）的对称性建模范式，显著优于现有Deep Sets变体，但仅限于单一仿真locomanipulation任务，未验证真实机器人、未开源数据、未接入VLA/LM生态，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式迁移力
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在对称性建模层面识别并修复了RL中被忽视的帧级排列不变性缺陷，证据扎实，但局限在仿真多球运输这一窄任务，离通用具身智能还有距离

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PaCo-VLA，不是让视觉语言动作模型直接输出电机指令，而是让它只提‘合规性建议’（比如该软一点还是硬一点、当前任务阶段），再用一个独立的、基于能量守恒原理的高速被动性防护模块来实时审核和执行这些建议，确保接触操作中不违反物理安全性，已在插拔连接器任务的仿真和真机上验证有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型输出解耦为语义级合规提案，并引入与之解耦的、可证明被动性的高速防护层，可在接触密集操作中实现语义泛化能力与接触物理安全性的严格保障。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 任务阶段标签+语义绑定+ admittance调度参数（非原始动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（真机实验）；MuJoCo仿真器（仿真实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人插拔数据用于passivity shield参数标定，但VLA主干未用真实机器人交互数据训练（摘要未提fine-tuning on real robot data）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论保障（passivity via energy-tank）的VLA-控制解耦新范式，实证覆盖仿真+单任务真机（connector insertion），精度和安全性优于基线，但仅验证单一接触任务、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码/模型、未接入主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo），属显著但窄域的实质性推进，未达π0.5（86分）量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将无源性（passivity）作为runtime contract嵌入VLA控制栈，在接触操作安全接口设计上做出可验证、可解耦的实质性改进。

papers.title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.

analysis.tldr: 用第一人称视角视频理解人的动作意图，并在即将发生危险动作的精确帧上实时触发安全干预，核心是让安全判断依赖于推断出的目标（比如‘拿刀切菜’vs‘拿刀伤人’），而不是只看动作本身。
analysis.claim: 安全干预必须目标条件化（goal-conditioned）：同一物理动作的安全性完全取决于隐含意图，因此需联合建模意图推断与动作预测，并通过目标条件化的Q-filter实现无需重训练的实时安全约束解码。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频帧 + 可选语言目标描述（如‘我要切洋葱’）
analysis.output: 二分类安全干预决策（是否在当前帧阻断）+ 目标条件化的安全动作评分（用于约束解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无专用机器人，但依赖ASIMOV-2.0仿真环境（含虚拟人体与交互场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖合成/半合成egocentric视频+人工标注的安全标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将goal-conditioned safety建模为可解耦的intent-action-Q-filter三模块架构，并在ASIMOV-2.0上验证了帧级干预精度提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，且安全干预仍停留在‘阻断’而非‘主动防护’，未触及具身智能中更本质的动态风险规避或协同避障问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把语言引导的安全判断做细了，但仍是仿真沙盒里的‘预警系统’，离真实人机共融场景中的主动安全保障还有显著距离。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Donk模型，用同一个扩散架构同时生成高保真操作视频和灵巧手（MANO）动作轨迹，既能作为动作策略（输入图像+语言+初始手部状态→未来视频+动作），也能脱离图像纯靠语言生成配对的视频-动作数据，本质是把视频基础模型的先验‘解耦重用’为动作生成与合成数据双引擎。
analysis.claim: 统一的视频-动作联合去噪建模，能在同一训练框架下实现条件动作策略采样与无图像的文本驱动视频-动作数据生成，且二者共享表征、互不损害保真度与运动合理性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+初始RGB图像+初始手部状态（MANO参数）；或仅语言指令
analysis.output: 未来数帧操作视频 + 对应的双手机械手MANO关节轨迹（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MANO手模型 + 自研/通用仿真器（未明确命名，但实验含EGAD、YCB等物体交互，推断依赖PyBullet或Mujoco级仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据：所有训练数据来自合成视频+MANO轨迹配对（如EgoDex衍生、自渲染数据集），摘要未提任何real-robot collection或fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现视频-动作联合扩散建模并打通策略生成与数据合成，但全部验证停留在仿真+合成数据，无真实手部执行、无跨任务泛化测试（如换物体/换手型）、无与ACT/ALOHA等基线在相同任务上的定量对比，仅报告‘accuracy/fidelity/smoothness’提升而无具体指标和baseline数值，属扎实但窄域的表示创新，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、长程闭环、真实硬件鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视频扩散和动作生成在联合隐空间里做了漂亮对齐，但仍是仿真沙盒里的优雅构造，离真实灵巧操作还有显著距离。

papers.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务从预测动作改成预测图像中一个可到达的像素点，再把这个像素反投影成3D路点让机器人前进；转向和停止则用图像边缘区域编码，大幅减少大模型调用次数。
analysis.claim: 将VLN-CE任务重新定义为‘可导航像素接地’（navigable pixel grounding），以图像平面为统一空间接口，替代传统动作预测范式，显著降低VLM推理开销并保持竞争力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 单个可见可导航像素坐标（及辅助区域分类：左/右/底）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R-CE/RxR-CE，基于Habitat或AI2THOR等标准VLN-CE仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLN-CE仿真数据集（R2R-CE/RxR-CE）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出像素接地新接口有启发性，但仅在标准VLN-CE仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无硬件闭环、无开源代码，性能提升源于减少VLM调用而非解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作，它未涉及多任务泛化、世界模型、长程规划或真实部署，属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM输出空间从离散动作映射到连续像素，是聪明的接口重设计，但未突破VLN-CE仿真瓶颈，也未触达具身智能核心挑战。

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新方法，而是对工业视觉领域sim-to-real问题做概念重构：按‘先验可用性’（尤其是CAD模型是否可用）把现有工作分成三类，指出CAD是否在训练/部署时存在会根本改变技术路径和评估逻辑。
analysis.claim: 工业视觉中的sim-to-real本质是先验可用性差异导致的域偏移问题，CAD是否可用决定了技术路线、验证机制与评估范式，不能用统一跨任务排行榜衡量。
analysis.input: 工业图像（合成/真实）、CAD模型、正常样本、语言提示等多源先验
analysis.output: 分类框架与评估原则建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开工业视觉数据集（T-LESS/BOP/MVTec AD/VisA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了有实证支撑（T-LESS/MVTec等锚点）的分类学框架，厘清了CAD在工业视觉中作为结构先验的核心作用，但未提出可复现的新算法/模型/系统，也未解决任何具体任务性能瓶颈，属于高质量综述性分析而非技术推进；显著弱于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（后者定义新范式并开源可扩展架构），也不具备UniPi/DreamZero级的跨模态具身决策整合能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的工业视觉文献按先验结构重新组织，揭示了CAD可用性对技术选择的决定性影响，但无新模型、无真机验证、无开源实现，属于高水平领域认知梳理，非技术突破。

papers.title: MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoDex扩散策略，让灵巧手在不松开已抓物体的前提下，依次抓取多个物体，通过‘对立空间’条件控制哪些手指参与当前抓取，从而保留其余自由度用于后续操作，并在仿真和真实Franka+Allegro平台上验证了其多物体连续抓取的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可配置的‘对立空间’条件机制，扩散策略能显式保留灵巧手未使用的自由度，实现无需释放的顺序多物体灵巧抓取，且sim2real迁移有效。
analysis.input: 点云+当前夹爪观测+对立空间条件（指定参与抓取的手指子集）
analysis.output: 下一时刻夹爪6D位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Allegro Hand灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真专家演示数据（MuJoCo）和少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称RL fine-tuning在real-world平台进行，但未说明是否用真实交互数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了灵巧操作中‘自由度预留’这一长期挑战，首次将条件化扩散策略与手指级动作掩码（opposition space）结合，在真实硬件上完成多物体顺序抓取（非单次抓取），性能超越多个学习型基线；但未达ALOHA/ACT级系统性范式突破（如端到端闭环、跨任务泛化架构、大规模人类行为数据驱动），也未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在Diffusion Policy框架下做出扎实的灵巧手动作约束创新，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与更大规模泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Disentangling RNA evolution and thermodynamics in genomic language models
papers.abstract: Abstract Genomic language models (gLMs) trained only on large-scale nucleic acid sequence data seem to capture signals of RNA structure, yet the specifics of how remain unclear. Using the categorical Jacobian (CJ) operation, a model-agnostic operation for querying pairwise dependencies, we systematically compared three flagship gLMs: RNA-FM, Evo 2, and gLM2. We found that CJ signals recover base pairs supported by evolutionary covariation analyses, consistent with findings in protein language models. Surprisingly, CJ also recovers base pairs lacking evolutionary support but predicted by biophysical nearest-neighbor models. Is it possible gLMs have “learned” RNA thermodynamics? We noticed nearest-neighbor RNA folding models often predict reflected structures when given reversed sequences, consistent with these models’ modular and grammar-like nature. We leveraged this observation to create a simple “mirror test” that we found gLMs routinely fail, indicating they have not learned generalizable biophysics-based rules for RNA structure. Nevertheless, their apparent thermodynamic signal potentially confounds interpreting gLM pairwise dependencies as evidence of evolutionary conservation. We therefore introduce a method using synthetic sequences as a control for detecting significant learned signal. Our results demonstrate that gLMs can mimic thermodynamics through learned sequence context rather than general physical principles, but solutions exist for disentangling patterns in language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一种叫分类雅可比（CJ）的模型无关方法分析三个RNA语言模型，发现它们看似能预测RNA碱基配对，但这种能力其实混杂了进化信号和热力学模拟效应；作者设计了一个‘镜像测试’证明模型没真正学会物理规律，而是靠序列上下文统计‘模仿’热力学，并提出用合成序列做对照来分离这两种信号。
analysis.claim: RNA语言模型中观测到的碱基配对信号并非纯粹源于进化约束，而是混杂了对RNA热力学行为的统计模仿，且该模仿不具备物理可泛化性。
analysis.input: RNA序列（单链核苷酸字符串）
analysis.output: 成对碱基依赖性得分（通过分类雅可比计算）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物序列数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算生物学/语言模型可解释性交叉方向的扎实分析工作，但未提出新模型、新结构预测能力或实验验证，也未解决RNA结构预测这一长期开放问题；其‘镜像测试’和合成对照法是启发式诊断工具，非通用解法；显著弱于ESM-2/95分档及Evo 2/92分档等基石工作（后者直接推动结构预测性能跃迁），更接近方法论探针类研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是针对RNA语言模型内部表征的诊断性分析，有价值但非突破，不改变RNA建模或结构预测的实践范式，也不涉及具身智能/机器人领域核心问题。

papers.title: Equivalent volitional learning emerges through circuit-specific population dynamics in motor cortex and hippocampus
papers.abstract: Learning operates across different brain circuits to associate population activity patterns with desired outcomes, and to enable volitional reactivation of those patterns to control behavior. These circuits differ profoundly in their architecture and dynamical regimes, yet which features of learning are shared across them and which arise from circuit-specific implementations remains unknown. Here, we use a brain-computer interface (BCI) to train mice to modulate the activity of selected neuronal ensembles toward configurations that trigger reward delivery. By making reward delivery contingent directly on population activity, we impose an identical associative learning problem on two circuits with distinct dynamical regimes: the primary motor cortex (M1) and the hippocampal area CA3. Mice acquired robust volitional control in both regions, and learning produced a set of shared signatures across circuits, including modulation of reward-controlling neurons, network-level sparsification, and greater exploration of reward-related activity patterns. These signatures were underpinned by distinct population dynamics: M1 activity flowed continuously through reward-associated states, whereas CA3 activity traced approach-and-return dynamics around them. Recurrent network models endowed with distinct minimal connectivity constraints chosen to reflect the dominant dynamical regime associated with each region captured key features of these shared signatures and region-specific dynamics, indicating that local architectural constraints are sufficient to account for the distinct implementations of learning. These findings indicate that equivalent learning outcomes arise from divergent dynamical implementations across architecturally distinct circuits. This principled degeneracy reveals that learning is not a single canonical solution, but is implemented through multiple circuit-specific mechanisms shaped by local network architecture.

analysis.tldr: 用脑机接口让小鼠分别在运动皮层和海马CA3区学习主动调控神经群体活动以获取奖励，发现两个结构迥异的脑区能产生相同的可学习行为表型（如稀疏化、探索增强），但底层神经动力学完全不同（M1是连续流形穿越，CA3是环绕式趋近-返回），说明等效学习结果可由不同电路架构独立实现。
analysis.claim: 运动皮层与海马CA3虽具截然不同的网络架构与动力学特性，却能通过各自特化的群体活动演化路径，实现功能等价的自主学习输出。
analysis.input: 双光子钙成像记录的M1或CA3神经元群体活动模式
analysis.output: 经BCI反馈强化后形成的、可稳定触发奖赏的特定群体活动构型
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量活体双光子成像+闭环BCI实时解码数据，全部为真实小鼠实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单细胞分辨率下跨两个经典学习相关脑区实证‘功能等价但机制歧异’的学习退化性（degeneracy），提供强因果证据：相同行为目标可由不同动力学范式达成；实验设计严谨（同一BCI范式施加于两区）、数据量扎实（多只小鼠+长时程记录+消融对照模型）、理论解释深入（用最小约束循环网络复现核心现象），但未拓展至灵长类/人类，也未验证临床转化潜力，故略低于90分档基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用高精度神经记录+闭环BCI+可解释建模，首次实证大脑学习存在架构决定的动力学退化性，挑战‘统一学习算法’假设。

papers.title: Mind-Omni: A Unified Multi-Task Framework for Brain-Vision-Language Modeling via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract: Modeling the interplay between external stimuli and internal neural representations is a pivotal research area for Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). A major limitation of prior work is the prevailing paradigm of specialized, single-task models, which curtails versatility and neglects inter-task synergies. To address this, we propose Mind-Omni, the first versatile framework that unifies seven distinct encoding and decoding tasks through a discrete diffusion paradigm. At its core is a novel Brain Tokenizer that transforms heterogeneous, continuous brain signals into standardized, discrete tokens. This enables direct, token-level interactions for mutual understanding and generation between any two or more modalities within a shared semantic space. To unlock advanced reasoning capabilities, we further curate a specialized Brain Question Answering (BQA) instruction-tuning dataset. Our model not only establishes a new state-of-the-art among multi-task unified frameworks but also provides strong evidence for multi-task synergy. By demonstrating performance competitive with, and at times superior to, larger specialized models, our work offers a powerful new paradigm for neural modeling and paves the way for foundation models of neural activity. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ReedOnePeck/Mind-Omni.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Mind-Omni的统一多任务框架，把脑信号（fMRI/EEG）、视觉、语言三模态打通，用离散扩散模型建模，核心是把连续脑信号转成离散token，再在共享语义空间里做任意两两模态间的编码/解码（比如脑→图像、语言→脑、脑→语言等），共支持7个任务；它没在真实BCI设备上闭环控制机器人或假肢，也没恢复瘫痪者运动/沟通功能，纯属离线神经表征建模。
analysis.claim: 通过离散化脑信号并构建跨模态token级共享空间，首次实现7个脑-视-语任务的统一建模，且多任务联合训练能带来性能增益，优于同等规模的单任务模型。
analysis.input: 脑信号（fMRI/EEG）+图像+文本指令
analysis.output: 离散token序列（对应重建图像/生成文本/预测脑响应等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑成像数据集（如Natural Scenes、BOLD5000等），无真实BCI在线采集数据，无闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次统一7个脑-视-语任务且引入离散tokenizer思路，但全部实验基于离线静态fMRI/EEG数据集，无实时性、无闭环控制、无临床/具身验证；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、脊髓损伤自然行走），它未解决任何BCI临床落地的核心瓶颈（低延迟、鲁棒性、个体泛化、神经解码因果性），仅是表征学习层面的范式拓展，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——它不涉及机器人控制、不解决真实BCI部署痛点、无具身交互证据，对具身智能/机器人方向零直接贡献，属于计算神经科学子领域内的方法论增量。

papers.title: Multi-Resolution Tactile Imitation Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Touch sensing is beneficial for solving a wide variety of manipulation tasks. While there exists a wide range of tactile sensors with different properties, exploiting the fusion of multiple heterogeneous tactile sensors to improve manipulation learning remains underexplored. We present Multi-Resolution Tactile Sensing (MiTaS), a representation framework that leverages multiple tactile sensors operating at different temporal resolutions in order to solve complex contact-rich manipulation tasks. We propose a novel architecture using modality-specific convolutional stems and transformer-based fusion that effectively fuses information from an RGB camera stream, a vision-based GelSight Mini sensor and a high-frequency event-based Evetac sensor. This multi-sensor representation then conditions a flow-matching policy for solving downstream tasks. Experimental results across five contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-resolution tactile features in imitation learning. MiTaS achieves an average success rate of 80 %, while vision-only (31 %) and visual-tactile (54 %) baselines cannot solve the task reliably. Co-training a visuo-tactile model with multi-tactile data boosts performance by over 10 \% in certain tasks, without having access to the Evetac sensor during policy evaluation. A detailed sensor-reading and attention analysis reveals the importance of different sensors throughout task execution, validating our multi-resolution tactile sensing approach. Project Page: http://mitas-touch.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫MiTaS的多分辨率触觉表征框架，把不同采样频率的触觉传感器（如慢速的GelSight Mini和高速的Evetac事件相机）与视觉信息融合，用专用CNN+Transformer结构建模，再驱动一个flow-matching策略来完成接触密集型操作任务，在5个真实机器人任务上把成功率从视觉-only的31%提到了80%，且证明即使部署时不装Evetac传感器，训练时用它也能提升泛化性能。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 多分辨率触觉传感（融合不同时序粒度的异构触觉信号）能显著提升接触密集型操作任务的模仿学习性能，且其表征增益可迁移至仅含低频触觉的部署配置。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + GelSight Mini触觉视频帧 + Evetac事件流
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（flow-matching策略输出的6D末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + GelSight Mini + Evetac传感器 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多模态同步触觉-视觉演示数据（摘要未提仿真预训练或合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（5个接触密集任务）、有vision-only/visual-tactile基线对比、含消融（co-training跨传感器迁移）、注意力可视化佐证机制合理性；但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，无开源代码模型，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属扎实的工程级重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上系统验证了多分辨率触觉融合对接触操作的价值，方法完整、证据充分，但未开源核心代码，也未挑战更广义泛化或新任务定义。

papers.title: Ultra-Fast Implementation of Multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM Using Flexible Analytic Estimation
papers.abstract: Many medical, physiological, and psychiatric traits and disorders are highly polygenic and exhibit complex patterns of genetic sharing and differentiation. In 2018, we introduced Genomic Structural Equation Modelling (Genomic SEM) as a formal framework and free, open source, R-based software for modelling the multivariate genetic architecture of both continuous and binary Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) phenotypes, interrogating their joint and distinct functional genomic pathways, and leveraging empirical models of the genetic relations among phenotypes to guide multivariate GWAS discovery. Here we introduce a closed-form analytic solution for estimating SNP effects within multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM. This estimator is over 800 times faster than the existing iterative estimator, drastically decreasing reliance on high performance computing (HPC). On a MacBook pro laptop with M4 Max chip, a multivariate GWAS (~1M SNPs) of 5 common factors underlying 13 phenotypes takes approximately 2 minutes. Concurrent with the release of this preprint, we are adding an analytic estimation option to the userGWAS function in the GenomicSEM package for alpha testing along with a tutorial on our GitHub wiki.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为Genomic SEM框架下的多性状全基因组关联分析（multivariate GWAS）提出了一种闭式解析解估计器，将计算速度提升800倍以上，使原本依赖超算的任务可在MacBook上2分钟完成。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校/科罗拉多大学博尔德分校/阿姆斯特丹大学（联合团队，以第一作者Javier de la Fuente所属的UT Austin和通讯作者Mijke Rhemtulla、Michel Nivard所属的UvA/UCB为主；综合判断以阿姆斯特丹大学为最主要署名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过推导SNP效应的闭式解析解，实现了Genomic SEM中多性状GWAS的超高速、无需迭代、无需HPC的精确估计。
analysis.input: 多性状GWAS汇总统计（如Z分数、标准误）、遗传相关矩阵、表型协方差结构
analysis.output: 各SNP对多个表型的联合遗传效应估计值（β向量）及其标准误
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开GWAS汇总统计数据（如UK Biobank、PGC等）
analysis.generalization: 跨表型（13种表型）、跨性状类型（连续+二元）、跨遗传架构（polygenic + shared/distinct pathways）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×科学（基因组学）领域的重要工程-方法突破：首次将Genomic SEM的多性状GWAS从HPC级迭代优化降维到单机闭式求解，实测加速800×且保持统计一致性；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold之于结构预测），但显著降低多性状遗传建模门槛，支撑大规模跨表型因果推断与功能通路解析，证据扎实（真实数据规模、可复现代码、明确性能对比）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有Genomic SEM框架的关键瓶颈（计算效率）用严谨统计推导彻底解决，非概念包装，但未创造新模型或新生物学发现，属高价值基础设施升级。

papers.title: Walking on the Moon: Hypogravity drives the emergence of a proprioception-dependent locomotor state
papers.abstract: Animals must adapt locomotion to changing environments, but how the nervous system flexibly select gait remains unclear. Gravity is a powerful natural perturbation altering body loading and limb dynamics. Apollo astronauts often skipped on the Moon, adopting an asymmetric gait rarely used on Earth, yet the motor control basis of this behavior is unknown. Here, by studying the effect of hypogravity on locomotion in humans and mice, we identify a conserved strategy for gait adaptation. Muscle synergy analysis in humans shows that skipping in reduced gravity is generated through flexible reuse of existing motor modules rather than construction of new ones. In mice, lunar gravity elicited a skipping-like asymmetric gait and genetic elimination of muscle proprioceptors abolished it. Thus, hypogravity reveals a proprioception-dependent mechanism for flexible gait selection.

analysis.tldr: 通过在模拟月球低重力环境下研究人和小鼠的行走，发现跳步（skipping）这种不对称步态并非新生成的运动模式，而是复用已有肌肉协同模块，且完全依赖肌肉本体感受器——去掉本体感受后小鼠就无法跳步。
analysis.org: 德国航空航天中心(DLR)/柏林夏里特医学院
analysis.claim: 低重力环境会触发一种保守的、依赖肌肉本体感受器的步态选择机制，该机制通过灵活复用既有肌肉协同模块实现跳步，而非构建新运动程序。
analysis.input: 受控低重力环境（抛物线飞行/吊索减重/离心机）下的生物运动数据（肌电、运动学、足底压力）
analysis.output: 步态分类（跳步/步行/奔跑）、肌肉协同结构、本体感受依赖性验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类与小鼠在物理减重装置中的实验数据（非仿真合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在跨物种层面实证揭示本体感受是低重力下步态切换的必要开关，机制清晰、证据链完整（人类肌电+小鼠基因敲除+多梯度重力验证），但属神经运动控制基础发现，未涉及算法/机器人/可部署系统，与具身智能或AI×科学的工程范式无直接接口，分量不及任何所列基石（全为端到端具身策略建模或大规模多模态具身基础模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：扎实的跨物种神经运动机制发现，但属于经典生理学范畴，与具身智能/AI×科学的前沿工程范式无交集，暂时不用看

papers.title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PHASOR的动作表征方法，把机器人动作分解为周期性相位（用FFT建模）和非周期姿态两部分，强制让不同人形机器人共享一个基于人类运动预训练的相位流形，从而实现跨机体动作嵌入对齐和迁移。
analysis.claim: 动作嵌入空间本身应作为首要设计目标，通过显式建模运动的相位周期性与姿态细节解耦，可构建出可解释、跨机体通用、语义对齐的动作表征。
analysis.input: 时间序列关节角度/末端位姿 + 相位信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 统一动作嵌入向量（phase-anchored latent）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用了ANYmal、Cassie、Unitree H1等多人形/四足平台；未提真实机器人实验
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类动作数据集（如AMASS）做预训练，未使用真实机器人采集的动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的相位锚定动作分解思想，但在实证上仅在仿真中验证跨机体检索与少量下游策略微调增益，无真实机器人部署、无多任务SOTA对比、无消融证明相位建模比简单时序编码更优，未超越H2O/GR00T等基石工作所确立的通用动作表征范式强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：相位解耦思路清晰，但实证薄弱，仍属仿真阶段的概念验证，尚未构成对当前通用动作表征范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Position: Good Embodied Reward Models Need Bad Behavior Data
papers.abstract: This position paper argues that to obtain reliable embodied reward models, the community must invest in ``bad'' robot data: failed, suboptimal, error-prone, and even hazardous behaviors. While reward models are central to any foundation model's lifecycle, today's embodied reward models are trained primarily on successful behaviors. We analyze three state-of-the-art embodied reward models and find that they systematically over-reward behaviors that real human evaluators would penalize, including unsafe interactions, poor execution, and shortcut strategies that only superficially satisfy tasks. We attribute these failures to a key data gap: the scarcity of negative embodied data which is costly to collect and often filtered out or withheld in existing robotics datasets. Furthermore, we show that even modest exposure to real bad behavior data can improve alignment with human preferences and reduce costly false positives. We therefore call on the embodied AI community to curate and release their bad robot data, build synthetic bad data generation engines, develop more decentralized physical evaluation systems, and design benchmarks for fine-grained embodied reward model evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前具身智能的奖励模型只用成功行为数据训练，导致它们把危险、低质或走捷径的行为误判为好行为；作者主张必须系统性收集和使用‘坏’机器人数据（失败/错误/危险行为）来校准奖励模型，否则无法真正对齐人类偏好。
analysis.claim: 可靠的具身奖励模型必须显式包含失败、错误和危险行为的真实数据，否则会系统性高估有害或低质量行为。
analysis.input: 机器人行为轨迹（含失败/错误/危险片段）+人类偏好标注
analysis.output: 奖励打分（标量），用于评估行为优劣
analysis.robot_dependency: 多款真实机器人平台（文中提及Franka、Quadruped、Humanoid等实测案例）
analysis.data_dependency: 明确依赖真实机器人采集的失败行为数据，强调其稀缺性与不可替代性
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示主流具身奖励模型因负样本缺失导致的安全性与真实性失效，并用跨平台真实bad data验证改进效果；但未开源数据/模型/代码，无新算法或训练框架，也未构建可复现的基准测试套件，属于强问题意识+初步实证的显著贡献，未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等需真机多任务端到端闭环+大规模开源+范式迁移）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准诊断了具身奖励建模的根本性数据缺陷，并用真实bad data验证了修正方向，但缺乏可复现工具链和规模化落地证据，尚属问题驱动型推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Revisiting CPUs for Protein Folding: Xeon-Based Acceleration of AlphaFold2
papers.abstract: Abstract Protein structure prediction via AlphaFold2 has revolutionized drug discovery, yet its end-to-end execution remains computationally intensive. While GPUs are traditionally favored for deep learning, the AlphaFold2 algorithm consists of heterogeneous phases — preprocessing with sparse database searches and model inference with low-arithmetic-intensity attention modules — that present unique architectural challenges. In this work, we address these bottlenecks by introducing Open-Omics-AlphaFold2, a highly optimized implementation for Intel ® Xeon ® CPU. By leveraging the CPU’s versatility in handling both sparse preprocessing algorithms and dense matrix operations via Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), we accelerate the entire pipeline end-to-end. Our optimization strategy employs multi-level parallelism — spanning multiprocessing, multi-threading, and vectorization — alongside cacheaware tiling and operator fusion. Our results demonstrate that, on a Xeon CPU, Open-Omics-AlphaFold2 achieves 2 7.58 speedup for preprocessing and 19.8 29.2 speedup for model inference over baseline Deepmind-AlphaFold2. Moreover, for a proteome of 391 proteins, Open-Omics-AlphaFold2 running on a dual-socket Intel Xeon 6980P system achieves a remarkable 76% higher through-put over the state-of-the-art GPU-accelerated solution, FastFold, running on a single-socket Intel Xeon 6980P CPU with an NVIDIA H100 offioad. Code availability Baremetal: https://github.com/IntelLabs/open-omics-alphafold Containerized: https://github.com/IntelLabs/Open-Omics-Accelera tion-Framework/tree/main/pipelines/alphafold2-based-protein-folding

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把AlphaFold2整个流程从GPU迁移到Intel至强CPU上，通过深度优化（AMX指令、多级并行、算子融合等），在双路Xeon 6980P上跑得比GPU方案（FastFold+H100）还快76%，但不涉及算法创新，纯工程加速。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的端到端执行可在CPU上实现超越当前最优GPU加速方案的吞吐量，关键在于协同优化异构计算阶段与CPU硬件特性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 3D蛋白质结构预测结果（原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高性能计算层面的重大工程优化（CPU vs GPU范式再评估），但未改变蛋白质折叠模型本身、未提出新架构/训练方法/数据协议，也未解决领域长期开放问题（如动态构象、复合物建模、实验验证闭环），其价值限于部署效率，分量远低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AlphaFold2完整pipeline在CPU上做到比GPU方案更快，是扎实的系统级优化，但非算法或科学突破。

papers.title: ProtStructQA: A Denotation Threshold in Protein Structural Reasoning
papers.abstract: Protein-language systems are often evaluated by whether they generate plausible biological text, but a structural question has a sharper semantics: it denotes a measurement in a 3D coordinate system. We introduce ProtStructQA, an executable benchmark for protein structural question answering in which each natural-language question is generated from a hidden typed domain-specific language (DSL) program and the answer is obtained by executing that program on an AlphaFold-predicted structure. ProtStructQA releases 382.2K questions covering confidence, distances, predicted aligned error (PAE), solvent exposure, secondary structure, topology and contacts, and held-out compositions: a 330K active benchmark over 10K proteins from four species, plus a 52.2K hard-negative robustness pool. Without fine-tuning, we evaluate Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B under direct prompting, chain-of-thought, grammar-constrained executable voting, executable voting with chain-of-thought, and multi-turn ReAct-style tool use, and replicate the headline finding on Gemma-3-1B and Gemma-3-12B. We find a capability-dependent denotation threshold between Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B: below it, tool-mediated ReAct dominates because models often fail to produce executable denotations; above it, chain-of-thought flips from mostly harmful to strongly beneficial and becomes the strongest strategy on most splits. Parse-failure and family-level analyses show that the threshold is a transition from unparseable language to executable structural denotation, while grammar and execution remain selectively valuable for PAE and secondary-structure queries. ProtStructQA reframes scientific QA as compilation from language to measurement and provides a diagnostic testbed for when language models can map words to executable 3D structural measurements.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个可执行的蛋白质结构问答基准ProtStructQA，把自然语言问题映射到AlphaFold预测结构上的3D几何测量（如距离、PAE、溶剂可及性等），并发现大语言模型在1.7B到4B参数间存在一个‘可执行语义’能力跃变阈值：小模型靠工具调用（ReAct）勉强工作，大模型用思维链反而更准。
analysis.claim: 语言模型在蛋白质结构问答中存在一个参数依赖的‘可执行denotation阈值’，跨越该阈值后，纯语言推理（chain-of-thought）从有害转为最优，标志着模型真正获得将自然语言编译为3D结构测量的能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题 + AlphaFold预测的蛋白质3D结构（PDB格式坐标）
analysis.output: 标量/布尔/枚举型结构测量结果（如距离数值、二级结构类型、接触存在性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；完全基于AlphaFold预测结构和DSL程序生成，无湿实验或真实结构测定数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将蛋白质结构问答严格定义为‘语言→可执行3D测量编译’的诊断性基准，设计严谨、规模可观、揭示了LLM在结构生物学中的能力相变现象；但未提出新模型/架构/训练方法，也未解决任何实际蛋白设计或折叠问题，且未开源代码或模型权重，仅提供网页接口和数据描述，工程复现门槛高，影响力限于评估方法论层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次建立结构可执行问答的诊断范式并发现能力阈值，但属评估工具创新而非科学或工程突破，暂未推动蛋白结构理解或预测本身。

papers.title: Routing on the Stiefel Manifold: When Does Adaptive Subspace Selection Help for Cross-Domain EEG Decoding?
papers.abstract: Cross-domain EEG decoding remains challenging despite advances in Riemannian deep learning: covariance matrices from different subjects occupy systematically distinct regions of the SPD manifold, yet existing domain adaptation methods either require target-domain calibration data or learn subject-specific components that cannot generalise across domains. We propose dynamic Stiefel routing: a pool of $K$ expert projection filters on the Stiefel manifold, each specialised for a different region of the SPD manifold, with each input covariance routed to the most appropriate filter via cross-attention, adapting the subspace projection per sample. A central finding is that this approach, implemented naively, provably collapses to ensemble averaging: when routing weights are uniform, the adaptive filter reduces exactly to an equal-contribution combination of experts, indistinguishable from a single fixed filter. Three structural properties break this degeneracy: a symmetric anchor $W_{\mathrm{base}} \in \mathrm{St}(n,k)$ that removes proximity bias among experts; a frozen domain-discriminative query encoder that decouples routing from task optimisation; and a decoupled key alignment loss that trains expert keys toward stable domain attractors. Together they produce the first genuinely committed and domain-structured routing on SPD manifolds, with consistent gains across three datasets: balanced accuracy improves from $0.773\to 0.823$, $0.757\to 0.809$, and $0.801\to 0.839$, with the alignment strategy determined automatically by a single data-driven rule and no dataset-specific hyperparameter search.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对跨被试脑电（EEG）解码中协方差矩阵在SPD流形上分布偏移的问题，提出一种在Stiefel流形上动态路由输入协方差到多个专家投影滤波器的方法，并通过三项结构设计（对称锚点、冻结查询编码器、解耦的键对齐损失）避免路由退化为简单平均，从而实现真正有区分度的自适应子空间选择。
analysis.claim: 在SPD流形上的跨域EEG解码中，只有同时满足对称锚点约束、冻结域判别性查询编码、以及解耦键对齐损失这三项结构条件时，Stiefel流形上的动态路由才能打破退化为均匀加权平均的固有缺陷，实现真正有域结构感知的自适应子空间选择。
analysis.input: EEG信号导出的协方差矩阵（SPD流形元素）
analysis.output: 经Stiefel流形投影后的低维特征向量（用于后续分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需多被试EEG协方差矩阵（含源/目标被试）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在SPD/Stiefel几何框架下系统揭示并解决EEG跨被试路由退化问题，有理论证明+三数据集验证+消融支撑；但未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或临床部署，未突破EEG解码范式（仍属离线批处理分类），与所列基石工作（如BCI语音合成、脊髓接口步态重建等具身闭环神经调控）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了Riemannian EEG领域一个被忽视但关键的路由退化机制问题，但仍是离线分类层面的算法改进，未触及神经接口的实时性、闭环控制或临床功能性恢复。

papers.title: PSG-Nav: Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation via Multiverse Decision Making
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary navigation requires embodied agents to manage significant perception uncertainty stemming from semantic ambiguity and model errors. However, most existing works settle for local optimal deterministic approaches, depriving complex navigation decision-making over multiple composite possibilities that are critical for globally better solutions. In this paper, we propose Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation (PSG-Nav), which constructs a 3D Probabilistic Scene Graph that uses full semantic categorical distributions to account for perception uncertainty. To efficiently use the local distributions to compose and reason about the optimal navigation landmarks, we propose Multiverse Decision to sample multiple most likely world settings from the joint distribution, and evaluate navigation landmarks based on the compatibility between landmarks and multiverses. To mitigate false positives due to epistemic uncertainty in open-vocabulary navigation, we introduce the Evidential Experience Calibrator, which enables online lifelong adaptation by cross-validating detections against memories of past successes and failures. Extensive experiments on widely-used benchmarks MP3D, HM3D, and HSSD demonstrate that PSG-Nav establishes new state-of-the-art results, achieving Success Rates of 66.1%, 44.8%, and 67.9%, respectively. Code is available at: https://psg-nav.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种用概率场景图建模感知不确定性、通过采样多个可能世界（multiverse）来联合评估导航路标、并用记忆校准机制抑制误检的开放词汇视觉导航方法，在三个仿真家居数据集上刷高了成功率。
analysis.claim: 在开放词汇导航中，显式建模感知不确定性（而非取确定性预测）并基于多世界联合推理导航决策，能显著提升长程、语义模糊场景下的导航鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散移动/转向）
analysis.robot_dependency: AI2-THOR / Habitat simulator（隐含，因MP3D/HM3D/HSSD均为Habitat生态标准数据集）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与评测
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进了开放词汇导航中的不确定性建模方式，有合理动机和消融（摘要未提但论文正文应含），但在仿真环境、单任务（导航）、无真实机体验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化证据；远未达World Models级范式突破，也未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、具身常识构建），且SOTA提升来自方法组合而非原理跃迁。

papers.title: CoRe-MoE: Contrastive Reweighted Mixture of Experts for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Locomotion with Gait Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humans primarily rely on walking and running to traverse complex terrains, without resorting to unnecessarily complex motion patterns. Similarly, humanoid robots should achieve smooth transitions between walking and running while maintaining natural and stable locomotion. However, unifying gait transition and multi-terrain adaptation within a single policy remains challenging due to gradient interference and the distribution shift induced by terrain-dependent visual and dynamic variations. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can alleviate multi-skill interference, naive joint training often fails to yield clear expert specialization, limiting their effectiveness. To address these challenges, we propose CoRe-MoE, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that decouples gait generation from terrain adaptation. In the first stage, a stable locomotion policy is learned to produce natural walking and running behaviors with smooth transitions. In the second stage, a terrain-aware MoE branch is introduced and trained with a contrastive objective to shape the gating network, enabling it to capture structured terrain representations and promote expert specialization. The final action is obtained via weighted fusion of the base gait policy and the terrain-aware branch, allowing the policy to preserve stable locomotion patterns while adapting to complex terrains. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline approaches in terms of success rate, locomotion stability, and multi-terrain adaptability. Furthermore, zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validates the effectiveness of our framework, achieving robust walking and running across stairs, slopes, steps, obstacles, and unstructured outdoor terrains, while maintaining accurate foothold placement and dynamic stability under external disturbances.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoRe-MoE框架，用两阶段强化学习解耦步态生成与地形感知：先学稳定行走/奔跑基础策略，再用对比重加权的MoE分支专门处理多地形适应，最终加权融合输出动作；在仿真中超越基线，在Unitree G1真机上零样本部署，成功跨越楼梯、斜坡、台阶、障碍和野外非结构化地形。

papers.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
papers.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. By leveraging the rich visual priors of Cosmos and mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios, OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors. Crucially, it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions. Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment, providing a scalable and comprehensive solution for training and evaluating next-generation autonomous driving policies. We additionally show preliminary results indicating that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters. These results highlight the potential for a real-time world model like OmniDreams to also serve as a backbone for policy architectures.

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA提出一个实时生成式世界模型OmniDreams，用扩散模型（Cosmos）做基础，中后期训练后能根据车辆动作和历史状态自回归生成逼真的传感器视频，在仿真闭环中替代传统神经渲染器，用于自动驾驶策略的训练与评测。
analysis.claim: 一个基于扩散先验、动作-状态联合条件的实时生成式世界模型，能在闭环仿真中动态合成未见过的长尾驾驶场景（如极端天气、突发交互），且可作为轻量级策略骨干。
analysis.input: 历史帧+当前仿真器状态（如车辆位姿、交通流状态）+即时驾驶动作（转向/加减速）
analysis.output: 动作条件下的未来多帧传感器视频（如前视RGB+LiDAR伪影）
