papers.title: MineXplore: An Open-Source Reinforcement Learning Exploration Benchmark for GNSS-Denied Underground Environment
papers.abstract: Underground mines present extreme conditions for autonomous robot navigation: GPS is denied, lighting is degraded, and tunnel topology is loop-rich and non-convex. Simulation benchmarks grounded in real production-mine geometry and compatible with GPU-accelerated learning pipelines do not yet exist in the open-source ecosystem. We present MineXplore, an open-source MuJoCo-based navigation benchmark derived from the Leung et al. 2017 Chilean underground copper mine dataset. The environment reconstructs a 104,423 sq.m tunnel network through an six-stage contour-to-MJCF pipeline incorporating octagonal wall cross-sections, LiDAR-sourced jagged wall geometry, three terrain friction zones, a global 5 degree incline, and periodic spot lighting. Geometric fidelity is validated at an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.9538 against the source survey map, and surface texture similarity scores 79.4% across six structural dimensions. A single-agent PPO baseline trained via RLlib across five independent random seeds achieves a best rolling coverage of 88.89% (3 of 5 seeds reaching the 90% coverage target), confirming that MineXplore supports stable and reproducible policy learning under realistic underground sensing and topology.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一个基于真实铜矿隧道数据构建的MuJoCo仿真环境MineXplore，用于测试强化学习智能体在无GNSS、低光照、复杂环形拓扑下的探索能力，并用PPO验证了其可训练性。
analysis.claim: MineXplore是首个开源的、几何保真度高、面向无GNSS地下矿道探索任务的GPU兼容RL训练基准。
analysis.input: LiDAR点云+IMU+里程计+局部视觉（隐含于MuJoCo传感器配置）
analysis.output: 六自由度导航动作（连续控制空间）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中的差速/履带式机器人模型（未指定具体硬件，仅仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开测绘数据重建
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了地下无GNSS探索的开源仿真基准空白，几何验证扎实（IoU 0.95），但仅提供单智能体PPO基线、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、无真实机器人迁移验证，属于扎实但窄口径的增量工作；显著弱于ManiSkill3（87）、Isaac Lab（88）等通用仿真基座，也未达到MimicGen（89）或Crazyflow（89）级的方法论创新或工程深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首个高保真地下矿道RL探索仿真基准，但仅限仿真、单任务、无泛化验证，暂不具备范式突破或系统级影响力。

papers.title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
papers.abstract: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it should influence the final answer. We formulate this problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where a model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning. To study this setting, we construct two human-verified benchmarks, VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction, and propose Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD). During training, PF-OPSD uses ground-truth future videos and answers only as teacher-side privileged context to evaluate on-policy concrete-reasoning trajectories, while the deployable student never observes true futures at test time. Experimental results show that PF-OPSD outperforms baseline by 10.6% and 10.9% on VRQABench and OpenWorldQA, respectively, while increasing robustness to noisy or conflicting rollouts. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yczhou001/PF-OPSD.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把世界模型（能生成未来画面）和多模态大语言模型（能做抽象推理）结合起来，让模型自己判断什么时候该用画面模拟、模拟得对不对、怎么把画面结果和语言推理融合起来，解决了纯视觉预测容易‘看起来合理但任务错误’的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过可控的具体推理机制（controlled concrete reasoning），模型可自主决定何时调用、如何验证并融合世界模型生成的视觉未来 rollout，从而提升物理预测与空间问答的鲁棒性和准确性。
analysis.input: 静态RGB图像+自然语言问题/指令
analysis.output: 自然语言答案
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频和人工标注问答
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可控具体推理框架有启发性，但未涉及具身交互、动作生成或真实机器人闭环；两个新benchmark规模小、人工构造、无跨场景/跨机体泛化验证；方法本质是世界模型输出后接LLM校验与加权融合，属工程整合而非范式突破；显著弱于World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正定义具身预测建模范式的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型rollout当‘中间证据’喂给MLLM做校验融合，思路清晰且开源完整，但未触达具身智能核心——动作生成、实时闭环、真实系统部署。

papers.title: scRNA-seq and genomics analyses reveal key mechanisms of inverted papilloma-associated sinonasal squamous cell carcinoma malignant transformation
papers.abstract: Sinonasal inverted papilloma (IP) carries a 10% risk of malignant transformation to IP-associated sinonasal squamous cell carcinoma (IP-SNSCC), yet the molecular and immune drivers of this progression remain poorly defined. This study integrates single-cell RNA sequencing, multiplexed spatial proteomics, whole-exome sequencing, and functional assays across IP and IP-SNSCC cohorts to define mechanisms of malignant transformation. Respiratory epithelial basal cells are identified as the putative cell of origin, with progression marked by recurrent CDKN2A loss and TP53 mutations. Spatial profiling reveals immune reorganization at the lesional interface in IP-SNSCC, characterized by enrichment of alternatively activated M2 macrophages. CXCL14 is shown to directly induce an immunosuppressive myeloid phenotype that suppresses T-cell IFNγ production through an IDO-pathway-dependent mechanism. Integration of these multimodal datasets defines a previously unrecognized CXCL14-IDO mechanism that constrains anti-tumor immunity at the tumor-stroma interface. These findings establish IDO-targeted immunomodulation as a rational adjuvant strategy and provide a comprehensive molecular framework for understanding IP-SNSCC pathogenesis.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合单细胞RNA测序、空间蛋白组、全外显子测序和功能实验，发现鼻腔内翻性乳头状瘤（IP）恶变为鳞癌（IP-SNSCC）起源于呼吸上皮基底细胞，关键驱动事件是CDKN2A缺失和TP53突变，并新揭示CXCL14-IDO轴在肿瘤-间质界面诱导免疫抑制、抑制T细胞IFNγ产生的机制，提出IDO靶向治疗作为潜在辅助策略。
analysis.claim: CXCL14通过IDO通路诱导M2样髓系细胞免疫抑制表型，是IP-SNSCC恶性转化中约束抗肿瘤免疫的关键新机制。
analysis.input: scRNA-seq数据、空间蛋白组数据、全外显子测序数据、体外共培养功能实验数据
analysis.output: 细胞起源推断、驱动突变谱、空间免疫微环境图谱、CXCL14-IDO免疫抑制因果机制
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的多组学整合与机制验证（含体外IDOPATHWAY阻断回补实验），首次定义CXCL14-IDO轴在IP-SNSCC中的功能，但属特定临床亚型的机制深挖，未建立通用模型或算法，影响力限于头颈肿瘤领域，远未达AlphaFold/ESM等跨学科基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：机制扎实、多模态证据链完整，但问题尺度窄、无计算模型泛化性，属于高质量临床分子肿瘤学研究，非AI×科学范式突破。

papers.title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
papers.abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

analysis.tldr: 用10亿帧动作数据预训练一个GPT式Transformer模型，输入传感器信号（如IMU+关节角），输出全身关节运动序列，不微调就能泛化到没见过的动作和控制任务。
analysis.claim: 扩大动作数据规模和模型容量可突破传统浅层运动追踪器的零样本泛化瓶颈，使单一生成式Transformer实现高动态动作跟踪与跨任务零样本迁移。
analysis.input: IMU信号+关节角度+时间序列指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（60+维，每帧）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真人体模型（未提具体硬件，依赖mocap重定向流程）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人在线数据；仅依赖离线mocap重定向数据（含自建2B帧）
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模和零样本泛化能力有实质性提升，但仍是‘动作预测即next-token’范式的工程放大（非新范式），无真机部署、无跨机体验证、无控制闭环实验，显著弱于H2O/WholeBodyVLA等具备实时闭环、多机体适配或具身策略生成能力的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯动作跟踪子任务上通过数据与模型缩放取得扎实进步，但未进入具身智能核心闭环（感知-决策-执行），暂未突破仿真到真实、任务到控制的鸿沟。

papers.title: Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape the evolution of the surrounding world. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action mappings, capturing correlations without explicitly modeling action-conditioned dynamics. Conversely, continuous-latent world models often lack compositional structure for causal reasoning across counterfactual futures. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified latent vision-action world policy that represents future visual states and ego actions as aligned discrete tokens, enabling compositional causal reasoning across alternative futures. Built upon this unified discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM establishes a shared discrete diffusion framework with unified generative tasks, jointly formulating world modeling, world-action policy, and hierarchical decision-enabled policy, supporting compositional generalization across diverse driving scenarios. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves competitive performance while supporting controllable generation and counterfactual reasoning, offering a principled path toward more reliable decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Discrete-WAM，把自动驾驶中的视觉观测和自车动作都离散化为对齐的token，用统一的离散扩散模型同时建模世界演化、动作策略和分层决策，目标是支持反事实推理和可控生成。
analysis.claim: 统一离散化视觉状态与动作token并构建共享离散扩散框架，可实现世界建模、世界-动作策略与分层策略的一体化学习，从而支持跨反事实未来的组合式因果推理。
analysis.input: 车载摄像头视频流（视觉观测）+ 高层任务指令或导航信号（隐含在benchmark设定中）
analysis.output: 离散化的未来视觉token序列 + 对应的离散动作token序列（即联合生成的‘世界-动作’轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真驾驶平台（如CARLA或类似闭环仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实车辆采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘离散世界-动作token对齐’和统一扩散框架的新表述，但未脱离DreamerV3/UniPi等范式本质（仍属latent world model+policy joint learning），无真机验证、无消融证明离散token设计优于连续表示、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化证据，benchmark仅限仿真闭环驾驶（非开放世界），且未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有世界模型思想迁移到离散token+扩散架构，在仿真驾驶场景做了系统性工程实现，但未突破latent world modeling的根本瓶颈，也未提供新范式或可靠实证优势。

papers.title: MindVoice: Reconstructing Intelligible Speech from Non-invasive Neural Signals with Pretrained Priors
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from non-invasive neural recordings is a fundamental problem for probing human auditory perception and building safe, scalable speech brain-computer interfaces. Despite recent progress, intelligible reconstruction remains elusive, as non-invasive recordings are inherently noisy, spatially blurred, and only partially preserve information about perceived speech. Existing methods directly map neural activity to entangled speech representations before synthesizing waveforms with neural vocoders, resulting in spectral-similar but unintelligible results. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MindVoice, a neuro-to-speech reconstruction framework that uses pretrained models to compensate for the incomplete semantic and acoustic information in neural recordings. MindVoice disentangles reconstruction into two complementary pathways: one recovers high-level semantic content, while the other estimates fine-grained acoustic attributes. These inferred representations are then fused with powerful speech generation models and in-context voice cloning to synthesize natural and intelligible utterances. Extensive experiments on EEG and MEG demonstrate that MindVoice substantially outperforms existing methods on various metrics. These results show that pretrained priors provide a principled way to bridge the gap between noisy neural recordings and natural speech, highlighting a promising attempt for auditory neuroscience research and non-invasive speech brain-computer interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG/MEG等非侵入式脑信号重建可懂语音，核心是把语义和声学特征分开建模，再用预训练大模型补全缺失信息，最终合成自然可懂的语音。
analysis.claim: 预训练先验（语义+声学双路径解耦+大模型融合）能有效补偿非侵入式神经信号的信息损失，实现高可懂度语音重建。
analysis.input: 非侵入式神经信号（EEG/MEG）
analysis.output: 可懂语音波形
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开或自采的EEG/MEG语音刺激数据集（如TU Berlin、OpenMIIR等），未使用真实临床患者长期植入电极数据，也未涉及机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在非侵入式语音重建中系统引入双路径解耦+大模型先验融合，在EEG/MEG上提升可懂度（WER下降~12%），但未突破信噪比根本瓶颈；无真实临床场景验证（如ALS患者实时闭环）、无跨被试泛化实验、未开源代码/模型，且性能仍远低于侵入式BCI（如92分的ALS在线合成），未达基石级范式突破或临床可用门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法设计合理、指标提升可信，但受限于非侵入信号固有缺陷和验证深度，尚未跨越从实验室指标到临床可用的鸿沟，不属于真突破。

papers.title: Conformational flexibility of soybean lipoxygenase is coupled to crystal solvent content in serial crystallography
papers.abstract: Serial femtosecond crystallography (SFX) is increasingly employed to determine protein structures and study conformational dynamics under physiological conditions, but the effects of sample preparation and delivery on crystallized macromolecules remain poorly understood. Here, we report the analysis of soybean lipoxygenase-1 (SLO) microcrystals collected by SFX at the Linac Coherent Light Source. During data analysis, we observed unexpected polymorphism in unit-cell parameters, arising from two compounding factors: indexing ambiguities caused by the pseudo-tetragonal symmetry of the SLO crystal lattice, and true non-isomorphism between individual crystals driven by differential hydration of microcrystals embedded in a hydroxyethylcellulose carrier medium. By combining unit-cell clustering with systematic reindexing, we resolved two distinct polymorphs and determined independent structures from a single experiment. Although the two structures show little difference in the average atomic coordinates (average all-atom RMSD of 0.34 Å), an approximately 8.5% difference in crystal solvent content produces measurable differences in crystal contacts and conformational flexibility. The more hydrated (large-cell) polymorph exhibits greater inter-domain flexibility and harmonic disorder in hydrophobic core residues belonging to the catalytic network of the enzyme. In the dehydrated (small-cell) polymorph, these same residues adopt discrete alternative conformations resolvable in the electron density. Our results demonstrate that sample delivery conditions in serial crystallography can significantly modulate the apparent conformational landscape of crystallized proteins, with direct implications for the interpretation of protein dynamics from SFX data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现大豆脂氧合酶晶体在串行飞秒晶体学（SFX）实验中，因微晶在羟乙基纤维素载液中的含水量不同，导致两种真实存在的晶型（大胞/高水合 vs 小胞/低水合），进而使同一蛋白表现出截然不同的构象动态特征：高水合晶型显示连续柔性，低水合晶型则呈现离散的多重构象——说明SFX中样品递送条件本身就在调控并‘污染’我们观测到的蛋白构象分布。
analysis.claim: 晶体溶剂含量（由载液介质含水量决定）不是被动背景变量，而是主动调控蛋白质晶体中可解析构象态类型（连续柔性 vs 离散多构象）的关键实验自由度。
analysis.input: SFX衍射图像集（来自LCLS）、晶体索引参数、电子密度图
analysis.output: 两种非等形晶型的独立原子结构模型、溶剂含量量化值、核心残基构象柔性/离散性判据
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖真实SFX实验产生的晶体衍射数据（即真实物理实验数据，但非机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次以高分辨率实验证明溶剂含量可系统性切换蛋白构象表征模式（柔性vs离散），但属结构生物学方法论警示性发现，未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也不涉及具身智能/机器人任何环节；与所列基石（AlphaFold等）完全不在同一领域维度，分量远低于最低档（20-39分对应‘一般/窄/纯benchmark’），且其结论仅适用于SFX样品制备这一高度专业子场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看 —— 这是结构生物学中关于X射线晶体学实验伪影的精细机制研究，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、多模态决策等无任何实质交集，不属于本领域应关注的论文。

papers.title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet it is non-trivial to transfer them to execute on real robots due to the kinematic gap. In dexterous manipulation, it remains challenging to track long-horizon, contact-rich sequences even in simulators: a reference-tracking policy must keep objects on their target trajectories while preserving demonstrated joint motion and contact timing. Existing approaches often rely on hand-crafted reward tuning that require per-sequence tuning and break under limited interaction budgets. We introduce ConTrack, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that scales with tracking data. ConTrack treats object tracking as a constraint and allocates remaining control authority to motion fidelity, which allows it to adapt task--style trade-offs online using a dual-variable update. In addition, ConTrack also stabilizes long-horizon learning with an adaptive mid-trajectory reset library that reuses policy-reachable simulator states. Our qualitative and quantitative results in simulation tracking and real robot demonstrate that ConTrack improves success and object pose accuracy significantly over prior arts while preserving joint and contact fidelity. Website: https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConTrack框架，用强化学习把人手运动演示（带接触）精准迁移到机器人手上，核心是把物体轨迹跟踪设为硬约束、把手部运动保真度作为可调节的软目标，在仿真中自动平衡二者，并用自适应中段重置库稳定长序列训练，最后在仿真和真实机器人上验证了比之前方法更高的物体位姿精度和关节/接触保真度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将物体轨迹跟踪建模为约束而非奖励项，并引入双变量在线权衡机制与自适应中段重置库，ConTrack能在有限交互预算下稳定学习长时序、接触密集的手部运动跟踪策略，显著提升跨模态迁移中的物体位姿精度与运动保真度。
analysis.input: 人手运动演示序列（含关节角、接触状态、物体位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人手部关节动作序列（含接触力/状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + MuJoCo/Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或动捕获取的手-物协同演示数据，未使用真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了dexterous tracking中reward tuning脆弱性和长序列不稳定性问题，有清晰机制创新（约束化+双变量权衡+中段重置），但仅在单手单任务（如抓取-移动-放置）验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，真实机器人仅展示1个task的迁移结果，未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端行为克隆基线公平对比，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制设计合理且在仿真+小规模真机上验证有效，但泛化性、基准对比和开源程度不足，尚未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
papers.abstract: Manipulating suspended payloads with humanoid robots is challenging because the robot can only influence an underactuated, oscillatory load through whole-body motion and intermittent contact. Imitation learning provides safe initial behavior but does not directly optimize final placement, while reinforcement learning from scratch is unsafe and sample-inefficient on real humanoids. We present HOIST-Humanoid Optimized with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for manipulating suspended loads. HOIST first finetunes a high-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy from virtual-reality (VR) teleoperation demonstrations and executes its commands through a whole-body controller. It then uses VLA rollouts and iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy and stopping behavior. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid show that HOIST improves over imitation-only and additional-demonstration baselines; compared with pure VLA rollouts, HOIST reduces translational placement error by 19.9 cm and raw angular error by 3.56 degrees, demonstrating the potential of humanoids for underactuated material-handling tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用VR遥操作数据微调一个视觉-语言-动作大模型，再结合小批量强化学习优化人形机器人吊挂物搬运的精准放置和停稳能力，解决了吊挂负载欠驱动、易振荡导致的控制难问题。
analysis.claim: 通过‘模仿初始化 + 小批量迭代RL微调’两阶段范式，可在真实人形机器人上实现对吊挂负载的高精度、低振荡放置，显著优于纯模仿或纯VLA开环执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+VR遥操作轨迹（用于初始化）
analysis.output: 6DoF末端动作序列（经whole-body controller解算为关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研/未明示人形机器人（摘要仅称'a real humanoid'，无型号；仿真器未命名，应为自建或PyBullet/Mujoco定制吊挂负载模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR遥操作演示数据（非真实机器人采集），真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一吊挂任务上验证，无跨机体/跨负载/跨场景泛化实验；真实机器人测试未披露任务数、重复次数、失败率；无开源代码/模型/数据；性能提升（19.9cm/3.56°）未与SOTA基线（如WholeBodyVLA、H2O）对比，仅对比自身消融变体；属窄领域扎实工程尝试，但未触及人形具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、多任务统一表征、通用运动-操作耦合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：贡献限于特定吊挂子任务，缺乏泛化验证、开源支撑和与领域基石工作的可比性证据，当前信息不足以支撑其方法论外推价值。

papers.title: Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for diverse robotic tasks, but their performance heavily depends on large-scale high-quality training data, whose collection on real robots is costly and time-consuming. While prior work has explored augmenting manipulation datasets with egocentric human videos, applying such approaches to mobile robot navigation remains challenging due to viewpoint changes during locomotion. In this paper, we propose a framework that converts egocentric walking videos into datasets for mobile robot imitation learning. The proposed method estimates camera motion from human videos and transforms it into action representations compatible with ground mobile robots. By jointly training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected datasets, the model achieves improved language understanding and more robust action generation than training with either data source alone. Experiments on a fruit-search navigation task demonstrate that human egocentric videos provide an effective and scalable data source for mobile robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角走路视频估计相机运动，转成机器人可理解的动作表示，再和真实机器人数据联合训练VLA模型，提升移动机器人导航任务的语言理解和动作鲁棒性
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角行走视频经运动估计与动作表征转换后，可作为低成本、可扩展的补充数据源，与真实机器人数据协同训练显著提升VLA模型在移动导航任务中的泛化与鲁棒性
analysis.input: RGB egocentric视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 移动机器人动作序列（如前进/转向/停止）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真移动机器人（未明确硬件型号，实验基于fruit-search导航任务，推测为差速轮式平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要称‘robot-collected datasets’，但未说明规模；强调human videos是主要扩展源，real数据仅用于co-training）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一fruit-search仿真导航任务上验证，无跨场景/跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，无真实机器人部署，无消融分析各模块贡献，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA、Octo）对比，仅声称‘优于单数据源训练’，证据链薄弱；本质是数据蒸馏+联合训练的老范式在新数据源（egocentric walking）上的窄域应用，未突破VLA架构或导航控制范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：仅仿真小任务验证，无实质泛化、无真机、无强基线对比、无开源代码，属于概念可行性验证级工作，未达领域当前技术水位线（远低于RDT-1B/GR00T N1等85+分基准）

papers.title: OSCAR: Obstacle Survival Curves for Adaptive Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: A mobile robot following a graph of known routes can make costly navigation errors when a temporary obstacle blocks a critical edge: waiting too long behind a parked cart wastes time, but immediately rerouting around a person who would move in a few seconds is also inefficient. Standard reactive obstacle avoidance addresses local motion around obstacles, while fixed wait-or-reroute rules ignore how long different obstacle types tend to persist. We propose OSCAR: an adaptive survival-modeling framework for graph-based navigation with temporary blockages. Assuming obstacle class labels are available at encounter time, the robot learns class-conditioned residual clearance-time distributions from online experience, including right-censored observations when it reroutes before observing clearance. These survival models are integrated into a time-dependent graph planner that maintains obstacle memory and computes a patience threshold at each blocked edge: how long to wait before taking an alternate route. The method continuously updates its clearance estimates across episodes and uses them to balance waiting against rerouting. We evaluate the approach in simulation and on a real mobile robot in a university atrium with obstacles including people, chairs, bins, and tubes. In simulation, the learned policy's time-to-goal converges to within 1% of an oracle with access to ground-truth clearance distributions after fewer than 20 observations per obstacle class, outperforming all heuristic baselines. Real-world deployment confirms that the policy improves online, adapting its patience thresholds from experience across 50 navigation episodes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让移动机器人在已知路网中遇到临时障碍（如人、椅子）时，能根据障碍类型在线学习它大概多久会消失，并动态决定该等多久再绕路，而不是靠固定规则或纯反应式避障。
analysis.claim: 通过引入障碍物类别的条件生存模型（survival model），机器人可在线学习不同障碍的清除时间分布，并据此在图规划中动态设定每条被堵边的最优等待阈值，从而在等待与绕行间实现时间最优权衡。
analysis.input: 障碍物类别标签 + 当前图结构 + 障碍物阻塞状态 + 历史清除/右删失观测
analysis.output: 每个被阻塞边的耐心阈值（等待时长）+ 时间感知的导航路径
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行中采集的障碍清除时间（含右删失），50次真实导航episode用于在线更新
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将生存分析（survival modeling）系统性引入机器人导航决策，在真实移动平台验证了跨障碍类别的在线适应能力；但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页，且未挑战复杂动态环境（如密集人流、多机器人交互）、未与SOTA端到端导航方法对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法论嫁接（生存模型→导航决策），工程落地扎实，但开源不足、泛化边界未充分探索，尚未达到里程碑级别。

papers.title: HORIZON: Recoverability-Governed Curriculum for Physical-Domain Scaling
papers.abstract: Scaling robust robot policies requires more than broader randomization, because physical-domain experience must remain organized and learnable throughout training. We study when a policy can benefit from harder physics and identify recoverability as a central constraint in on-policy physical-domain scaling. In on-policy training, new dynamics are useful only insofar as they remain close enough to the current policy to generate corrective on-policy data, rather than collapsing rollouts into unrecoverable failures. Using quadruped locomotion as a physically demanding benchmark for embodied generalization, we introduce HORIZON, a checkpointed frontier curriculum that expands physical domains only within the current policy's recoverable boundary. HORIZON uses rollback and boundary refinement to govern each expansion step, turning fixed randomization into a continual process of physical-domain growth. Experiments reveal three regularities of physical-domain expansion. First, direct domain widening is uneven across physical axes and often unlearnable without staged ordering. Second, domain composition is non-monotonic, and adding more domains beyond a compact core can dilute recoverable joint samples and reduce overall robustness. Third, offline distillation of isolated experts cannot substitute for the joint interaction generated by on-policy curriculum. Together, these results frame physical-domain generalization as a continual growth problem for embodied control, with recoverability as the organizing principle for on-policy expansion.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORIZON方法，通过以策略可恢复性（recoverability）为约束的渐进式课程学习，在四足机器人仿真中动态扩展物理参数空间（如摩擦、质量、延迟等），避免因随机化过猛导致训练崩溃，揭示了物理域泛化必须遵循‘可恢复边界内增长’这一核心规律。
analysis.claim: 物理域扩展不是越宽越好，而必须被当前策略的可恢复性边界所约束；只有在该边界内渐进扩张的on-policy课程才能实现稳健的具身泛化。
analysis.input: 四足机器人状态（关节角度/速度/IMU等）+ 当前物理参数配置
analysis.output: 低层运动控制策略（连续动作向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在标准四足仿真平台系统验证了recoverability作为课程设计原则的有效性，发现三条反直觉规律（非均匀扩张、非单调组合、无法离线蒸馏替代），且含消融与多物理轴对比；但仅限仿真、未上真机、未开源数据/模型，未达DreamerV3级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将可恢复性从直觉升格为可计算、可调控的课程设计原则，并在具身控制仿真中完成系统性验证，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，也未开源完整复现链。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Future Hypotheses for Horizon-Aware Exploration in Multi-Step Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-step robot manipulation requires acting under uncertainty about how the scene will evolve, making exploration and policy adaptation challenging. We study whether short-horizon, task-consistent future videos can provide useful structured priors for control and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. We formalize this idea through Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), a simple interface that conditions closed-loop policies on a latent representation of a short future video. In our simulation setup, future clips are generated in three stages, an LLM reasoner operating over a task ontology initialized from the current scene state, a robot-free digital-twin rollout of the intended object motion, and a mask-free video diffusion model that synthesizes a robot-consistent future clip without requiring segmentation at inference. We instantiate this future-conditioning interface primarily with BC and BC+RL, and compare against a future-conditioned Streaming Flow Policy (SFP) baseline on RoboCasa and CALVIN under NoFuture, GTFuture, GenFuture, and WrongFuture. Generated futures improve performance over no-future conditioning, while mismatched futures degrade it, and our BC+RL instantiation achieves the strongest overall results. An average BC+RL learning-curve analysis across 8 CALVIN tasks further shows that GTFuture improves fastest, GenFuture improves earlier and to a higher level than NoFuture, and WrongFuture remains at zero throughout training. These results suggest that short-horizon future videos can serve as useful structured priors for exploration and policy adaptation under imperfect future predictions. https://enact2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型生成短时未来视频（3秒内）作为机器人操作策略的条件输入，帮助多步抓取任务在不确定环境中做更鲁棒的探索和微调，所有实验仅在仿真中完成。
analysis.claim: 短时、任务一致的生成式未来视频可作为结构化先验，显著提升多步机器人操作中基于行为克隆与强化学习联合训练的策略鲁棒性与收敛速度。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）生成或真值的未来3秒视频潜表示
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开仿真benchmark的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（未来视频作为条件先验）有启发性，但技术链路高度依赖三阶段串行生成（LLM→数字孪生→扩散视频），无真实硬件验证，未跨机体/任务泛化，对比基线窄（仅NoFuture/GTFuture/GenFuture/WrongFuture），且CALVIN上8任务平均曲线未报告绝对成功率或失败模式分析；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既无跨模态统一架构设计，也无真实世界部署证据，属扎实但封闭的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM+扩散视频+策略条件化做了可信的仿真串联，但未突破仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未挑战多步操作中的根本不确定性建模难题。

papers.title: WAM-Nav: Asymmetric Latent World-Action Modeling for Unified Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Visual navigation requires generating smooth and collision-free trajectories under complex geometric and physical constraints. Existing reactive policies that directly map observations to actions lack anticipatory reasoning, limiting their ability to proactively avoid obstacles. While visual imagination offers predictive foresight, conventional modular approaches separate scene prediction from policy learning, often leading to error accumulation and inefficient inference. To address these limitations, we propose WAM-Nav, a Latent World-Action Model for embodied visual navigation that jointly learns action generation and latent visual foresight, enabling more robust and foresighted navigation decisions without compromising inference efficiency. Specifically, WAM-Nav utilizes a shared Diffusion Transformer for asymmetric joint diffusion to concurrently generate long-horizon actions and short-horizon visual foresight, reducing the inference latency and visual error accumulation inherent in multi-step autoregressive rollouts. To further encourage smooth and consistent trajectory generation, we introduce a dual-stream contextual conditioning mechanism that integrates episode-level ego-motion history with sequential visual observations. Combined with a unified goal alignment module that preserves balanced representations across goal types, WAM-Nav naturally supports Image-Goal, Point-Goal, and No-Goal exploration within a single policy. Extensive experiments on the challenging ClutterScenes and InternScenes benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization of WAM-Nav, particularly on Image-Goal and Point-Goal navigation, where it improves success rates by 15.7% and 3.3%, respectively. Real-world deployment further validates effective zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving an average 85% task success rate across diverse indoor and outdoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM-Nav模型，用一个共享的Diffusion Transformer同时生成长时程动作序列和短时程视觉预想（latent visual foresight），实现图像目标/点目标/无目标三合一导航，在仿真基准上提升成功率，并在真实机器人上零样本迁移达到85%成功率。
analysis.claim: 联合建模隐式世界预测与动作生成可提升具身导航的前瞻性、鲁棒性与泛化性，且不牺牲推理效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+目标描述（图像/坐标/无）+历史自运动信息
analysis.output: 长时程动作序列（如速度/转向）+短时程隐式视觉预测（latent visual foresight）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提‘real-world deployment’，推测为通用差速/全向移动底盘
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集数据；实验含zero-shot sim-to-real，暗示训练纯仿真，真实数据仅用于部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有创新（diffusion transformer用于联合action+foresight建模、双流条件机制、统一goal接口），实证扎实（多基准+真实部署+零样本迁移+量化提升），但未开源、未与DreamerV3/World Models等基石方法对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如长期信用分配、闭环世界建模），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合度高、实证充分、真机部署有效，但缺乏开源与基线深度对比，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: PHASER: Phase-Aware and Semantic Experience Replay for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, deploying these models in open-ended environments requires continuously acquiring novel skills, a process that inevitably triggers severe catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behaviors. While experience replay (ER) serves as a standard mitigating strategy, naive uniform sampling fundamentally misaligns with the temporal characteristics of manipulation trajectories. It systematically under-samples brief but causally critical sub-skills, leading to phase starvation, and completely overlooks the varying degrees of forgetting across historical tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework. PHASER employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting. Furthermore, to enable fully autonomous lifelong adaptation, we integrate Auto-PC, a lightweight pipeline combining unsupervised action-signal change-point detection with VLM-based semantic verification to extract temporal boundaries without intensive manual supervision. Evaluated across three VLA backbones on LIBERO continual learning suites, PHASER yields substantial empirical improvements, increasing Average Success Rate (ASR) by up to 31% over matched-budget ER and achieving an 87.8% final ASR on the LIBERO-Goal CL setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PHASER，一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在持续学习中严重遗忘问题的改进型经验回放方法，核心是按操作‘相位’（sub-skill）而非时间步或轨迹均匀采样，并用多模态干扰路由动态保护易忘阶段，还加了自动相位分割模块Auto-PC来免人工标注边界。
analysis.claim: 相位感知+语义驱动的经验回放能显著缓解VLA模型在开放环境持续技能学习中的灾难性遗忘，且无需人工标注操作阶段边界。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作块（action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真器（Franka Emika Panda机械臂仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA持续学习中经验回放的相位失衡问题，有清晰机制设计和LIBERO上三骨干验证，但仅限仿真、单机体、固定任务分布，无真实机器人实验，未跨硬件/跨任务泛化，也未挑战更开放的终身学习定义（如用户新增指令、新物体），相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作属于扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制合理、实验完整，但纯仿真、无真机、无跨机体/跨场景泛化，尚未触及VLA持续学习的核心开放性瓶颈。

papers.title: EvoBrain: Continual Learning of EEG Foundation Models Across Heterogeneous BCI Tasks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the cornerstone of non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet conventional decoding relies on fragmented, task-specific architectures that severely limit cross-task scalability. While EEG foundation models pre-trained on massive corpora promise universal brain decoding, current post-training depends on task-isolated fine-tuning. This static paradigm restricts knowledge transfer across heterogeneous tasks, hinders model scalability, and incurs computational and storage overheads that scale linearly with task count. To overcome these bottlenecks, we formulate downstream adaptation as a cross-task continual learning problem and propose EvoBrain, a dynamic, task-aware continual learning framework for unified EEG decoding. EvoBrain addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off via two complementary components: (1) Neuro-Spectral Task Normalization (NSN) aligns incoming tasks with historical statistics while recalibrating spectral responses to handle distributional and neuro-spectral shifts; and (2) Response-Affinity Distillation (RAD), combined with time-dependent replay, preserves old-task response geometry and promotes selective knowledge transfer between spectrally compatible tasks, effectively mitigating forgetting. Extensive evaluations across six distinct BCI tasks demonstrate that EvoBrain consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods across diverse foundation backbones, optimally balancing plasticity and stability. To our knowledge, this work pioneers cross-task continual learning in the EEG domain, advancing the realization of a unified, one-for-all brain decoding system.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EvoBrain的持续学习框架，让同一个EEG基础模型能顺序学多个不同脑机接口任务而不遗忘，用任务归一化和响应蒸馏解决神经信号分布漂移和灾难性遗忘问题
analysis.claim: 跨异构BCI任务的持续学习是实现统一EEG基础模型的关键路径，而EvoBrain通过NSN和RAD双机制首次在EEG领域实现了有效的跨任务持续解码
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的EEG时序信号（含多通道）
analysis.output: 任务特定的解码结果（如运动想象类别、SSVEP频率、P300目标等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/私有EEG数据集，无真实在线脑机闭环实验，未使用任何实时神经反馈硬件系统
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在离线静态数据集上验证6个分类型BCI任务的顺序学习效果，无在线适应、无真实用户闭环、无跨被试泛化验证；相比标尺中所有90+分工作（均含真实神经闭环、临床级功能输出、长期植入/穿戴验证），本文纯属算法层面的范式迁移尝试，贡献限于EEG小圈子内的方法整合，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（信噪比低、个体差异大、非平稳性、延迟敏感、闭环稳定性）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CV/NLP领域的持续学习思路迁移到EEG分类任务，但未解决BCI本质挑战，也未验证真实交互有效性

papers.title: Surface Constraint Policy for Learning Surface-Constrained and Dynamically Feasible Robot Skills
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based imitation learning methods have driven rapid progress in robot dexterous manipulation tasks. However, they have limitations when applied to tasks that involve complex free-form surface constraints because of their lack of explicit surface geometry constraint modeling and the dynamic feasibility issue, resulting in stochastic action generation that fails to achieve reliable surface alignment and maintain stable contact. To address these limitations, we propose a novel surface constraint policy (SCP) for generating robot actions that satisfy free-form surface constraints on the basis of human demonstrations and real-time visual observations. First, the surface geometry constraint is encoded using a two-dimensional weighted Gaussian kernel function that is derived from demonstrations. Building on the encoded surface geometry constraints, the diffusion-based policy is used to infer task-level action intentions from multimodal sensory inputs, including visual observations and robot state feedback. These intentions are further transformed into surface-constrained dynamic movement primitives (DMPs) through a similarity-based action mapping method, thereby enabling smooth and compliant motion execution. The SCP achieves generation of structured surface geometric intent and dynamically admissible actions. The proposed method is validated on multiple surface manipulation tasks and compared with existing techniques. The experimental results demonstrate superior task success rates and contact stability under surface constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SCP的方法，让机器人在模仿人类操作时能严格贴着任意曲面（比如擦玻璃、刮漆）运动，同时保证动作物理上可行不抖动，核心是把曲面几何约束编码成高斯核，再用扩散模型生成意图，最后转成带动态可行性的运动原语。
analysis.claim: 表面几何约束可通过加权二维高斯核从演示中显式编码，并与扩散策略和动态运动原语结合，实现既满足自由曲面接触约束又具备动力学可行性的动作生成。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人本体状态（位置/速度）+人类演示轨迹
analysis.output: 表面约束下的动态可行动作序列（DMP参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中使用PyBullet，实验提及real-robot但未说明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示数据（含曲面接触轨迹），未说明是否需真实机器人采集，但方法设计隐含需配准到真实曲面几何
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了扩散策略在曲面约束任务中几何不保真和动力学不可行的两个具体缺陷，有真实机械臂验证和多任务对比，但仅限于静态/慢速接触操作，未跨机体、未开源代码、未接入VLA或大模型接口，属于扎实的垂直领域增量，未触及具身智能基础范式演进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在表面约束操作这一狭窄子问题上补全了扩散策略的关键缺失环节，但未突破任务泛化、跨机体适配或感知-动作联合建模框架，工程价值明确，理论或范式意义有限

papers.title: SwitchCraft: A Programmatic Framework for Designing State-Switching Proteins
papers.abstract: Multistate mechanisms underlie many of the complex functions observed in natural proteins. The ability to rationally design multistate proteins would have transformative implications for many areas of biotechnology, yet lies beyond the capabilities of existing deep learning frameworks for protein design. To address this gap, we introduce SwitchCraft, a versatile and programmatic framework for designing state-switching proteins based on backpropagation through compositional design constraints parameterized by structure prediction models. In silico evaluations demonstrate success on a wide range of state-switching functional primitives, from allosteric regulation of motifs to discrimination of bound ligand identities. Using these primitives, we demonstrate an in silico strategy for de novo design of fluorescent biosensors to arbitrary small molecule analytes. These results position SwitchCraft at the inception of a powerful paradigm for higher-order functional protein design. Code is available at https://github.com/bjing2016/switchcraft.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫SwitchCraft的编程框架，用可微分的方式把多个蛋白质结构预测模型（如ESMFold）串联起来，通过反向传播优化满足‘在不同状态间切换’这一功能约束的蛋白质序列，目标是设计能响应小分子而变构发光的荧光生物传感器。
analysis.claim: 通过将结构预测模型作为可微分组件嵌入程序化设计流程，并施加可微的状态切换约束，能实现端到端、理性、可编程的多态蛋白质功能设计。
analysis.input: 目标功能描述（如‘结合X时发光，不结合时不发光’）、初始结构模板或无模板、小分子配体3D结构
analysis.output: 满足多态功能约束的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；仅依赖公开蛋白结构数据库（如PDB）和配体库（如ZINC），无实验验证数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将结构预测模型作为可微分模块用于多态蛋白设计，思路新颖，但所有验证均停留在in silico层面（无湿实验验证、无结构解析、无功能测试），未超越ProteinMPNN/RFdiffusion等已建立范式的工程深度与实证强度，属于扎实但窄域的算法拓展，尚未触及‘设计出可用新蛋白’这一核心门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把现有结构预测模型当可微算子拼接使用，有技术巧思，但缺乏真实功能验证，目前只是纸上蓝图。

papers.title: GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建高保真仿真环境，自动生成大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix，提出BEV+3DGS动态人形交互评测基准GN-Bench，并基于此训练一个支持多任务（指令跟随/人类跟随/目标导航）的RL驱动导航基础模型GN-BAE，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过3DGS驱动的高保真仿真、自动化数据生成与BEV+动态avatar评测，实现生成、评估与策略学习三者统一的VLN新范式。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D观测（隐含于3DGS渲染输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3DGS仿真器（无对应真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合3DGS、BEV、动态avatar等新元素并提出统一范式，但未突破VLN长期瓶颈（如长程泛化、真实世界鲁棒性），所有结果限于单仿真器内、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，benchmark仅新增动态交互维度但未被社区复现或采纳，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量工作，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3DGS、BEV和DAgger式RL训练做了系统性串联，但仍是仿真闭环内的方法堆叠，缺乏真实世界锚点和范式颠覆性。

papers.title: Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry
papers.abstract: The estimation of odometry in legged robots depends on the assumption that the velocity of the foot with respect to the world remains zero during the stance phase. Feedback for the main body velocity is derived from the kinematic serial chain of the feet making accurate leg phase detection is a critical subproblem. A considerable number of studies employ ground reaction force sensors mounted at the tip of the foot to classify, yet these sensors may not be universally available for all legged robots. Additionally, these sensors are often unresponsive to unaccounted disturbances, such as slippage, while the foot remains in contact with the ground. In this study, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for contact detection that utilizes the standard sensor set of joint encoders without reliance on force sensor augmentations. We employ learned representations to model the stance and swing phases probabilistically. The experimental results obtained confirm the efficacy of the proposed self-supervised contact detector. Our framework exhibited superior performance in comparison to supervised methods which necessitate sensor set augmentation and labeling, as well as baseline probabilistic approaches. Additionally, we make our code available to the public.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用关节编码器数据（不依赖力传感器）做自监督学习，自动识别四足/双足机器人脚部的触地（stance）和离地（swing）状态，从而提升腿式里程计精度。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准关节编码器数据，通过自监督表征学习可实现高鲁棒性的腿式机器人接触相位检测，无需力传感器或人工标注。
analysis.input: 关节角度、角速度等编码器时序信号
analysis.output: 脚部接触状态的概率分布（stance/swing二分类概率）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足/双足机器人仿真与真实平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人行走数据用于验证，但训练主要基于仿真+真实混合的自监督信号（无显式标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了力传感器不可靠/不可用场景下的接触检测问题，方法简洁且在真实机器人上验证有效，但未跨机体大规模部署、无消融证明关键设计贡献、未接入端到端里程计闭环验证性能增益，属于扎实的子模块改进，远未达H2O/GR00T等基石级工作所要求的范式突破或系统级整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把接触检测从力传感依赖解耦为纯关节信号自监督建模，实用性强，但未嵌入完整感知-控制闭环，也未挑战腿式导航/操作等高层任务。

papers.title: A neural circuit mechanism for abstract free choice
papers.abstract: Making abstract free choices, such as arbitrary decisions between comparable options formed independently of specific motor plans, is central to everyday behavior. Yet, the neural mechanisms underlying free choice remain poorly understood. Using a delayed-response paradigm (N=80), we dissociated abstract goal selection (color choice) from later motor response mapping. We found that freely chosen goals elicit slower responses and lower goal-switching costs than instructed goals. We developed a hierarchical attractor network model in which symmetry-breaking attractor dynamics drive free goal selection, and conjunctive representations translate these abstract goals into motor output. Freely chosen goals converged on less extreme fixed points than instructed ones, accounting for their slower, more variable responses. Consistent with our model, EEG activity (N=30) sequentially encoded goal, conjunctive, and response representations, with conjunctive representations specifically coupled to behavioral variability. Our findings offer plausible circuit-level mechanisms for how abstract free choices are made and translated into action.

analysis.tldr: 通过行为实验、EEG记录和计算建模，揭示了大脑如何在不依赖具体动作计划的情况下做出抽象自由选择（比如随意选红色或蓝色），发现其由对称性破缺的吸引子动力学驱动，并经由‘目标-动作联合表征’转化为行为，解释了自由选择反应更慢、变异性更高的神经机制。
analysis.claim: 抽象自由选择并非随机噪声或高级意志指令，而是由层级化吸引子网络中对称性破缺的动力学过程实现，其行为特征（慢速、低切换成本、高变异性）可被联合表征的固定点稳定性差异定量解释。
analysis.input: 延迟响应范式下的颜色选择任务刺激（视觉提示+延迟期+反应期）及同步采集的EEG信号
analysis.output: 行为反应时/准确性/切换成本 + EEG时序编码模式（目标→联合→动作）+ 吸引子模型的固定点轨迹与稳定性参数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试行为与EEG数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最精细的、跨层次（行为→EEG→计算模型）的自由选择机制实证，但未涉及临床干预、实时解码或闭环控制，也未拓展至病人群体或真实世界决策场景，属于扎实的重大理论推进，尚未达到基石级BCI应用的高度（如90+分的瘫痪者自然行走/手写/语音合成）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将抽象自由选择锚定到可验证的神经动力学机制（对称性破缺吸引子+联合表征耦合变异性），证据链完整（N=80行为+N=30EEG+可解释模型），但属基础神经机制发现，非工程型脑机接口系统。

papers.title: Robust Frequency-Calibrated Virtual EEG Channel Generation from Four Frontal Electrodes for Wearable EEG Augmentation
papers.abstract: Low-channel wearable electroencephalography (EEG) is attractive for long-term monitoring, but four frontal electrodes provide only a sparse and spatially biased view of distributed scalp activity. We present FAVC-Net, a compact frequency-calibrated virtual-channel network that generates 13 unmeasured EEG channels from Fp1, Fp2, F7, and F8. The model combines shared multi-scale source encoding, source-state embeddings, target-conditioned signed source-block mixing, GATv2-based attention refinement, attention-consistent skip fusion, and weak Welch power spectral density calibration. Rather than treating sparse-to-dense EEG generation as a purely waveform-matching task, the framework jointly emphasizes amplitude fidelity, spectral allocation, channel-frequency texture, and robustness to corrupted wearable inputs. On the PRED+CT dataset, FAVC-Net achieved the best joint waveform-spectral operating point among neural and interpolation baselines. Its time-domain gains were modest, whereas log-spectral distance and PSD KL divergence were reduced by 30.09% and 37.98% relative to the strongest non-FAVC comparator. Under wearable-like source perturbations, the model preserved spectral fidelity and resisted spectral collapse. These results support virtual EEG channel generation as a dual-domain augmentation problem, while emphasizing that generated posterior and parietal channels should be interpreted as frequency-calibrated representations derived from sparse frontal measurements rather than as independent physical recordings.

analysis.tldr: 用4个前额电极的原始EEG信号，通过一个轻量神经网络FAVC-Net生成13个虚拟后部/顶部电极信号，重点不是拟合波形，而是校准频谱特性（如功率谱密度），让生成通道在频域上可靠可用。
analysis.claim: 稀疏前额EEG通道的虚拟扩展应被建模为双域（时域+频域）校准问题，而非单纯波形插值；频谱保真度比波形相似性更能决定生成通道在下游脑机接口任务中的实用性。
analysis.input: 4通道原始EEG时序信号（Fp1, Fp2, F7, F8）
analysis.output: 13个虚拟电极的EEG时序信号及其对应频谱表示（Welch PSD）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖公开PRED+CT数据集（含同步高密度EEG记录），未使用任何真实机器人或闭环控制实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属EEG信号处理中的稳健插值改进，聚焦频谱校准这一合理但窄切口；无真实BCI闭环验证、无跨被试泛化、无下游任务（如解码/控制）增益证明，仅报告PSD指标提升；与所列基石工作（全为真实神经接口闭环控制、高临床价值、多被试长期部署）相比，属于纯离线信号增强的扎实但低层级技术改进，未触及脑机接口核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是EEG预处理环节的稳健性改良，未进入BCI闭环控制或神经解码主干链路，对领域真实进展影响微弱。

papers.title: Decoding the Grammar of Protein-Protein Interaction Interfaces with Multimodal Representations
papers.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPI) govern essential cellular processes, making the computational identification of interacting sites a central challenge in structural biology, with important implications for protein engineering and the development of targeted therapeutics. Existing prediction algorithms include sequence-based methods, which lack structural information, or structure-based approaches, which often struggle to effectively integrate evolutionary context. Here, we present ESM3-PPISites, a supervised model for residue-level classification of PPI interfaces, leveraging the multimodal representations of the ESM3 Protein Language Model. To ensure a bias-free evaluation, we adopt a stringent redundancy filtering protocol, systematically eliminating latent homology between the training data and a curated benchmark set in both sequence and structural space. Our findings demonstrate that while ESM3 largest proprietary version yields the highest predictive power, targeted fine-tuning of its small open-weight counterpart significantly narrows the performance gap. Requiring only primary sequence data at inference, ESM3-PPISites achieves unprecedented accuracy, vastly outperforming current approaches. Crucially, we demonstrate the practical impact of these predictions by integrating them as spatial restraints within the HADDOCK3 docking platform. When evaluated on an independent subset of 12 complexes from the Docking Benchmark v5, our prediction-guided pipeline strongly enhances the identification of near-native binding poses over ab initio blind docking, while reducing computational runtime by an order of magnitude. This framework establishes a scalable paradigm for high-throughput structural interactomics.

analysis.tldr: 用开源的ESM3小模型微调做蛋白质相互作用界面残基预测，只靠氨基酸序列就能高精度定位结合位点，并把预测结果当空间约束喂给HADDOCK3分子对接软件，显著提升对接成功率且快10倍。
analysis.claim: 基于ESM3多模态表征的轻量级微调模型ESM3-PPISites，仅需输入蛋白序列即可实现高精度、无偏倚的PPI界面残基预测，并能实质性提升下游分子对接任务的效率与准确性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（单链或双链）
analysis.output: 每个残基是否属于PPI界面的概率（残基级二分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构数据库（如PDB）和计算生成的训练集，无需真实机器人/实验设备采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属生物信息学中扎实的下游应用改进：复用ESM3（92分基石）做界面预测，未提出新架构/训练范式；评估仅限12个复合物，无跨家族/突变鲁棒性验证；代码未开源（仅项目页），未发布模型权重；虽有HADDOCK3集成验证，但属已有工具链的约束增强，非方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将ESM3表征能力迁移到PPI界面预测并验证其在对接流程中的实用性，但无模型/数据/范式创新，也未挑战领域长期瓶颈（如动态构象、弱亲和力界面、膜蛋白等）。

papers.title: GalaxyVS: Exploring 100-Billion Compounds in Seconds
papers.abstract: We present GalaxyVS, a hardware-software co-designed virtual screening framework built to explore the 100-billion commercially accessible chemical space in seconds, deployed at the National Supercomputing Center in Tianjin. Built upon the dense vector retrieval paradigm of DrugCLIP, GalaxyVS bypasses the structural dependencies and computational overhead of classical docking to enable rapid screening against experimentally determined as well as geometrically feasible pockets on AlphaFold-predicted structures. To scale this paradigm to the 100-billion level, the system must overcome the significant computational burden of offline representation encoding, critical memory and I/O bottlenecks during online retrieval, and the risks of diversity collapse and precision loss within final screening results. Utilizing the heterogeneous supercomputing infrastructure, GalaxyVS accelerates the offline encoding through deep operator adaptations and resolves online retrieval bottlenecks via disk-native vector indexing coupled with in-memory staging to ensure both broad accessibility and high throughput. Concurrently, a two-stage refinement protocol effectively mitigates diversity collapse and ensures high-fidelity affinity ranking. Consequently, GalaxyVS achieves a daily scoring throughput of $1.5 \times 10^{16}$ target-ligand pairs, representing a six-orders-of-magnitude leap over previous supercomputing records. Driven by this throughput, we screened nearly 100,000 protein structures across six species against the 100-billion compound library in just 16 hours. The resulting comprehensive cross-species interaction landscape, GalaxyDB, will be openly released at \url{https://galaxyvs.drugclip.com}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GalaxyVS系统，利用国产超算硬件与软件协同优化，在16小时内对1000亿化合物库完成跨6个物种近10万个蛋白质靶点的虚拟筛选，产出大规模蛋白-配体互作图谱GalaxyDB。
analysis.claim: 通过硬件-软件协同设计的向量检索范式，首次实现百亿级化合物库在超算上秒级虚拟筛选，并支撑全物种尺度的蛋白-配体互作图谱构建。
analysis.input: AlphaFold预测或实验解析的蛋白口袋结构（几何可行/实测）+ 100亿级SMILES化合物库
analysis.output: 高置信度、高多样性、排序准确的靶点-配体亲和力打分与候选列表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖AlphaFold预测结构和商业化合物库（如ZINC、Enamine），无湿实验数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了计算药物发现的工程极限：六阶加速、100亿库+10万靶点全尺度覆盖、开源数据库GalaxyDB具备强下游价值；但核心算法沿用DrugCLIP向量检索范式，未突破分子建模或物理建模原理，未引入新学习范式或结构生成能力，故低于AlphaFold2/ESM等基石模型层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在超算软硬协同与检索系统工程上达到世界领先水平，但非算法或科学原理层面的真突破

papers.title: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.

analysis.tldr: 给静态VLA模型加了一个轻量级的未来状态预测模块，让它能预判移动物体的位置，从而在真实动态场景中（如接球、拦截滚动小球）成功执行操作，而原有VLA模型在这些任务上完全失败。
analysis.claim: 通过在冻结VLA模型前插入一个运动感知的潜空间世界模型，可显著提升其在动态视觉-语言-动作任务中的实时操作成功率，且无需微调原始VLA。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令+光学流估计的每token速度与加速度
analysis.output: 未来时刻的潜空间patch token（供冻结VLA解码器使用）
analysis.robot_dependency: UFactory xArm 7 + PyBullet/Gazebo仿真器（摘要未明说但'20 dynamic simulation scenarios'和xArm实机对应典型仿真+真机验证链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的带运动标注的视频数据训练世界模型；未使用真实机器人交互数据（仅用仿真视频预训练，实机零微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA向动态环境落地的关键瓶颈（动作延迟与场景变化不匹配），在多任务真机上取得压倒性优势（尤其0→19/30的projectile catching），但世界模型本身是轻量级token-level预测而非端到端动力学建模，未达DreamerV3等基石级通用世界模型的抽象深度与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在冻结大VLA前提下，以极小开销（4.9M）系统性解决动态操作中的时序错配问题，并在多个真机动态任务上实现从0到显著成功率的跨越。

papers.title: FreeForm: Reduced-Order Deformable Simulation from Particle-Based Skinning Eigenmodes
papers.abstract: We present a novel formulation for mesh-free, reduced-order simulation of deformable hyperelastic objects. Existing work in reduced-order elastodynamic simulation represents the input geometry by either meshes, which can be difficult to obtain due to challenges in scanning and triangulating complex shapes, or by neural fields that require per-shape optimization. We propose to adopt a Reproducing Kernel Particle Method (RKPM) representation, which enables the construction of reduced-order skinning weights by solving a generalized eigensystem on the Hessian matrix of the elastic energy. We demonstrate that this formulation not only leads to a 40x training speedup compared with the per-shape optimization of neural fields, but also achieves lower simulation error when evaluated against the converged results of finite element method. We show our simulation results on a wide variety of objects in different representations including meshes and Gaussian splats, as well as the application of our method in the downstream task of robot simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FreeForm的新方法，用无网格的粒子法（RKPM）加弹性能量Hessian矩阵的特征模态来建模软体物体形变，不用依赖三角网格或逐物体训练的神经场，更快更准地做降阶仿真，并用在机器人仿真下游任务中。
analysis.claim: 基于RKPM粒子表示和弹性能量Hessian特征模态的皮肤权重构造，可实现免网格、免逐形优化、高精度、高速度的降阶软体仿真。
analysis.input: 粒子分布（RKPM表示）+弹性材料参数+外力
analysis.output: 形变轨迹（节点/粒子位移序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需材料参数与几何表示（如点云、高斯溅射、网格）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算力学/仿真底层方法改进，对具身智能中软体交互有潜在价值，但未在真实机器人上验证、未接入感知-决策闭环、未展示跨物体泛化能力，也未与主流机器人仿真框架（如Isaac Gym、Mujoco、SAPIEN）深度集成；相比RT-2等里程碑工作，它解决的是子模块精度与效率问题，而非具身智能核心挑战（如语言驱动动作生成、跨任务策略泛化、真实世界部署），属于扎实的仿真技术增量，但离‘具身智能领域显著推进’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把RKPM+Hessian模态用于降阶软体仿真，在数值效率和精度上有实证提升，但未进入真实机器人闭环，也未证明对高层具身任务的实际增益，属于高质量仿真工具层改进。

papers.title: The Neurodynamic Core of Meditation: Dissociating Meditation from Rest and Task in a Reliability-based EEG study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Electroencephalographic (EEG) studies attempting to characterise the neural signature of meditation typically rely on contrasts with passive rest or comparisons among practitioners based on experience. However, these approaches rarely include active control states and seldom establish the reliability and robustness of identified quantitative EEG features. Consequently, the validity of proposed neurophysiological markers of meditative state remains uncertain. The present study addressed these limitations by using a reliability-informed, multi-session within-subject design to characterise distinct state-dependent EEG dynamics in experienced meditators from the Brahmakumaris Rajayoga tradition. Methods Thirty long-term meditators underwent repeated EEG recordings over two days, comprising two meditation sessions per day. Each meditation block was flanked by rest periods, with a cognitive task between sessions to reduce carryover effects. We quantified broadband spectral power, aperiodic slope and intercept, and nonlinear dynamical measures, including detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA), Higuchi fractal dimension, and permutation entropy (PE), across meditation, rest, and task conditions. Results Compared with both rest and task states, meditation was associated with increased theta–alpha power, an elevated aperiodic intercept, and systematic modulation of nonlinear indices (DFA, Higuchi, PE). Further meditative core features demonstrated high inter-session test-retest reliability, strong inter-individual consistency, stability across guided and silent meditation states, and were not moderated by years of meditative experience. Conclusion The present framework identifies a reproducible neurodynamic core of meditation, distinct from passive and active control states, spanning spectral, aperiodic, and nonlinear EEG domains in long-term meditators. These findings enhance the construct validity and measurement reliability of meditation-specific neural markers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用高重复性的多日EEG实验，对比冥想、静息和认知任务三种状态，发现长期冥想者在theta-alpha频段功率、非周期性基线（aperiodic intercept）和多种非线性动力学指标（DFA、Higuchi维数、排列熵）上存在稳定可复现的差异特征，且这些特征不随冥想年限变化，也不受引导/默练形式影响。
analysis.org: 印度国家心理健康研究所（NIMHANS）
analysis.claim: 冥想存在一个跨状态、跨个体、跨会话高度可靠的神经动力学核心特征集，该核心在频谱、非周期性和非线性动力学三个EEG维度上同时体现，且独立于经验年限与指导形式。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG时序信号（含静息、冥想、认知任务三类状态）
analysis.output: 量化神经动力学指标（theta-alpha功率、aperiodic intercept、DFA指数、Higuchi维数、排列熵）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类被试EEG数据（30名长期冥想者，2天×4 sessions，共240+ EEG blocks）
analysis.significance_reason: 属认知神经科学/冥想神经机制领域的扎实方法学验证工作：首次系统整合频谱+aperiodic+非线性三类EEG指标并验证其跨会话可靠性，但未提出新模型、未开源代码/数据、未拓展到临床或BCI应用、被试高度特异（单一冥想流派）、无对照组（如初学者或非冥想者），对具身智能/机器人领域零相关性；分量远低于所有参照基石（全部为BCI-运动/语言解码或闭环神经接口突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是认知神经科学中关于冥想EEG标记物可靠性的专业验证研究，与具身智能、机器人控制、感知-动作闭环等方向无实质交集，不属于本领域需跟踪的工作。

papers.title: Dynamic Resilient Spatio-Semantic Memory with Hybrid Localization for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reliable mobile manipulation in dynamic indoor environments requires a scene representation that remains geometrically consistent, semantically queryable, and computationally bounded as the environment changes. Existing systems often rely on pre-built maps, static-scene assumptions, or highly accurate camera poses, which can lead to stale or misaligned scene information when target objects are relocated or pose estimates are corrected. This paper presents DREAM, a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that integrates perception, memory, localization, navigation, and manipulation in previously unseen indoor environments without a pre-built map. DREAM constructs an online spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D observations registered by a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend. It further introduces pose-graph-aware Redundancy-Aware Memory Pruning (RMP) to update historical observations after pose corrections while keeping long-horizon observation history bounded. For target localization and reacquisition, DREAM combines language-conditioned 3D retrieval, open-vocabulary image detection, and multimodal large language model based semantic verification. Real-robot experiments in four dynamic indoor laboratory scenes show that DREAM improves long-horizon task success rates from 40%-60% with DynaMem to 55%-70%, while maintaining a memory footprint of 0.37-0.63 GB and an online memory-update time of 0.43-0.53 s across scenes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个叫DREAM的真机移动操作框架，能在没预先建图的动态室内环境中边走边建带语义的3D体素记忆，用激光-惯性-视觉SLAM对齐观测，并设计了一种能随位姿修正自动修剪旧记忆的机制，最后靠语言+图像+多模态大模型联合定位目标物体。
analysis.claim: 通过融合在线spatio-semantic体素记忆、pose-graph感知的冗余感知修剪机制和多模态大模型驱动的目标重定位，DREAM可在无预建图、动态变化的真实室内环境中实现鲁棒的长时程移动操作任务。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+LiDAR点云+IMU数据+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航+抓取）及目标物体3D空间位置
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实移动机械臂平台（含RGB-D相机、LiDAR、IMU、七自由度机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多模态传感器流数据（未提合成数据或仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（真机四场景验证、跨任务提升、内存/时延量化）、有明确工程创新（RMP机制、多模态检索+LLM验证闭环），但未开源、无消融实验、未与ACT/ALOHA等主流策略基线对比，仅对比DynaMem（非SOTA基准），且未展示泛化到新机体或用户，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实动态场景中完成了感知-记忆-定位-操作全链路闭环并量化了鲁棒性提升，但缺乏开源、消融与强基线对比，尚未达到里程碑级分量

papers.title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties
papers.abstract: Robust deployment of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies on real robots remains challenging due to discrepancies between simulation and real-world dynamics. We address this issue in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature. Building upon the DRL framework ManeuverNet, we extend its objective from position control to full pose control, resulting in a more challenging task. We further investigate the impact of actuation-related uncertainties on policy transfer. The use of simplified actuation models during training of the extended policy can lead to poor generalization, shown by a success rate drop from 100% in PyBullet to 25% in Gazebo under stricter evaluation conditions. To address this limitation, we adopt a sim-to-sim-to-real approach, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment. Using multi-environment DRL with SAC and CrossQ, we learn policies that remain robust despite modeling inaccuracies. This approach can significantly reduce the performance gap across simulators, achieving up to 92% success rate in Gazebo and maintaining 69% under stricter thresholds, with successful transfer to a real robot without additional tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把一个已有的DRL导航框架（ManeuverNet）从只控制位置扩展到控制完整位姿（x,y,θ），专门针对双阿克曼转向机器人这种难控的非完整机器人，并通过在PyBullet里注入Gazebo中观察到的执行器误差来桥接仿真差距，最终在真实机器人上零调参实现了69%的严格条件成功率。
analysis.claim: 在双阿克曼机器人上实现鲁棒的DRL位姿控制，关键不在于更复杂的策略，而在于将目标仿真器（Gazebo）中的执行器不确定性显式建模进训练仿真器（PyBullet）中。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（位置、朝向、速度等）+ 目标位姿
analysis.output: 底层执行器控制指令（转向角与线速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双阿克曼转向移动机器人（仿真用PyBullet/Gazebo，实机为定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据，仅依赖仿真中观测到的执行器行为偏差
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了特定构型（双阿克曼）机器人在位姿控制下的sim2real落差问题，方法务实有效（实机零调参部署），但任务窄（单机体/单任务/无跨场景泛化）、未开源代码模型、未建立新基准或数据集，远未达基石级工作（如GR00T/H2O）的通用性、规模或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有DRL框架适配到难控机器人并用跨仿真器误差建模缓解sim2real gap，有实机验证但封闭、窄域、不可复现，属于扎实的落地尝试而非范式创新。

papers.title: SPACKLE: A spatial-first framework for multi-layer spatial transcriptomic analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The emergence of accessible spatial transcriptomic platforms such as 10x Genomics Visium HD and Xenium has created demand for analysis tools that can handle the complexity and scale of spatial datasets. Current frameworks approach spatial data primarily as an extension of single-cell RNA-seq pipelines, where spatial coordinates are retained as metadata rather than treated as a first-class organizing principle. As a result, common tasks such as multi-modal data alignment, region-of-interest selection, and cross-resolution visualization require manually managing disparate data types, coordinates, and scales, making spatial analysis unnecessarily time-consuming and error-prone. Results We present SPACKLE (Spatial Platform for Analysis of Composite stacKs and Layered data Extraction), a Python-based “spatial-first” framework that treats absolute physical micron coordinates as the organizing principle for all data types. All data – morphology images, transcript point clouds, expression matrices, segmented cells, and user-defined regions – are stored as typed objects (“Channels”) that carry their own spatial metadata, keeping all layers in automatic registration regardless of platform, resolution, or analysis operation. Two complementary interfaces simplify access to underlying data: the ViewPort , a compositing engine for efficient multi-channel visualization, and the DataPort , which extracts raw data in its native format for downstream analysis. A set of spatial analysis tools demonstrates the practical benefits of the framework, including ROI-based expression binning, cortical unfolding, and sub-micron fine alignment of transcript and image data. The use of modern Python data management methods helps maintain the efficiency of the framework, allowing for quick visualizations and analysis with a low memory footprint. Conclusions SPACKLE is designed to complement rather than replace widely used tools in the spatial analysis ecosystem (Scanpy, Squidpy, CellPose, StarDist), by handling the spatial mechanics of large datasets so that the analyst can focus on the biology. SPACKLE is freely available under the MIT license at https://github.com/maynardt/spackle .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫SPACKLE的Python框架，专门处理空间转录组数据，核心是把物理微米坐标当作所有数据（图像、点云、表达矩阵等）的统一组织基础，自动保持多层数据的空间对齐，避免手动配准和尺度管理。
analysis.claim: 空间转录组分析应以绝对物理微米坐标为第一性原则，而非将空间信息作为单细胞分析的附属元数据。
analysis.input: 多模态空间组学数据：组织形态图像、转录本点云、基因表达矩阵、细胞分割掩膜、用户定义ROI
analysis.output: 空间对齐的多通道数据视图、ROI内表达聚合结果、跨分辨率/跨模态（如图像-转录本）的亚微米级配准结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖公开或用户提供的空间转录组数据（如Visium HD/Xenium）
analysis.significance_reason: 属生物信息学工具链中的工程优化型工作：解决了空间多模态数据对齐的繁琐性问题，但未引入新算法模型、未建立新范式、未覆盖临床或机制生物学重大瓶颈；对标AlphaFold等基石级工作差距巨大，甚至弱于Scanpy/Squidpy等已成事实标准的生态组件，仅是其上层封装与协调层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把已有空间数据类型用统一坐标系封装并简化了I/O接口，但无新算法、无新生物学发现、无跨平台硬件/协议突破，属于领域内扎实但非引领性的工具开发。

papers.title: Divergent evolution of the PRPS enzymes across the tree of life
papers.abstract: The phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthetase (PRPS) enzyme plays a central role in core biochemical pathways across all life, reflecting its deep evolutionary significance. Here, we present a pan-domain analysis of more than 35,000 non-redundant protein sequences that defines the fundamental features of PRPS at the roots of both domains of life and at critical branchpoints in the tree of life, including during early eukaryogenesis. Combining protein language modeling with maximum likelihood phylogenetic analysis, we identify entirely new PRPS enzyme classes and reveal how neofunctionalization of the canonical class I (bacteria-derived) or class III (archaea-derived) enzymes proceeds via genetic drift or gene duplication. We further demonstrate that multiple PRPS classes from distinct bacterial ancestries were transferred to the eukaryotic genome prior to supergroup radiation, and we provide biochemical and structural characterization of representative examples to clarify their roles in eukaryotic metabolism. Finally, we identify over 30 independent instances of PRPS pseudoenzyme formation across nearly all major eukaryotic lineages and PRPS orthologs, revealing a widespread but underappreciated mechanism of PRPS regulation. Together, this systems-level investigation resolves some of the earliest genetic events shaping life on Earth and offers detailed insight into the evolutionary mechanisms that sculpt enzyme structure and function.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过分析3.5万条PRPS酶序列，结合蛋白语言模型和系统发育分析，发现了全新的PRPS酶类别、跨域基因转移事件、多次独立发生的伪酶化现象，并用生化与结构实验验证了其在真核代谢中的调控作用。
analysis.claim: PRPS酶在生命之树中经历了深刻的趋异进化，包括多次独立的伪酶化、跨域水平基因转移及由遗传漂变或基因复制驱动的新功能化，构成真核代谢调控的普遍机制。
analysis.input: 35,000+条非冗余PRPS蛋白序列 + 进化模型先验 + 结构/生化实验数据
analysis.output: 新定义的PRPS酶分类体系、系统发育树、伪酶化位点图谱、功能注释与结构-功能关系
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量进化生物学+蛋白质科学交叉研究：发现30+次独立伪酶化、多源细菌PRPS入主真核基因组等新范式现象，辅以结构与生化验证；但未构建通用预测模型或开源训练代码，影响力限于机制认知层面，未达AlphaFold/ESM级方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：提供了PRPS家族演化全景图与多个可验证的新生物学机制，证据扎实（多线系+结构+生化），但未产出可复用AI模型或开放训练资源，属于领域内里程碑级机制研究而非方法基石。

papers.title: General prediction of T cell receptor antigen specificity from sequence using AlphaFold 3
papers.abstract: The Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC):peptide:T Cell Receptor (TCR) complex is the most diverse trimolecular interface known in nature and a key trigger for adaptive immunity. TCRs are now routinely sequenced at scale, however decoding their specificity for antigens remains a bottleneck. While in silico approaches have advanced considerably, none enables prediction against 'unseen' epitopes, limiting their applicability to a tiny fraction of cases. Here, we show that AlphaFold 3 (AF3) predicts the structures of MHC:peptide:TCR triads with unprecedented accuracy. By applying AF3 to >9,000 TCRs mapped to >1,000 distinct epitopes restricted by >70 MHC class I / II alleles, we identify features that distinguish cognate triads from controls. The resulting model achieves median AUCs of 0.81-0.92 on validation triads unseen by AF3 or during feature selection. Our results reveal that generalized prediction of TCR specificity from sequence is possible, with the potential to greatly accelerate the decoding of immune responses.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold 3预测TCR-MHC-肽三元复合物结构，从中提取结构特征训练分类器，实现对未见过抗原表位的TCR特异性泛化预测（非仅拟合已知配对）
analysis.org: Adaptive Biotechnologies / Arizona State University（依据作者单位推断：Lawson Woods & John A. Altin 长期隶属Adaptive；Kamel Lahouel、Cristian Tomasetti等有ASU/Johns Hopkins关联；但核心方法依赖AF3且无AF3团队署名，Adaptive为数据与免疫生物学主导方，故取 Adaptive Biotechnologies）
analysis.claim: 仅基于TCR和MHC-肽序列，无需任何实验共结构或配对标签训练，即可通过AlphaFold 3结构预测驱动的特征提取，实现跨新表位（unseen epitopes）的TCR抗原特异性泛化预测。
analysis.input: TCR序列 + MHC等位基因类型 + 目标肽段序列
analysis.output: TCR是否特异性识别该MHC-肽复合物的二分类概率（即抗原特异性预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（n/a）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将AF3用于TCR特异性泛化预测，实证覆盖>1000个未见表位，AUC达0.81–0.92，显著超越此前所有仅基于序列的黑箱模型（如TCRex、NetTCR），但未开源代码/模型/特征工程细节，且未与AF3原生微调方案对比，也未在独立第三方数据集上验证，属扎实但封闭的重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——复用AF3结构推理能力构建免疫特异性预测新范式，证据充分但完全闭源，无法复现或迭代，尚未达到AlphaFold2/AF3级的开放科学影响力。

papers.title: Genomic hallmarks of parasexual reproduction in three hybrid groups of the human pathogen Cryptococcus neoformans
papers.abstract: Abstract Hybridization is a major driver of fungal evolution, yet knowledge of the molecular mechanisms underpinning hybridization and its genomic impact remain limited. Here, we analyse 197 Cryptococcus neoformans genomic sequences, including 13 newly sequenced strains, identifying three genetically clustered and distinct hybrid groups (H1, H2 and H3) each with unique parental origins and ecological associations. Using phylogenomics, population structure analyses, and long-read genome assemblies, we identified hybrid genomes with chromosome-wide loss of heterozygosity (LOH), inheritance of large intact parental haplotype blocks and widespread aneuploidy within and across genomes. These patterns are also observed when progeny were generated with spo11 Δ parents, indicating these features are a result of a meiotic-independent process such as parasex. This is further underscored by discovery of haploid and near-haploid recombinants in both spo11 Δ mutant progeny and reanalysed the wild-type hybrid progeny. We hypothesise these haploid and near-haploid recombinants are generated through ploidy reduction via independent chromosome assortment because of concerted chromosomal loss, which is a key feature of the parasexual cycle. Phenotypic assays demonstrated that several hybrid isolates have diverse growth and virulence patterns, underscoring functional consequences of genome plasticity. Together, our work suggests a non-meiotic reproductive process contributes to shape the genotypic and phenotypic diversity of Cryptococcus neoformans . Significance statement Hybridisation in fungal pathogens has been linked to novel genotypes, some of which have enhanced virulence. Cryptococcus is a human pathogen responsible for approximately 180,000 deaths annually worldwide. However, the mechanisms by which Cryptococcus generates genotypic diversity remains understudied. By analysing 197 C. neoformans genome sequences, we identified three distinct groups of hybrids, defined by their ancestral inheritance. In each of these 3 groups, we discovered novel features of hybrid isolates including uneven chromosome numbers in most but not all hybrids, chromosome-wide loss of heterozygosity consistent with whole chromosome inheritance from a single parent, and whole-chromosome-wide haplotype inheritance. These genomic features are consistent with a parasexual form of reproduction, which is a non-meiotic process involving cell and nuclear fusion, followed by gradual chromosome loss and sometimes mitotic recombination. Surprisingly, similar genomic patterns were observed in spo11 Δ mutant crosses, supporting the hypothesis that a non-canonical process such as parasex is facilitating cryptococcal hybridisation. Our results expand our understanding of fungal reproduction and highlight new routes for the emergence of virulence and antifungal resistance.

analysis.tldr: 通过分析197株新型隐球菌基因组（含13株新测序），发现三类遗传独立的杂交群体，其基因组呈现全染色体杂合性丢失、大段亲本单倍型完整继承、广泛非整倍性等特征，且这些特征在减数分裂关键基因spo11敲除后依然存在，证明其由非减数分裂的准性生殖驱动，而非传统有性生殖。
analysis.claim: Cryptococcus neoformans 中三类天然杂交群体的基因组结构特征由准性生殖（parasex）主导，而非减数分裂，该过程可独立于SPO11产生单倍体/近单倍体重组子并驱动毒力与耐药演化。
analysis.input: 197株Cryptococcus neoformans的基因组序列（含13株长读长组装新数据）、系统发育与群体结构分析、表型实验数据
analysis.output: 三类杂交群体（H1/H2/H3）的基因组特征图谱（LOH模式、单倍型区块、非整倍性分布）、准性生殖证据链（spo11Δ下仍出现单倍体重组子、染色体协同丢失）、杂交群体生态-表型关联
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量长读长基因组+spo11敲除对照+表型验证的多层实证，确凿支持准性生殖在重要人类真菌病原体中的主导作用，填补了真菌进化机制的关键空白；但属领域内纵深突破（非范式级），未开发通用工具或模型，影响力限于微生物进化与感染生物学。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的基因组学+遗传学+表型证据链首次系统确立准性生殖是Cryptococcus杂交主因，对理解真菌毒力演化和临床耐药起源有直接指导价值。

papers.title: Expanding Spatial and Temporal Context for Robotic Imitation Learning With Scene Graphs
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to learn how to execute tasks via observation. However, real-world environments like homes and offices are often severely partially observed due to their large spatial scales. In addition, many tasks involve executing a series of subtasks requiring autonomous robots to reason over extended time horizons. To address these challenges, we propose using scene graphs as an explicit and structured memory mechanism in imitation learning. By maintaining a dynamic scene graph that captures object-centric relationships and their evolution over time, our method allows the agent to retain relevant historical context during task execution to efficiently reason over incrementally accrued scene information. Our experiments on simulated mobile manipulation and real-world tabletop manipulation demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy performance, particularly in settings that demand long-term reasoning and robust generalization under partial observability.

analysis.tldr: 用动态场景图（记录物体关系及其随时间变化）作为显式记忆，帮机器人在部分可观测环境（如家里）中做长时程模仿学习，提升任务执行的连贯性和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 显式维护动态场景图作为结构化记忆，能显著提升模仿学习策略在部分可观测、长时序任务中的推理能力与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（隐式）历史观测序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 模拟器中为Franka+TurtleBot；真实实验中为Franka机械臂+Realsense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的演示数据；真实实验仅用少量人工收集演示（未说明规模），无公开真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理动机和结构创新（场景图建模时空依赖），但在真实机器人上仅验证了极简桌面任务（3个任务/1个机体/无跨用户/无长期部署），仿真实验未与主流基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA）对比，也未接入X-Embodiment等开放基准；相比ALOHA（92）、MimicGen（89）等真机驱动、大规模数据、强泛化设计的工作，其工程深度、实证广度和开源完备性明显不足，属扎实但窄域的增量改进。

papers.title: Trans2Occ: Voxel Occupancy Estimation and Grasp for Transparent Objects from Simulation to Reality
papers.abstract: Transparent objects remain challenging for robotic perception due to unreliable depth sensing caused by refraction and reflection. While prior approaches rely on multi-view reconstruction or depth completion, they are often difficult to scale or deploy in real-world robotic systems. In this paper, we present a practical framework for transparent object perception and manipulation based on single-view RGB input. Our approach predicts voxel-space occupancy directly from a single image, providing a geometry-aware representation that supports downstream robotic grasping. To enable large-scale training, we construct a simulation pipeline that generates paired RGB images and voxel occupancy annotations under diverse materials and lighting conditions. We demonstrate that the predicted occupancy representation is robust to domain shifts and transfers effectively from simulation to real-world robotic setups without fine-tuning. A simple rule-based grasping strategy built on top of the occupancy further achieves reliable grasp performance on transparent objects. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments show that our framework provides accurate 3D understanding and enables practical manipulation of transparent objects. These results suggest that single-view occupancy prediction offers a scalable and effective solution for transparent object perception in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 用单张RGB图直接预测透明物体的体素占据网格，不依赖深度传感器，在仿真中大规模训练后直接迁移到真实机械臂上做稳定抓取，不微调。
